candidates.english: She ate an apple after school.
candidates.chinese: 她放学后吃了一个苹果。

candidates.english: I have a dog and a cat.
candidates.chinese: 我有一只狗和一只猫。

candidates.english: An elephant has a long nose.
candidates.chinese: 大象有一个长鼻子。

candidates.english: We talked about our weekend plans.
candidates.chinese: 我们谈了周末的计划。

candidates.english: The movie is about a brave girl.
candidates.chinese: 这部电影是关于一个勇敢的女孩。

candidates.english: It is about five o'clock now.
candidates.chinese: 现在大约五点钟。

candidates.english: Please accept this small gift.
candidates.chinese: 请收下这份小礼物。

candidates.english: She accepted the invitation happily.
candidates.chinese: 她高兴地接受了邀请。

candidates.english: He refuses to accept the truth.
candidates.chinese: 他拒绝接受真相。

candidates.english: You can achieve your goal step by step.
candidates.chinese: 你可以一步一步实现目标。

candidates.english: Hard work helps you achieve success.
candidates.chinese: 努力能帮助你取得成功。

candidates.english: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.
candidates.chinese: 她实现了成为医生的梦想。

candidates.english: We walked across the road at the pedestrian crossing.
candidates.chinese: 我们从人行横道走过了马路。

candidates.english: The bank is across the street.
candidates.chinese: 银行在街对面。

candidates.english: He swam across the river.
candidates.chinese: 他游过了河。

candidates.english: Running keeps me active and healthy.
candidates.chinese: 跑步让我保持活跃和健康。

candidates.english: She is active in class discussions.
candidates.chinese: 她在课堂讨论中很积极。

candidates.english: My grandpa is still active at seventy.
candidates.chinese: 我爷爷七十岁了仍然很活跃。

candidates.english: My teacher gave me useful advice.
candidates.chinese: 老师给了我有用的建议。

candidates.english: Let me give you some advice.
candidates.chinese: 让我给你一些建议。

candidates.english: His advice helped me a lot.
candidates.chinese: 他的建议帮了我很多。

candidates.english: We cannot afford such an expensive bike.
candidates.chinese: 我们买不起这么贵的自行车。

candidates.english: We can't afford a new car now.
candidates.chinese: 我们现在买不起新车。

candidates.english: Can you afford the time to help me?
candidates.chinese: 你能抽出时间帮我吗？

candidates.english: The child is afraid of the dark.
candidates.chinese: 这个孩子怕黑。

candidates.english: I'm afraid of spiders.
candidates.chinese: 我害怕蜘蛛。

candidates.english: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
candidates.chinese: 不要害怕寻求帮助。

candidates.english: Our team played against Class Two.
candidates.chinese: 我们队和二班进行了比赛。

candidates.english: Many people are against the new rule.
candidates.chinese: 许多人反对这项新规定。

candidates.english: Stealing is against the law.
candidates.chinese: 偷窃是违法的。

candidates.english: I agree with your idea.
candidates.chinese: 我赞同你的想法。

candidates.english: I agree with your decision.
candidates.chinese: 我同意你的决定。

candidates.english: They agreed to meet at the gate.
candidates.chinese: 他们同意在大门口见面。

candidates.english: All the students are ready.
candidates.chinese: 所有学生都准备好了。

candidates.english: All the windows are open.
candidates.chinese: 所有的窗户都开着。

candidates.english: We all enjoyed the party.
candidates.chinese: 我们都很喜欢这个聚会。

candidates.english: Our teacher allows us to ask questions.
candidates.chinese: 老师允许我们提问。

candidates.english: My parents allow me to watch TV on weekends.
candidates.chinese: 我父母允许我周末看电视。

candidates.english: Smoking is not allowed here.
candidates.chinese: 这里不允许吸烟。

candidates.english: The boy sat alone in the room.
candidates.chinese: 那个男孩独自坐在房间里。

candidates.english: She lives alone in a small flat.
candidates.chinese: 她独自住在一间小公寓里。

candidates.english: He finished the work alone.
candidates.chinese: 他独自完成了工作。

candidates.english: We walked along the river after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后，我们沿着河边散步。

candidates.english: There are many trees along the road.
candidates.chinese: 沿着这条路有许多树。

candidates.english: She brought her friend along to the party.
candidates.chinese: 她带朋友一起参加了聚会。

candidates.english: My mother was angry with me.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈生我的气。

candidates.english: He got angry when he heard the news.
candidates.chinese: 听到这个消息，他生气了。

candidates.english: She was angry at the delay.
candidates.chinese: 她对延误感到生气。

candidates.english: Would you like another cup of tea?
candidates.chinese: 你想再来一杯茶吗？

candidates.english: I need another pen; this one doesn't work.
candidates.chinese: 我需要另一支笔，这支坏了。

candidates.english: Can you give me another chance?
candidates.chinese: 你能再给我一次机会吗？

candidates.english: Please answer my question.
candidates.chinese: 请回答我的问题。

candidates.english: She answered the phone quickly.
candidates.chinese: 她迅速接了电话。

candidates.english: The answer to this question is simple.
candidates.chinese: 这个问题的答案很简单。

candidates.english: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
candidates.chinese: 雨后出现了一道彩虹。

candidates.english: The sun appeared from behind the clouds.
candidates.chinese: 太阳从云层后面出现了。

candidates.english: A smile appeared on her face.
candidates.chinese: 她脸上露出了微笑。

candidates.english: The children sat around the table.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们围坐在桌旁。

candidates.english: We walked around the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们绕着湖走了一圈。

candidates.english: The earth goes around the sun.
candidates.chinese: 地球绕着太阳转。

candidates.english: We arrived at school on time.
candidates.chinese: 我们准时到校。

candidates.english: The train will arrive at nine.
candidates.chinese: 火车将在九点到达。

candidates.english: They arrived home late last night.
candidates.chinese: 他们昨晚很晚才到家。

candidates.english: She works as an English teacher.
candidates.chinese: 她是一名英语老师。

candidates.english: He used a book as a pillow.
candidates.chinese: 他用书当枕头。

candidates.english: As I was leaving, the phone rang.
candidates.chinese: 我正要离开时，电话响了。

candidates.english: May I ask you a question?
candidates.chinese: 我可以问你一个问题吗？

candidates.english: She asked for a glass of water.
candidates.chinese: 她要了一杯水。

candidates.english: The teacher asked us to be quiet.
candidates.chinese: 老师要求我们安静。

candidates.english: We meet at the school gate at seven.
candidates.chinese: 我们七点在校门口见。

candidates.english: She is waiting at the bus stop.
candidates.chinese: 她正在公交车站等候。

candidates.english: I will call you at noon.
candidates.chinese: 我中午给你打电话。

candidates.english: Many students attended the school meeting.
candidates.chinese: 许多学生参加了校会。

candidates.english: We will attend a concert tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我们今晚将去听音乐会。

candidates.english: He attends class every day.
candidates.chinese: 他每天上课。

candidates.english: Please pay attention to the road.
candidates.chinese: 请注意路况。

candidates.english: The teacher asked for our attention.
candidates.chinese: 老师要求我们注意听讲。

candidates.english: The loud noise drew everyone's attention.
candidates.chinese: 巨大的噪音引起了大家的注意。

candidates.english: He slowed down to avoid the dog.
candidates.chinese: 他放慢速度，避开那只狗。

candidates.english: We should avoid eating too much junk food.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该避免吃太多垃圾食品。

candidates.english: She avoided the crowded street.
candidates.chinese: 她避开了拥挤的街道。

candidates.english: Keep away from the fire.
candidates.chinese: 请远离火源。

candidates.english: He walked away without saying a word.
candidates.chinese: 他一句话没说就走开了。

candidates.english: The school is two miles away from here.
candidates.chinese: 学校离这里有两英里远。

candidates.english: Please come back before dark.
candidates.chinese: 请在天黑前回来。

candidates.english: She leaned back in her chair.
candidates.chinese: 她靠在椅子上。

candidates.english: He hurt his back while playing football.
candidates.chinese: 他踢足球时伤了背。

candidates.english: Too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
candidates.chinese: 吃太多糖对牙齿不好。

candidates.english: The weather was bad yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 昨天天气很糟糕。

candidates.english: He had a bad cold last week.
candidates.chinese: 他上周得了重感冒。

candidates.english: Our team beat the other team in the final.
candidates.chinese: 我们队在决赛中打败了另一支队伍。

candidates.english: She beat me at chess.
candidates.chinese: 她下棋赢了我。

candidates.english: Our class beat another class in the quiz.
candidates.chinese: 我们班在知识竞赛中打败了另一个班。

candidates.english: I stayed home because it was raining.
candidates.chinese: 因为下雨，我待在了家里。

candidates.english: She was late because she missed the bus.
candidates.chinese: 她迟到了，因为她错过了公交车。

candidates.english: He is happy because he got a gift.
candidates.chinese: 他很高兴，因为他收到了一份礼物。

candidates.english: The leaves become yellow in autumn.
candidates.chinese: 树叶在秋天变黄。

candidates.english: She wants to become a doctor.
candidates.chinese: 她想成为一名医生。

candidates.english: The weather became colder at night.
candidates.chinese: 夜里天气变得更冷了。

candidates.english: Classes begin at eight o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 课程八点开始。

candidates.english: The movie begins in ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 电影十分钟后开始。

candidates.english: She began to read a new book.
candidates.chinese: 她开始读一本新书。

candidates.english: The cat is hiding behind the door.
candidates.chinese: 猫正躲在门后面。

candidates.english: The garden is behind the house.
candidates.chinese: 花园在房子后面。

candidates.english: He sat behind me in class.
candidates.chinese: 他上课时坐在我后面。

candidates.english: I believe you can solve the problem.
candidates.chinese: 我相信你能解决这个问题。

candidates.english: She believes in hard work.
candidates.chinese: 她相信努力的价值。

candidates.english: Do you believe his story?
candidates.chinese: 你相信他说的话吗？

candidates.english: This is the best answer to the question.
candidates.chinese: 这是这个问题最好的答案。

candidates.english: She is the best singer in our class.
candidates.chinese: 她是我们班最好的歌手。

candidates.english: This is the best day of my life.
candidates.chinese: 这是我一生中最好的一天。

candidates.english: The bank is between the shop and the school.
candidates.chinese: 银行在商店和学校之间。

candidates.english: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
candidates.chinese: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。

candidates.english: There is a park between my home and the school.
candidates.chinese: 在我家和学校之间有一个公园。

candidates.english: The long speech was boring.
candidates.chinese: 那场长篇演讲很无聊。

candidates.english: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
candidates.chinese: 那部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

candidates.english: I think playing chess is boring.
candidates.chinese: 我觉得下棋很无聊。

candidates.english: My little brother was born in May.
candidates.chinese: 我的弟弟出生在五月。

candidates.english: She was born in a small village.
candidates.chinese: 她出生在一个小村庄。

candidates.english: The baby was born at noon.
candidates.chinese: 这个婴儿是在中午出生的。

candidates.english: May I borrow your ruler for a minute?
candidates.chinese: 我可以借用一下你的尺子吗？

candidates.english: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?
candidates.chinese: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？

candidates.english: He borrowed a book from the library yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 他昨天从图书馆借了一本书。

candidates.english: Both answers are correct.
candidates.chinese: 两个答案都正确。

candidates.english: Both of my parents are teachers.
candidates.chinese: 我的父母都是老师。

candidates.english: I like both apples and oranges.
candidates.chinese: 苹果和橙子我都喜欢。

candidates.english: The brave boy called an adult when he saw the dog in the river.
candidates.chinese: 那个勇敢的男孩看到狗落水后叫来了大人。

candidates.english: The brave firefighter saved the child.
candidates.chinese: 勇敢的消防员救了那个孩子。

candidates.english: It was brave of you to tell the truth.
candidates.chinese: 你说了实话，真勇敢。

candidates.english: Be careful not to break the glass.
candidates.chinese: 小心别打破玻璃杯。

candidates.english: He broke a cup while washing it.
candidates.chinese: 他洗杯子时打破了一个杯子。

candidates.english: He broke his toy car by accident.
candidates.chinese: 他不小心弄坏了他的玩具车。

candidates.english: The room is bright in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间早晨很明亮。

candidates.english: The sun is very bright today.
candidates.chinese: 今天阳光很明亮。

candidates.english: She has a bright smile.
candidates.chinese: 她有灿烂的笑容。

candidates.english: Please bring your notebook to class.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的笔记本带到课堂上。

candidates.english: Remember to bring your umbrella.
candidates.chinese: 记得带伞。

candidates.english: Can you bring some water for the trip?
candidates.chinese: 你能为旅行带些水吗？

candidates.english: They plan to build a new bridge here.
candidates.chinese: 他们计划在这里建一座新桥。

candidates.english: They are building a new school.
candidates.chinese: 他们正在建一所新学校。

candidates.english: We built a birdhouse in the garden.
candidates.chinese: 我们在花园里建了一个鸟舍。

candidates.english: Our family is busy preparing dinner together.
candidates.chinese: 我们全家正一起忙着准备晚饭。

candidates.english: The teacher is busy grading papers.
candidates.chinese: 老师正忙着批改试卷。

candidates.english: I am busy with my homework now.
candidates.chinese: 我现在正忙着做作业。

candidates.english: I need to buy a new schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 我需要买一个新书包。

candidates.english: I want to buy some fruit for my mother.
candidates.chinese: 我想给我妈妈买些水果。

candidates.english: She bought a new dress yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 她昨天买了一条新裙子。

candidates.english: We travelled to the museum by bus.
candidates.chinese: 我们乘公交车去了博物馆。

candidates.english: He goes to work by subway.
candidates.chinese: 他乘地铁去上班。

candidates.english: We can save time by taking a taxi.
candidates.chinese: 我们可以通过坐出租车节省时间。

candidates.english: Please call me when you get home.
candidates.chinese: 你到家后请给我打电话。

candidates.english: I will call you tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我今晚会给你打电话。

candidates.english: She called her friend to ask for help.
candidates.chinese: 她打电话给朋友求助。

candidates.english: Good friends care about each other.
candidates.chinese: 好朋友互相关心。

candidates.english: He doesn't care about the weather.
candidates.chinese: 他不在乎天气。

candidates.english: She cares a lot about her grades.
candidates.chinese: 她非常在意她的成绩。

candidates.english: Be careful when you cross the road.
candidates.chinese: 过马路时要小心。

candidates.english: Be careful with the hot water.
candidates.chinese: 小心热水。

candidates.english: You must be careful when using scissors.
candidates.chinese: 使用剪刀时一定要小心。

candidates.english: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.
candidates.chinese: 这个包太重了，我搬不动。

candidates.english: She can carry the box easily.
candidates.chinese: 她能轻松地搬起这个箱子。

candidates.english: He carried his backpack to school.
candidates.chinese: 他背着书包去学校。

candidates.english: Can you catch the ball with one hand?
candidates.chinese: 你能单手接住这个球吗？

candidates.english: She tried to catch the falling cup.
candidates.chinese: 她试图接住掉落的杯子。

candidates.english: The dog can catch a frisbee in the park.
candidates.chinese: 这只狗能在公园里接住飞盘。

candidates.english: We celebrate the Spring Festival with our family.
candidates.chinese: 我们和家人一起庆祝春节。

candidates.english: They celebrate her birthday with a cake.
candidates.chinese: 他们用蛋糕庆祝她的生日。

candidates.english: We celebrate our victory with a party.
candidates.chinese: 我们开派对庆祝胜利。

candidates.english: Give me a chance to explain.
candidates.chinese: 给我一个解释的机会。

candidates.english: I have a chance to win the game.
candidates.chinese: 我有机会赢得这场比赛。

candidates.english: This is your chance to speak.
candidates.chinese: 这是你发言的机会。

candidates.english: A kind word can change someone's day.
candidates.chinese: 一句善意的话能改变一个人的一天。

candidates.english: The new policy will change our school life.
candidates.chinese: 新政策将改变我们的学校生活。

candidates.english: You can change your password anytime.
candidates.chinese: 你可以随时更改密码。

candidates.english: These apples are fresh and cheap.
candidates.chinese: 这些苹果既新鲜又便宜。

candidates.english: This pen is cheap but writes well.
candidates.chinese: 这支笔便宜但很好写。

candidates.english: The tickets are cheap on weekdays.
candidates.chinese: 工作日的票很便宜。

candidates.english: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
candidates.chinese: 交卷前检查一下你的答案。

candidates.english: Please check your bag for the keys.
candidates.chinese: 请检查你的包里有没有钥匙。

candidates.english: The doctor will check your eyes.
candidates.chinese: 医生会检查你的眼睛。

candidates.english: We cheered for our school team.
candidates.chinese: 我们为校队加油。

candidates.english: The students cheer for the runners.
candidates.chinese: 学生们为赛跑选手加油。

candidates.english: We cheer when our friend scores.
candidates.chinese: 当我们的朋友得分时，我们欢呼加油。

candidates.english: Walking to school is a healthy choice.
candidates.chinese: 步行上学是一个健康的选择。

candidates.english: You have a choice between tea and juice.
candidates.chinese: 你可以在茶和果汁之间做选择。

candidates.english: Her choice of shoes surprised me.
candidates.chinese: 她对鞋子的选择让我惊讶。

candidates.english: You can choose one book to take home.
candidates.chinese: 你可以选一本书带回家。

candidates.english: Please choose a color for the wall.
candidates.chinese: 请为墙壁选一种颜色。

candidates.english: I choose the blue backpack.
candidates.chinese: 我选择蓝色的背包。

candidates.english: Please keep the classroom clean.
candidates.chinese: 请保持教室干净。

candidates.english: She wore a clean white shirt.
candidates.chinese: 她穿了一件干净的白衬衫。

candidates.english: The kitchen is clean after the meal.
candidates.chinese: 饭后厨房很干净。

candidates.english: The teacher gave us clear instructions.
candidates.chinese: 老师给了我们清楚的指示。

candidates.english: The photo is clear enough to see.
candidates.chinese: 这张照片清晰可见。

candidates.english: Her voice was clear in the hall.
candidates.chinese: 她的声音在大厅里很清晰。

candidates.english: We climbed the hill before sunrise.
candidates.chinese: 我们在日出前爬上了小山。

candidates.english: They climb the tree to pick apples.
candidates.chinese: 他们爬树摘苹果。

candidates.english: We climb the stairs every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天早上爬楼梯。

candidates.english: Please close the window before you leave.
candidates.chinese: 离开前请关上窗户。

candidates.english: Close the door quietly, please.
candidates.chinese: 请轻轻关上门。

candidates.english: He closed the book after reading.
candidates.chinese: 他读完书后合上了书。

candidates.english: Leo likes to collect old postcards.
candidates.chinese: 利奥喜欢收集旧明信片。

candidates.english: She collects shells on the beach.
candidates.chinese: 她在海滩上收集贝壳。

candidates.english: They collect stamps from different countries.
candidates.chinese: 他们收集不同国家的邮票。

candidates.english: Come and sit beside me.
candidates.chinese: 过来坐在我旁边。

candidates.english: Please come to my house after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后请来我家。

candidates.english: The bus comes at eight o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 公交车八点来。

candidates.english: These shoes are light and comfortable.
candidates.chinese: 这双鞋既轻便又舒适。

candidates.english: This sofa is comfortable to sit on.
candidates.chinese: 这张沙发坐起来很舒适。

candidates.english: A comfortable bed helps you sleep well.
candidates.chinese: 舒适的床有助于你睡得好。

candidates.english: Colds are common in winter.
candidates.chinese: 感冒在冬天很常见。

candidates.english: My school is not far from home.
candidates.chinese: 我的学校离家不远。

candidates.english: The station is far from the hotel.
candidates.chinese: 车站离酒店很远。

candidates.english: How far is it to the airport?
candidates.chinese: 到机场有多远？

candidates.english: Many children fear the dark.
candidates.chinese: 许多孩子怕黑。

candidates.english: She fears spiders and snakes.
candidates.chinese: 她害怕蜘蛛和蛇。

candidates.english: He has a fear of flying.
candidates.chinese: 他害怕坐飞机。

candidates.english: I feel much better today.
candidates.chinese: 我今天感觉好多了。

candidates.english: I feel happy when I see my friends.
candidates.chinese: 当我看到朋友时，我感到高兴。

candidates.english: She felt a cold wind on her face.
candidates.chinese: 她感到脸上有一阵冷风。

candidates.english: Few students knew the answer.
candidates.chinese: 很少有学生知道答案。

candidates.english: There are few apples left in the basket.
candidates.chinese: 篮子里剩下的苹果很少。

candidates.english: Only a few people came to the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 只有很少的人来参加会议。

candidates.english: The team will fight for every point.
candidates.chinese: 这支队伍会为每一分而拼搏。

candidates.english: They fought against the fire all night.
candidates.chinese: 他们整夜与大火搏斗。

candidates.english: The class will fight against food waste.
candidates.chinese: 这个班级将与食物浪费作斗争。

candidates.english: Please fill the bottle with water.
candidates.chinese: 请把瓶子装满水。

candidates.english: She filled the cup with hot tea.
candidates.chinese: 她把杯子倒满了热茶。

candidates.english: The box was filled with old books.
candidates.chinese: 盒子里装满了旧书。

candidates.english: This is our final lesson before the exam.
candidates.chinese: 这是考试前我们的最后一课。

candidates.english: The final answer is on page ten.
candidates.chinese: 最后的答案在第十页。

candidates.english: Tomorrow is the final day of school.
candidates.chinese: 明天是学校的最后一天。

candidates.english: Can you find your name on the list?
candidates.chinese: 你能在名单上找到自己的名字吗？

candidates.english: I found my keys under the sofa.
candidates.chinese: 我在沙发下找到了我的钥匙。

candidates.english: Did you find the book you wanted?
candidates.chinese: 你找到你想要的书了吗？

candidates.english: I finished my homework before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 我在晚饭前完成了作业。

candidates.english: She finished her painting just in time.
candidates.chinese: 她及时完成了她的画。

candidates.english: We finished the race together.
candidates.chinese: 我们一起跑完了比赛。

candidates.english: These shoes fit me very well.
candidates.chinese: 这双鞋非常合我的脚。

candidates.english: This jacket fits you perfectly.
candidates.chinese: 这件夹克非常适合你。

candidates.english: The key fits the lock.
candidates.chinese: 这把钥匙和这把锁正合适。

candidates.english: Maya fixed the loose wheel on her bike.
candidates.chinese: 玛雅修好了自行车上松动的车轮。

candidates.english: Dad fixed the broken chair.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸修好了坏椅子。

candidates.english: I need to fix my watch.
candidates.chinese: 我需要修理我的手表。

candidates.english: Birds fly south before winter.
candidates.chinese: 鸟儿在冬天到来前向南飞。

candidates.english: The kite flies high in the sky.
candidates.chinese: 风筝在天空中飞得很高。

candidates.english: We watched the plane fly over the hills.
candidates.chinese: 我们看着飞机飞过山丘。

candidates.english: Follow the signs to the school library.
candidates.chinese: 按照指示牌走到学校图书馆。

candidates.english: The dog follows me to school.
candidates.chinese: 狗跟着我去学校。

candidates.english: Please follow the teacher into the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 请跟着老师走进教室。

candidates.english: We study hard for our future.
candidates.chinese: 我们为了未来而努力学习。

candidates.english: She exercises for good health.
candidates.chinese: 她为了健康而锻炼。

candidates.english: He works hard for his family.
candidates.chinese: 他为了家人而努力工作。

candidates.english: Do not forget to lock the door.
candidates.chinese: 别忘了锁门。

candidates.english: I forgot my umbrella at home.
candidates.chinese: 我把雨伞忘在家里了。

candidates.english: Don't forget to bring your books.
candidates.chinese: 别忘了带你的书。

candidates.english: Are you free this Saturday?
candidates.chinese: 你这周六有空吗？

candidates.english: I am free after three o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 我三点以后有空。

candidates.english: She has free time on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 她星期天有空闲时间。

candidates.english: We bought some fresh fruit at the market.
candidates.chinese: 我们在市场买了一些新鲜水果。

candidates.english: The bread from the bakery is fresh.
candidates.chinese: 面包店的面包是新鲜的。

candidates.english: We enjoy fresh air in the park.
candidates.chinese: 我们在公园享受新鲜空气。

candidates.english: A true friend listens when you are sad.
candidates.chinese: 真正的朋友会在你难过时倾听。

candidates.english: My friend helps me with math.
candidates.chinese: 我的朋友帮我学数学。

candidates.english: She is a kind friend to everyone.
candidates.chinese: 她对每个人都是友善的朋友。

candidates.english: Our new neighbours are very friendly.
candidates.chinese: 我们的新邻居非常友好。

candidates.english: The shopkeeper gave us a friendly smile.
candidates.chinese: 店主给了我们友好的微笑。

candidates.english: My classmates are friendly to new students.
candidates.chinese: 我的同学对新同学很友好。

candidates.english: The train leaves from Platform Two.
candidates.chinese: 火车从二号站台出发。

candidates.english: The letter is from my cousin.
candidates.chinese: 这封信是我表兄寄来的。

candidates.english: She walks from home to school.
candidates.chinese: 她从家走到学校。

candidates.english: Please wait in front of the library.
candidates.chinese: 请在图书馆前面等候。

candidates.english: The teacher stands in front of the class.
candidates.chinese: 老师站在班级前面。

candidates.english: There is a garden in front of the house.
candidates.chinese: 房子前面有一个花园。

candidates.english: The bus was full of passengers.
candidates.chinese: 公交车里坐满了乘客。

candidates.english: The glass is full of water.
candidates.chinese: 玻璃杯装满了水。

candidates.english: The stadium was full of fans.
candidates.chinese: 体育场里挤满了球迷。

candidates.english: We had great fun at the school fair.
candidates.chinese: 我们在校园游园会上玩得很开心。

candidates.english: Playing chess is fun for us.
candidates.chinese: 下棋对我们来说很有趣。

candidates.english: The picnic was full of fun.
candidates.chinese: 野餐充满了乐趣。

candidates.english: My grandmother grows roses in her garden.
candidates.chinese: 我奶奶在她的花园里种玫瑰。

candidates.english: We have a small garden behind our house.
candidates.chinese: 我们房子后面有一个小花园。

candidates.english: The children play in the garden.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在花园里玩耍。

candidates.english: You can get a map at the gate.
candidates.chinese: 你可以在门口拿一张地图。

candidates.english: She got a prize for her essay.
candidates.chinese: 她的作文得了奖。

candidates.english: I get a letter from my pen pal.
candidates.chinese: 我收到笔友的来信。

candidates.english: This book is a gift from my teacher.
candidates.chinese: 这本书是老师送给我的礼物。

candidates.english: He gave me a gift for my birthday.
candidates.chinese: 他送给我一份生日礼物。

candidates.english: The gift was wrapped in red paper.
candidates.chinese: 礼物用红纸包着。

candidates.english: Please give the note to your parents.
candidates.chinese: 请把这张便条交给你的父母。

candidates.english: Give me a pen, please.
candidates.chinese: 请给我一支钢笔。

candidates.english: She gives her seat to an old man.
candidates.chinese: 她把座位让给了一位老人。

candidates.english: We go to school by bus.
candidates.chinese: 我们乘公交车去上学。

candidates.english: I go to the park every Sunday.
candidates.chinese: 我每个星期天去公园。

candidates.english: They are going to the library now.
candidates.chinese: 他们现在正去图书馆。

candidates.english: That is a good idea.
candidates.chinese: 那是个好主意。

candidates.english: She is a good student.
candidates.chinese: 她是个好学生。

candidates.english: This is a good book for children.
candidates.chinese: 这是一本适合孩子们的好书。

candidates.english: You did a great job today.
candidates.chinese: 你今天做得非常棒。

candidates.english: We had a great time at the party.
candidates.chinese: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

candidates.english: The weather is great for a picnic.
candidates.chinese: 这天气非常适合野餐。

candidates.english: These plants grow well in warm places.
candidates.chinese: 这些植物在温暖的地方长得很好。

candidates.english: Children grow fast in summer.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在夏天长得很快。

candidates.english: The tree has grown taller this year.
candidates.chinese: 这棵树今年长得更高了。

candidates.english: Reading before bed is a good habit.
candidates.chinese: 睡前阅读是个好习惯。

candidates.english: He has a habit of biting his nails.
candidates.chinese: 他有咬指甲的习惯。

candidates.english: Getting up early is a healthy habit.
candidates.chinese: 早起是个健康的习惯。

candidates.english: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
candidates.chinese: 如果你知道答案就举手。

candidates.english: He washed his hands before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 他晚饭前洗了手。

candidates.english: She writes with her left hand.
candidates.chinese: 她用左手写字。

candidates.english: Hang your coat behind the door.
candidates.chinese: 把你的外套挂在门后。

candidates.english: Please hang the picture on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 请把画挂在墙上。

candidates.english: The clothes are hanging in the closet.
candidates.chinese: 衣服挂在衣柜里。

candidates.english: What happened after the lights went out?
candidates.chinese: 灯灭之后发生了什么？

candidates.english: The accident happened on the corner.
candidates.chinese: 事故发生在拐角处。

candidates.english: A strange thing happened at school today.
candidates.chinese: 今天学校里发生了一件奇怪的事。

candidates.english: She was happy to see her old friend.
candidates.chinese: 她见到老朋友很高兴。

candidates.english: The children look happy in the playground.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在操场上看起来很高兴。

candidates.english: I am happy with my new bike.
candidates.chinese: 我对我的新自行车很满意。

candidates.english: The maths problem is hard but useful.
candidates.chinese: 这道数学题很难，但很有用。

candidates.english: The exam was hard for many students.
candidates.chinese: 这次考试对许多学生来说很难。

candidates.english: It is hard to learn a new language.
candidates.chinese: 学习一门新语言很难。

candidates.english: I could hardly hear him in the noisy room.
candidates.chinese: 在嘈杂的房间里，我几乎听不见他说话。

candidates.english: She hardly eats any vegetables.
candidates.chinese: 她几乎不吃蔬菜。

candidates.english: We hardly ever watch TV at home.
candidates.chinese: 我们在家几乎不看电视。

candidates.english: Too much sun can harm your skin.
candidates.chinese: 过多日晒会伤害你的皮肤。

candidates.english: Smoking can harm your lungs.
candidates.chinese: 吸烟会伤害你的肺。

candidates.english: Don't harm the little animals.
candidates.chinese: 不要伤害小动物。

candidates.english: We have enough time to finish.
candidates.chinese: 我们有足够的时间完成。

candidates.english: She has a new phone.
candidates.chinese: 她有一部新手机。

candidates.english: I have two brothers and one sister.
candidates.chinese: 我有两个兄弟和一个姐妹。

candidates.english: Sleep is important for your health.
candidates.chinese: 睡眠对你的健康很重要。

candidates.english: Eating fruit is good for your health.
candidates.chinese: 吃水果对你的健康有好处。

candidates.english: He exercises every day to protect his health.
candidates.chinese: 他每天锻炼以保持健康。

candidates.english: A healthy breakfast gives you energy.
candidates.chinese: 健康的早餐能给你能量。

candidates.english: She looks healthy after the vacation.
candidates.chinese: 假期后她看起来很健康。

candidates.english: Vegetables are part of a healthy diet.
candidates.chinese: 蔬菜是健康饮食的一部分。

candidates.english: Can you hear the birds outside?
candidates.chinese: 你能听见外面的鸟叫声吗？

candidates.english: I can hear the rain on the roof.
candidates.chinese: 我能听见雨点打在屋顶上的声音。

candidates.english: Did you hear the teacher's question?
candidates.chinese: 你听见老师的问题了吗？

candidates.english: This box is too heavy for me.
candidates.chinese: 这个箱子对我来说太重了。

candidates.english: The bag is heavy because it has many books.
candidates.chinese: 这个包很重，因为里面有很多书。

candidates.english: The suitcase is too heavy to carry.
candidates.chinese: 这个行李箱太重了，搬不动。

candidates.english: Could you help me carry these books?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我搬这些书吗？

candidates.english: Can you help me with my homework?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我做作业吗？

candidates.english: She helps her mother clean the room.
candidates.chinese: 她帮助妈妈打扫房间。

candidates.english: Your advice was very helpful.
candidates.chinese: 你的建议非常有帮助。

candidates.english: The map was helpful for finding the way.
candidates.chinese: 这张地图对于找路很有帮助。

candidates.english: He gave me some helpful tips for studying.
candidates.chinese: 他给了我一些对学习有帮助的建议。

candidates.english: The firefighter became a hero in the town.
candidates.chinese: 那名消防员成了镇上的英雄。

candidates.english: The soldier was honored as a hero.
candidates.chinese: 这位士兵被尊为英雄。

candidates.english: She is a hero to many young people.
candidates.chinese: 她是许多年轻人眼中的英雄。

candidates.english: The kitten hid under the table.
candidates.chinese: 小猫躲在桌子下面。

candidates.english: The children hid behind the door.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们藏在门后。

candidates.english: He hides his toys in the closet.
candidates.chinese: 他把玩具藏在壁橱里。

candidates.english: The mountain is too high for us to climb today.
candidates.chinese: 这座山太高了，我们今天爬不上去。

candidates.english: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
candidates.chinese: 这个架子太高了，我够不着。

candidates.english: The wall is high and white.
candidates.chinese: 这面墙又高又白。

candidates.english: We learned about the history of this city.
candidates.chinese: 我们了解了这座城市的历史。

candidates.english: She is reading a book about Chinese history.
candidates.chinese: 她正在读一本关于中国历史的书。

candidates.english: The museum shows the history of the village.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆展示了这个村庄的历史。

candidates.english: Please hold the ladder for me.
candidates.chinese: 请帮我扶住梯子。

candidates.english: Hold the rope tightly when you climb.
candidates.chinese: 攀爬时紧紧抓住绳子。

candidates.english: He held the door open for me.
candidates.chinese: 他为我扶住门。

candidates.english: Home is where my family is.
candidates.chinese: 家就是家人所在的地方。

candidates.english: I want to go home after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后我想回家。

candidates.english: They built a new home near the park.
candidates.chinese: 他们在公园附近建了一个新家。

candidates.english: Be honest when you make a mistake.
candidates.chinese: 犯错时要诚实。

candidates.english: It is important to be honest with your friends.
candidates.chinese: 对朋友诚实很重要。

candidates.english: He is an honest boy who never lies.
candidates.chinese: 他是一个从不撒谎的诚实男孩。

candidates.english: I hope you feel better soon.
candidates.chinese: 我希望你很快好起来。

candidates.english: We hope to see you at the party.
candidates.chinese: 我们希望能在聚会上见到你。

candidates.english: She hopes to become a doctor one day.
candidates.chinese: 她希望有一天成为医生。

candidates.english: The soup is still too hot to drink.
candidates.chinese: 汤还太烫，不能喝。

candidates.english: It is very hot in summer.
candidates.chinese: 夏天很热。

candidates.english: The coffee is hot, so be careful.
candidates.chinese: 咖啡很热，小心点。

candidates.english: The journey takes about an hour.
candidates.chinese: 这段旅程大约需要一小时。

candidates.english: I studied for two hours last night.
candidates.chinese: 我昨晚学习了两个小时。

candidates.english: The movie lasts for one hour.
candidates.chinese: 这部电影时长一小时。

candidates.english: How do you get to school?
candidates.chinese: 你怎样去学校？

candidates.english: How do you make this cake?
candidates.chinese: 你怎样做这个蛋糕？

candidates.english: Tell me how you solved the problem.
candidates.chinese: 告诉我你是怎样解决这个问题的。

candidates.english: I was hungry after football practice.
candidates.chinese: 足球训练后我饿了。

candidates.english: The children are hungry after playing outside.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在外面玩完后饿了。

candidates.english: I feel hungry when I skip breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 不吃早饭时我会感到饿。

candidates.english: She hurt her knee while running.
candidates.chinese: 她跑步时伤了膝盖。

candidates.english: He hurt his arm when he fell.
candidates.chinese: 他摔倒时伤了胳膊。

candidates.english: Be careful not to hurt yourself.
candidates.chinese: 小心别伤到自己。

candidates.english: Lily had an idea for the class project.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉对班级项目有了一个主意。

candidates.english: I have a good idea for the game.
candidates.chinese: 我对这个游戏有个好主意。

candidates.english: That is a clever idea.
candidates.chinese: 那是一个聪明的主意。

candidates.english: Call me if you need help.
candidates.chinese: 如果你需要帮助，就给我打电话。

candidates.english: If it rains, we will stay inside.
candidates.chinese: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。

candidates.english: You can pass if you study hard.
candidates.chinese: 如果你努力学习，就能通过。

candidates.english: Imagine living on a small island.
candidates.chinese: 想象一下住在一个小岛上。

candidates.english: Imagine you are in a forest.
candidates.chinese: 想象你在森林里。

candidates.english: Can you imagine life without music?
candidates.chinese: 你能想象没有音乐的生活吗？

candidates.english: It is important to drink enough water.
candidates.chinese: 喝足够的水很重要。

candidates.english: Eating vegetables is important for your health.
candidates.chinese: 吃蔬菜对你的健康很重要。

candidates.english: Please remember this important rule.
candidates.chinese: 请记住这条重要的规则。

candidates.english: It is impossible to finish this in one minute.
candidates.chinese: 一分钟内完成这件事是不可能的。

candidates.english: It is impossible to lift that heavy box alone.
candidates.chinese: 一个人抬起那个重箱子是不可能的。

candidates.english: Finding a parking spot here is impossible.
candidates.chinese: 在这里找到停车位是不可能的。

candidates.english: Daily practice will improve your English.
candidates.chinese: 每天练习会提高你的英语水平。

candidates.english: Reading more can improve your vocabulary.
candidates.chinese: 多读书能提高你的词汇量。

candidates.english: She wants to improve her cooking skills.
candidates.chinese: 她想提高她的烹饪技巧。

candidates.english: The keys are in my bag.
candidates.chinese: 钥匙在我的包里。

candidates.english: The pencil is in the pencil case.
candidates.chinese: 铅笔在铅笔盒里。

candidates.english: There is a bird in the tree.
candidates.chinese: 树上有一只鸟。

candidates.english: The price includes breakfast and lunch.
candidates.chinese: 这个价格包括早餐和午餐。

candidates.english: The tour includes a visit to the museum.
candidates.chinese: 这次旅行包括参观博物馆。

candidates.english: Does the menu include any vegetarian dishes?
candidates.chinese: 菜单上有素菜吗？

candidates.english: The number of visitors increased last year.
candidates.chinese: 去年游客人数增加了。

candidates.english: The price of fruit increased this month.
candidates.chinese: 这个月水果价格上涨了。

candidates.english: Exercise can increase your energy.
candidates.chinese: 锻炼能增加你的精力。

candidates.english: Friends can influence the choices we make.
candidates.chinese: 朋友会影响我们所做的选择。

candidates.english: Music can influence your mood.
candidates.chinese: 音乐能影响你的情绪。

candidates.english: Her advice influenced my decision.
candidates.chinese: 她的建议影响了我的决定。

candidates.english: It was raining, so we stayed home instead.
candidates.chinese: 下雨了，所以我们改为待在家里。

candidates.english: I had tea instead of coffee.
candidates.chinese: 我喝了茶，而不是咖啡。

candidates.english: He walked to work instead of driving.
candidates.chinese: 他步行上班，而不是开车。

candidates.english: He has a strong interest in science.
candidates.chinese: 他对科学有浓厚的兴趣。

candidates.english: She shows great interest in drawing.
candidates.chinese: 她对绘画表现出极大的兴趣。

candidates.english: His main interest is playing basketball.
candidates.chinese: 他的主要兴趣是打篮球。

candidates.english: The museum has an interesting robot show.
candidates.chinese: 这家博物馆有一场有趣的机器人展览。

candidates.english: We watched an interesting documentary about animals.
candidates.chinese: 我们看了一部关于动物的有趣纪录片。

candidates.english: The story is interesting and easy to read.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事有趣且易读。

candidates.english: The swimmer jumped into the pool after the coach's signal.
candidates.chinese: 游泳者听到教练的信号后跳进了泳池。

candidates.english: She walked into the classroom quietly.
candidates.chinese: 她悄悄地走进教室。

candidates.english: The cat ran into the garden.
candidates.chinese: 猫跑进了花园。

candidates.english: Let me introduce my new classmate.
candidates.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的新同学。

candidates.english: Let me introduce our new teacher to you.
candidates.chinese: 让我向你介绍我们的新老师。

candidates.english: He introduced his friend to his parents.
candidates.chinese: 他把朋友介绍给他的父母。

candidates.english: She wants to invent a useful machine.
candidates.chinese: 她想发明一台有用的机器。

candidates.english: The Chinese invented paper long ago.
candidates.chinese: 中国人很久以前发明了纸。

candidates.english: Who invented the telephone?
candidates.chinese: 谁发明了电话？

candidates.english: I invited Amy to my birthday party.
candidates.chinese: 我邀请艾米参加我的生日聚会。

candidates.english: We invited our neighbors to dinner.
candidates.chinese: 我们邀请邻居来吃晚饭。

candidates.english: She invited me to her art show.
candidates.chinese: 她邀请我去她的艺术展。

candidates.english: Her job is to care for sick animals.
candidates.chinese: 她的工作是照顾生病的动物。

candidates.english: He found a job at the library.
candidates.chinese: 他在图书馆找到了一份工作。

candidates.english: My job is to answer phone calls.
candidates.chinese: 我的工作是接电话。

candidates.english: Would you like to join our reading club?
candidates.chinese: 你愿意加入我们的读书俱乐部吗？

candidates.english: I want to join the school band.
candidates.chinese: 我想加入学校乐队。

candidates.english: She joined the chess club last week.
candidates.chinese: 她上周加入了国际象棋俱乐部。

candidates.english: The dog jumped over the small wall.
candidates.chinese: 那只狗跳过了矮墙。

candidates.english: The children like to jump on the bed.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们喜欢在床上跳。

candidates.english: He jumped over the puddle.
candidates.chinese: 他跳过了水坑。

candidates.english: I just need five more minutes.
candidates.chinese: 我只需要再多五分钟。

candidates.english: I'm just looking, thank you.
candidates.chinese: 我只是看看，谢谢。

candidates.english: It's just a small problem.
candidates.chinese: 这只是个小问题。

candidates.english: Keep the milk cold in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 把牛奶放在冰箱里冷藏。

candidates.english: Please keep quiet in the library.
candidates.chinese: 请在图书馆保持安静。

candidates.english: She keeps her room tidy every day.
candidates.chinese: 她每天保持房间整洁。

candidates.english: It was kind of you to help me.
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我，真是太友善了。

candidates.english: She is kind to everyone she meets.
candidates.chinese: 她对遇到的每个人都很友善。

candidates.english: The kind teacher helped the new student.
candidates.chinese: 那位友善的老师帮助了新学生。

candidates.english: Do you know the answer to this question?
candidates.chinese: 你知道这道题的答案吗？

candidates.english: I know how to ride a bike.
candidates.chinese: 我知道怎么骑自行车。

candidates.english: She knows the way to the station.
candidates.chinese: 她知道去车站的路。

candidates.english: After weeks at sea, they finally saw land.
candidates.chinese: 在海上数周后，他们终于看到了陆地。

candidates.english: The ship reached land after a long voyage.
candidates.chinese: 经过长途航行，船到达了陆地。

candidates.english: Birds live on land and in the sky.
candidates.chinese: 鸟生活在陆地上和天空中。

candidates.chinese: 一大群人在体育场外等候。

candidates.english: They live in a large house with a garden.
candidates.chinese: 他们住在一栋带花园的大房子里。

candidates.english: The large pizza is enough for everyone.
candidates.chinese: 这个大披萨够大家吃了。

candidates.english: We caught the last bus home.
candidates.chinese: 我们赶上了回家的末班车。

candidates.english: December is the last month of the year.
candidates.chinese: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

candidates.english: He took the last piece of cake.
candidates.chinese: 他拿了最后一块蛋糕。

candidates.english: Tom was late for school this morning.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆今天早上上学迟到了。

candidates.english: She was late for the meeting by five minutes.
candidates.chinese: 她开会迟到了五分钟。

candidates.english: Don't be late for dinner tonight.
candidates.chinese: 今晚吃饭不要迟到。

candidates.english: I will call you later this evening.
candidates.chinese: 今晚晚些时候我会给你打电话。

candidates.english: We can discuss it later after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我们可以午饭后再讨论这件事。

candidates.english: I'll finish my homework later.
candidates.chinese: 我稍后会完成作业。

candidates.english: The funny story made everyone laugh.
candidates.chinese: 这个有趣的故事把大家都逗笑了。

candidates.english: The joke made the children laugh.
candidates.chinese: 这个笑话让孩子们笑了。

candidates.english: She laughs when she sees the puppy.
candidates.chinese: 她看到小狗时笑了。

candidates.english: Mia will lead the team in the final game.
candidates.chinese: 米娅将在决赛中带领队伍。

candidates.english: The guide will lead us through the forest.
candidates.chinese: 向导将带领我们穿过森林。

candidates.english: He leads the class in the school parade.
candidates.chinese: 他在学校游行中带领班级。

candidates.english: A yellow leaf fell onto my book.
candidates.chinese: 一片黄叶落在了我的书上。

candidates.english: Each leaf on the tree turns red in autumn.
candidates.chinese: 秋天，树上的每片叶子都变红了。

candidates.english: A dry leaf landed beside the path.
candidates.chinese: 一片干叶落在了小路旁。

candidates.english: We learn something new every day.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天都学习新东西。

candidates.english: I want to learn how to swim.
candidates.chinese: 我想学习游泳。

candidates.english: She learns English by watching movies.
candidates.chinese: 她通过看电影学习英语。

candidates.english: This task takes the least time.
candidates.chinese: 这项任务需要的时间最少。

candidates.english: This shelf has the least space for books.
candidates.chinese: 这个书架放书的空间最少。

candidates.english: This bag has the least rice.
candidates.chinese: 这个袋子里的米最少。

candidates.english: We should leave before it gets dark.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该在天黑前离开。

candidates.english: The train leaves at nine in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 火车早上九点离开。

candidates.english: Please leave the room quietly.
candidates.chinese: 请安静地离开房间。

candidates.english: Try to use less water when you wash your hands.
candidates.chinese: 洗手时尽量少用水。

candidates.english: I drink less coffee at night.
candidates.chinese: 我晚上喝较少的咖啡。

candidates.english: She has less homework today.
candidates.chinese: 她今天的作业较少。

candidates.english: Our first lesson starts at eight.
candidates.chinese: 我们的第一节课八点开始。

candidates.english: The math lesson is very interesting.
candidates.chinese: 数学课非常有趣。

candidates.english: We have a music lesson on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 我们周五有音乐课。

candidates.english: Lie down and rest for a while.
candidates.chinese: 躺下来休息一会儿。

candidates.english: The cat lies on the sofa all day.
candidates.chinese: 猫整天躺在沙发上。

candidates.english: He lay on the grass and looked at the sky.
candidates.chinese: 他躺在草地上看天空。

candidates.english: Reading is an important part of my life.
candidates.chinese: 阅读是我生活中重要的一部分。

candidates.english: City life is busy but exciting.
candidates.chinese: 城市生活忙碌但令人兴奋。

candidates.english: She enjoys a simple life in the countryside.
candidates.chinese: 她喜欢乡村的简单生活。

candidates.english: The morning light came through the window.
candidates.chinese: 晨光透过窗户照了进来。

candidates.english: The light from the lamp is bright.
candidates.chinese: 台灯的光很亮。

candidates.english: The light from the moon is soft.
candidates.chinese: 月光很柔和。

candidates.english: I like this story because it is funny.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢这个故事，因为它很有趣。

candidates.english: I like apples very much.
candidates.chinese: 我非常喜欢苹果。

candidates.english: She likes reading books on weekends.
candidates.chinese: 她喜欢在周末读书。

candidates.english: Please listen carefully to the question.
candidates.chinese: 请认真听这个问题。

candidates.english: Listen to the teacher in class.
candidates.chinese: 上课时听老师讲。

candidates.english: He listens to music every day.
candidates.chinese: 他每天听音乐。

candidates.english: A little bird is sitting by the window.
candidates.chinese: 一只小鸟正停在窗边。

candidates.english: The little dog is very cute.
candidates.chinese: 这只小狗很可爱。

candidates.english: She has a little sister.
candidates.chinese: 她有一个小妹妹。

candidates.english: My grandparents live in a quiet village.
candidates.chinese: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的村庄。

candidates.english: They live in a big city.
candidates.chinese: 他们住在大城市。

candidates.english: I live near the school.
candidates.chinese: 我住在学校附近。

candidates.english: Ben felt lonely after moving to a new town.
candidates.chinese: 搬到新城镇后，本感到很孤独。

candidates.english: She felt lonely on her first day at camp.
candidates.chinese: 在营地的第一天，她感到很孤独。

candidates.english: She felt lonely without her friends.
candidates.chinese: 没有朋友在身边，她感到孤独。

candidates.english: We walked along a long country road.
candidates.chinese: 我们沿着一条长长的乡间小路走。

candidates.english: The snake is very long.
candidates.chinese: 这条蛇很长。

candidates.english: He has long hair.
candidates.chinese: 他留着长发。

candidates.english: Look at the map before we set off.
candidates.chinese: 出发前看一下地图。

candidates.english: Look at the blackboard, please.
candidates.chinese: 请看黑板。

candidates.english: She looked at the clock and left.
candidates.chinese: 她看了看钟，然后离开了。

candidates.english: Be careful not to lose your ticket.
candidates.chinese: 小心别把票弄丢了。

candidates.english: Don't lose your keys again.
candidates.chinese: 别再丢钥匙了。

candidates.english: He lost his wallet on the bus.
candidates.chinese: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。

candidates.english: The music is too loud for the baby.
candidates.chinese: 这音乐对婴儿来说太响了。

candidates.english: The loud noise woke me up.
candidates.chinese: 巨大的噪音把我吵醒了。

candidates.english: Please speak in a loud voice.
candidates.chinese: 请大声说话。

candidates.english: We love spending time in the school garden.
candidates.chinese: 我们喜欢在学校花园里度过时光。

candidates.english: I love my family.
candidates.chinese: 我爱我的家人。

candidates.english: She loves painting pictures.
candidates.chinese: 她喜欢画画。

candidates.english: With a little luck, we will catch the early bus.
candidates.chinese: 运气好的话，我们能赶上早班车。

candidates.english: Good luck with your exam.
candidates.chinese: 祝你考试好运。

candidates.english: He had bad luck today.
candidates.chinese: 他今天运气不好。

candidates.english: Let us make a card for our teacher.
candidates.chinese: 让我们为老师制作一张卡片。

candidates.english: She makes a cake for her mother.
candidates.chinese: 她为妈妈做了一个蛋糕。

candidates.english: We made a paper boat in class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在课堂上做了一艘纸船。

candidates.english: She managed to finish the race.
candidates.chinese: 她设法完成了比赛。

candidates.english: He managed to open the door.
candidates.chinese: 他设法打开了门。

candidates.english: They managed to catch the train.
candidates.chinese: 他们设法赶上了火车。

candidates.english: Many students joined the reading club.
candidates.chinese: 许多学生加入了阅读社团。

candidates.english: There are many books on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 书架上有许多书。

candidates.chinese: 许多人喜欢旅游。

candidates.chinese: 我们队赢得了足球比赛。

candidates.chinese: 篮球比赛五点开始。

candidates.chinese: 我们在电视上看了一场网球比赛。

candidates.chinese: 这个标志是什么意思？

candidates.chinese: 这个单词是什么意思？

candidates.chinese: 红灯意味着停止。

candidates.chinese: 你能解释这个单词的意思吗？

candidates.chinese: 我不知道这个句子的意思。

candidates.chinese: 这个标志的意思很清楚。

candidates.chinese: 我们四点在图书馆外见面吧。

candidates.english: We can meet at the bus stop after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后我们可以在公交车站见面。

candidates.english: Let's meet for lunch on Sunday.
candidates.chinese: 我们周日见面吃午饭吧。

candidates.chinese: 你介意把窗户打开吗？

candidates.english: Would you mind closing the door?
candidates.chinese: 你介意把门关上吗？

candidates.english: I don't mind waiting for you.
candidates.chinese: 我不介意等你。

candidates.chinese: 火车将在一分钟后到达。

candidates.english: The meeting starts in five minutes.
candidates.chinese: 会议五分钟后开始。

candidates.english: Please wait a minute for me.
candidates.chinese: 请等我一会儿。

candidates.english: I miss my old classmates very much.
candidates.chinese: 我非常想念以前的同学。

candidates.english: She misses her hometown very much.
candidates.chinese: 她非常想念她的家乡。

candidates.english: I will miss you when you leave.
candidates.chinese: 你离开时我会想念你的。

candidates.chinese: 犯一次错误没关系。

candidates.chinese: 我在作业里发现了一个错误。

candidates.english: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes.
candidates.chinese: 每个人有时都会犯错。

candidates.english: I saved some money to buy the book.
candidates.chinese: 我存了一些钱来买这本书。

candidates.english: He needs money for the bus fare.
candidates.chinese: 他需要钱付公交车费。

candidates.english: She put her money in a safe place.
candidates.chinese: 她把钱放在安全的地方。

candidates.chinese: 我们开会需要更多椅子。

candidates.english: Please give me more time to finish.
candidates.chinese: 请给我更多时间完成。

candidates.chinese: 我们旅行需要更多的水。

candidates.chinese: 大多数孩子喜欢这场科学表演。

candidates.english: Most students like the new library.
candidates.chinese: 大多数学生喜欢新图书馆。

candidates.english: Most of the food was delicious.
candidates.chinese: 大多数食物都很美味。

candidates.chinese: 请把箱子从门边移开。

candidates.chinese: 你能把椅子移近一点吗？

candidates.chinese: 这辆玩具车移动得很快。

candidates.chinese: 我们剩下的时间不多了。

candidates.chinese: 这杯茶里糖太多了。

candidates.chinese: 我今天作业不多。

candidates.chinese: 请把你的名字写在上方。

candidates.chinese: 你叫什么名字？

candidates.chinese: 她的名字在名单上。

candidates.chinese: 我们应该学会尊重自然。

candidates.english: We should protect nature for our future.
candidates.chinese: 为了我们的未来，我们应该保护自然。

candidates.english: The children love to explore nature.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们喜欢探索自然。

candidates.english: There is a small park near my home.
candidates.chinese: 我家附近有一个小公园。

candidates.english: The school is near the park.
candidates.chinese: 学校在公园附近。

candidates.english: We live near the station.
candidates.chinese: 我们住在车站附近。

candidates.english: Daily exercise is necessary for good health.
candidates.chinese: 每天锻炼对健康是必要的。

candidates.english: Water is necessary for life.
candidates.chinese: 水是生命所必需的。

candidates.chinese: 系安全带是必要的。

candidates.chinese: 你今天需要一件暖和的外套。

candidates.english: Plants need sunlight to grow.
candidates.chinese: 植物需要阳光才能生长。

candidates.chinese: 我考试需要一支铅笔。

candidates.chinese: 两个答案都不正确。

candidates.chinese: 这两本书都没有意思。

candidates.english: Neither answer is right.
candidates.chinese: 两个答案都不对。

candidates.english: I felt nervous before speaking on stage.
candidates.chinese: 上台发言前我感到紧张。

candidates.chinese: 考试前她会紧张。

candidates.chinese: 他对面试感到紧张。

candidates.chinese: 我的爷爷从不浪费食物。

candidates.chinese: 我周末从不吃早餐。

candidates.chinese: 她从不撒谎。

candidates.chinese: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

candidates.chinese: 我今天没有时间玩。

candidates.english: There are no apples in the basket.
candidates.chinese: 篮子里没有苹果。

candidates.chinese: 外面的噪声让我无法入睡。

candidates.english: The noise from the street is very loud.
candidates.chinese: 街上的噪声很大。

candidates.chinese: 请在图书馆里少制造噪声。

candidates.chinese: 这个包不重。

candidates.chinese: 她现在不在家。

candidates.chinese: 我不喜欢寒冷的天气。

candidates.chinese: 我写了一则关于实验的简短笔记。

candidates.chinese: 他在科学课上做了笔记。

candidates.english: My notebook is full of notes.
candidates.chinese: 我的笔记本上写满了笔记。

candidates.english: There is nothing in the empty box.
candidates.chinese: 这个空盒子里什么也没有。

candidates.english: I have nothing to say about that.
candidates.chinese: 关于那件事我没有什么要说的。

candidates.english: There is nothing wrong with your bike.
candidates.chinese: 你的自行车没有什么问题。

candidates.english: Did you notice the new sign by the gate?
candidates.chinese: 你注意到门边的新标志了吗？

candidates.english: I noticed a small mistake in the report.
candidates.chinese: 我注意到报告里有一个小错误。

candidates.english: She noticed the door was open.
candidates.chinese: 她注意到门开着。

candidates.english: Write your phone number on this card.
candidates.chinese: 把你的电话号码写在这张卡片上。

candidates.english: What is your house number?
candidates.chinese: 你的门牌号码是多少？

candidates.english: Please call this number for help.
candidates.chinese: 请拨打这个号码求助。

candidates.english: This is a photo of our class.
candidates.chinese: 这是我们班的一张照片。

candidates.english: The color of the sky is blue.
candidates.chinese: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。

candidates.english: The name of the movie is interesting.
candidates.chinese: 这部电影的名字很有趣。

candidates.english: The bird flew off when we came near.
candidates.chinese: 我们靠近时，那只鸟飞走了。

candidates.english: The bus drove off before I arrived.
candidates.chinese: 我到达之前，公交车开走了。

candidates.english: He walked off without saying goodbye.
candidates.chinese: 他没有说再见就走开了。

candidates.english: Mia offered to carry the heavy bag.
candidates.chinese: 米娅主动提出帮忙拿这个重包。

candidates.english: Tom offered to help me with my homework.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆主动提出帮我做作业。

candidates.english: She offered to water the plants.
candidates.chinese: 她主动提出给植物浇水。

candidates.english: We often ride our bikes after school.
candidates.chinese: 我们放学后经常骑自行车。

candidates.english: I often read books before bed.
candidates.chinese: 我经常在睡前看书。

candidates.english: They often play basketball on weekends.
candidates.chinese: 他们周末经常打篮球。

candidates.english: Dad repaired the old wooden chair.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸修好了那把旧木椅。

candidates.english: She wears an old coat in winter.
candidates.chinese: 她冬天穿一件旧外套。

candidates.english: The old shoes are still comfortable.
candidates.chinese: 这双旧鞋仍然很舒服。

candidates.english: Your keys are on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 你的钥匙在厨房桌子上。

candidates.english: The book is on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 书在架子上。

candidates.english: There is a map on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 墙上有一张地图。

candidates.english: I visit the museum once a month.
candidates.chinese: 我每月参观一次博物馆。

candidates.english: I brush my teeth once a day.
candidates.chinese: 我每天刷一次牙。

candidates.english: He goes swimming once a week.
candidates.chinese: 他每周去游泳一次。

candidates.english: I only need five minutes.
candidates.chinese: 我只需要五分钟。

candidates.english: I only have one brother.
candidates.chinese: 我只有一个兄弟。

candidates.english: She only eats vegetables for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚餐只吃蔬菜。

candidates.english: Please open the window for some fresh air.
candidates.chinese: 请打开窗户透透气。

candidates.english: Can you open the door for me?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我打开门吗？

candidates.english: He opened the box carefully.
candidates.chinese: 他小心地打开了盒子。

candidates.english: In my opinion, the second plan is better.
candidates.chinese: 在我看来，第二个计划更好。

candidates.english: What is your opinion about the plan?
candidates.chinese: 你对这个计划有什么看法？

candidates.english: In my opinion, this book is very useful.
candidates.chinese: 在我看来，这本书非常有用。

candidates.english: Would you like tea or juice?
candidates.chinese: 你想喝茶还是果汁？

candidates.english: Do you want coffee or milk?
candidates.chinese: 你想要咖啡还是牛奶？

candidates.english: You can take the bus or walk to school.
candidates.chinese: 你可以坐公交车或者步行去学校。

candidates.english: Put the pictures in the correct order.
candidates.chinese: 把这些图片按正确顺序排列。

candidates.english: Please arrange the books in alphabetical order.
candidates.chinese: 请按字母顺序排列这些书。

candidates.english: The names are listed in order of age.
candidates.chinese: 这些名字按年龄顺序列出。

candidates.english: Some students read while others drew.
candidates.chinese: 一些学生阅读，另一些学生画画。

candidates.english: I like this shirt, but the other one is cheaper.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢这件衬衫，但另一件更便宜。

candidates.english: Some people walk to work; others take the bus.
candidates.chinese: 有些人步行上班，其他人乘公交车。

candidates.english: The children are out in the garden.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在外面的花园里。

candidates.english: He left his shoes out in the rain.
candidates.chinese: 他把鞋子放在外面淋雨了。

candidates.english: The cat is out on the roof again.
candidates.chinese: 那只猫又跑到外面的屋顶上了。

candidates.english: The bridge over the river is very old.
candidates.chinese: 河上的那座桥很古老。

candidates.english: A bird flew over our heads.
candidates.chinese: 一只鸟从我们头顶飞过。

candidates.english: There is a sign over the door.
candidates.chinese: 门上方有一个标志。

candidates.english: Lily grows vegetables in her own garden.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉在自己的花园里种蔬菜。

candidates.english: She made the cake with her own hands.
candidates.chinese: 她亲手做了这个蛋糕。

candidates.english: Each student has his own desk.
candidates.chinese: 每个学生都有自己的课桌。

candidates.english: He felt a sharp pain in his knee.
candidates.chinese: 他感到膝盖一阵剧痛。

candidates.english: She felt a dull pain in her back.
candidates.chinese: 她感到背部隐隐作痛。

candidates.english: The pain in his tooth kept him awake.
candidates.chinese: 牙痛让他无法入睡。

candidates.english: We will paint a picture of the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们要画一幅湖景图。

candidates.english: My sister likes to paint flowers.
candidates.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢画花。

candidates.english: They painted a mural on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 他们在墙上画了一幅壁画。

candidates.english: This is the most difficult part of the task.
candidates.chinese: 这是任务中最难的部分。

candidates.english: The first part of the movie is boring.
candidates.chinese: 电影的第一部分很无聊。

candidates.english: A part of the roof was damaged.
candidates.chinese: 屋顶的一部分受损了。

candidates.english: She studied hard and passed the test.
candidates.chinese: 她努力学习并通过了考试。

candidates.english: He passed the driving test yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 他昨天通过了驾驶考试。

candidates.english: If you study, you will pass the exam.
candidates.chinese: 如果你学习，你就会通过考试。

candidates.english: Our teacher is patient with every student.
candidates.chinese: 我们的老师对每位学生都很有耐心。

candidates.english: Be patient with the little kids.
candidates.chinese: 对小孩子要有耐心。

candidates.english: The doctor is patient with his patients.
candidates.chinese: 这位医生对他的病人很有耐心。

candidates.english: You can pay for the book at the desk.
candidates.chinese: 你可以在服务台支付书款。

candidates.english: I need to pay the electricity bill.
candidates.chinese: 我需要支付电费。

candidates.english: He paid fifty yuan for the ticket.
candidates.chinese: 他付了五十元买这张票。

candidates.english: People around the world hope for peace.
candidates.chinese: 世界各地的人们都期盼和平。

candidates.english: The class made a peace poster.
candidates.chinese: 全班制作了一张和平主题海报。

candidates.english: We all want peace in the world.
candidates.chinese: 我们都希望世界和平。

candidates.english: The weather was perfect for a picnic.
candidates.chinese: 这天气非常适合野餐。

candidates.english: Her English pronunciation is perfect.
candidates.chinese: 她的英语发音很完美。

candidates.english: The drawing looks perfect to me.
candidates.chinese: 这幅画在我看来很完美。

candidates.english: The person at the door is our new coach.
candidates.chinese: 门口的那个人是我们的新教练。

candidates.english: The person in the blue shirt is my uncle.
candidates.chinese: 穿蓝衬衫的那个人是我叔叔。

candidates.english: She is the kindest person I know.
candidates.chinese: 她是我认识的最善良的人。

candidates.english: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
candidates.chinese: 我们在老桥旁拍了一张照片。

candidates.english: I took a photo of the sunset.
candidates.chinese: 我拍了一张日落的照片。

candidates.english: This photo was taken in Beijing.
candidates.chinese: 这张照片是在北京拍的。

candidates.english: You may pick one book to take home.
candidates.chinese: 你可以挑选一本书带回家。

candidates.english: Please pick a card from the deck.
candidates.chinese: 请从牌堆里挑选一张牌。

candidates.english: She picked the red dress for the party.
candidates.chinese: 她为聚会挑选了红色连衣裙。

candidates.english: The picture shows a busy market.
candidates.chinese: 这张图片展示了一个热闹的市场。

candidates.english: The picture on page five shows a map.
candidates.chinese: 第五页的图片显示了一张地图。

candidates.english: He drew a picture of his family.
candidates.chinese: 他画了一幅他家人的图画。

candidates.english: May I have a piece of bread?
candidates.chinese: 我可以吃一块面包吗？

candidates.english: She cut the cake into eight pieces.
candidates.chinese: 她把蛋糕切成了八块。

candidates.english: He gave me a piece of cheese.
candidates.chinese: 他给了我一块奶酪。

candidates.english: It is a pity that the park is closed.
candidates.chinese: 公园关闭了，真遗憾。

candidates.english: What a pity you missed the concert.
candidates.chinese: 你错过了音乐会，真遗憾。

candidates.english: It's a pity the shop is closed today.
candidates.chinese: 今天商店关门了，真遗憾。

candidates.english: This quiet place is good for reading.
candidates.chinese: 这个安静的地方适合阅读。

candidates.english: This is a nice place for a picnic.
candidates.chinese: 这是个野餐的好地方。

candidates.english: Find a safe place to park your bike.
candidates.chinese: 找个安全的地方停自行车。

candidates.english: We made a plan for the school trip.
candidates.chinese: 我们为学校旅行制订了计划。

candidates.english: Our plan is to visit the museum tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们的计划是明天参观博物馆。

candidates.english: She shared her study plan with me.
candidates.chinese: 她和我分享了她的学习计划。

candidates.english: This plant needs water and sunlight.
candidates.chinese: 这株植物需要水和阳光。

candidates.english: This plant grows well in shade.
candidates.chinese: 这种植物在阴凉处长得好。

candidates.english: Water the plant every morning.
candidates.chinese: 每天早上给这株植物浇水。

candidates.english: The children play together after class.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们课后一起玩。

candidates.english: Let's play chess after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们下棋吧。

candidates.english: The kids play in the park on weekends.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们周末在公园里玩。

candidates.english: Please wait for me by the school gate.
candidates.chinese: 请在校门口等我。

candidates.english: Please close the window.
candidates.chinese: 请关上窗户。

candidates.english: Please pass me the salt.
candidates.chinese: 请把盐递给我。

candidates.english: It was a pleasure to work with your team.
candidates.chinese: 与你们团队合作很愉快。

candidates.english: It gives me great pleasure to help you.
candidates.chinese: 能帮助你让我感到非常愉快。

candidates.english: Reading gives me great pleasure.
candidates.chinese: 阅读让我感到非常愉快。

candidates.english: Please remember the main point of the story.
candidates.chinese: 请记住这个故事的要点。

candidates.english: The main point is to save water.
candidates.chinese: 要点是节约用水。

candidates.english: The first point in her speech was clear.
candidates.chinese: 她演讲中的第一个要点很清楚。

candidates.english: It is polite to say thank you.
candidates.chinese: 说谢谢是有礼貌的。

candidates.english: Be polite to the elderly.
candidates.chinese: 对老人要有礼貌。

candidates.english: She is always polite to her classmates.
candidates.chinese: 她对同学总是很有礼貌。

candidates.english: Plastic waste can pollute the sea.
candidates.chinese: 塑料垃圾会污染海洋。

candidates.english: Factories should not pollute the river.
candidates.chinese: 工厂不应污染河流。

candidates.english: Don't pollute the air with smoke.
candidates.chinese: 不要用烟雾污染空气。

candidates.english: The project helps poor families find safe housing.
candidates.chinese: 这个项目帮助贫困家庭获得安全的住所。

candidates.english: They live in a poor village.
candidates.chinese: 他们住在一个贫穷的村庄。

candidates.english: In the story, a poor farmer finds a bag of seeds.
candidates.chinese: 在故事中，一位贫穷的农民发现了一袋种子。

candidates.english: Basketball is popular at our school.
candidates.chinese: 篮球在我们学校很受欢迎。

candidates.english: This song is popular among young people.
candidates.chinese: 这首歌在年轻人中很受欢迎。

candidates.english: She is popular because she is kind.
candidates.chinese: 她因为善良而受欢迎。

candidates.english: Is it possible to finish this today?
candidates.chinese: 今天有可能完成这件事吗？

candidates.english: It is possible to learn English well.
candidates.chinese: 学好英语是可能的。

candidates.english: Is it possible to meet tomorrow?
candidates.chinese: 明天有可能见面吗？

candidates.english: Daily practice will improve your writing.
candidates.chinese: 每天练习会提高你的写作水平。

candidates.english: Practice makes perfect.
candidates.chinese: 熟能生巧。

candidates.english: You need more practice in math.
candidates.chinese: 你需要更多的数学练习。

candidates.english: The teacher praised Amy for helping others.
candidates.chinese: 老师因艾米帮助他人而表扬了她。

candidates.english: The coach praised the players for their effort.
candidates.chinese: 教练因队员们的努力表扬了他们。

candidates.english: Her teacher praised her for the good essay.
candidates.chinese: 她的老师表扬她作文写得好。

candidates.english: I prefer walking to taking the bus.
candidates.chinese: 比起坐公交车，我更喜欢步行。

candidates.english: I prefer tea to coffee.
candidates.chinese: 比起咖啡，我更喜欢茶。

candidates.english: She prefers reading to watching TV.
candidates.chinese: 比起看电视，她更喜欢阅读。

candidates.english: We need to prepare food for the trip.
candidates.chinese: 我们需要为旅行准备食物。

candidates.english: We must prepare for the exam.
candidates.chinese: 我们必须为考试做准备。

candidates.english: Mom is preparing dinner in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈正在厨房准备晚餐。

candidates.english: I made a birthday present for Mum.
candidates.chinese: 我为妈妈做了一份生日礼物。

candidates.english: He gave me a present for my birthday.
candidates.chinese: 他送了我一份生日礼物。

candidates.english: She opened the present with a smile.
candidates.chinese: 她微笑着打开了礼物。

candidates.english: She takes pride in her careful work.
candidates.chinese: 她为自己认真完成的工作感到自豪。

candidates.english: He looked at his drawing with pride.
candidates.chinese: 他自豪地看着自己的画。

candidates.english: Winning the game filled the team with pride.
candidates.chinese: 赢得比赛让全队充满自豪。

candidates.english: We worked together to solve the problem.
candidates.chinese: 我们一起解决了这个问题。

candidates.english: The math problem was hard but fun.
candidates.chinese: 这道数学题很难但很有趣。

candidates.english: She found a problem in the plan.
candidates.chinese: 她发现了计划中的一个问题。

candidates.english: This farm produces fresh milk every day.
candidates.chinese: 这个农场每天生产鲜奶。

candidates.english: The factory produces car parts.
candidates.chinese: 这家工厂生产汽车零件。

candidates.english: This small company produces school bags.
candidates.chinese: 这家小公司生产书包。

candidates.english: I promise to return the book tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我保证明天归还这本书。

candidates.english: She made a promise to help me.
candidates.chinese: 她承诺帮助我。

candidates.english: He kept his promise to call me.
candidates.chinese: 他遵守了给我打电话的承诺。

candidates.english: Wear proper shoes for the mountain walk.
candidates.chinese: 登山时要穿合适的鞋。

candidates.english: Use proper tools for the job.
candidates.chinese: 做这项工作要使用合适的工具。

candidates.english: She wore proper clothes for cold weather.
candidates.chinese: 她穿了适合寒冷天气的衣服。

candidates.english: Trees help protect the soil from heavy rain.
candidates.chinese: 树木有助于保护土壤免受暴雨侵蚀。

candidates.english: Wear a hat to protect your head.
candidates.chinese: 戴帽子保护你的头。

candidates.english: This cover protects the book from rain.
candidates.chinese: 这个封面保护书不被雨水淋湿。

candidates.english: My parents are proud of my progress.
candidates.chinese: 我的父母为我的进步感到自豪。

candidates.english: She was proud of her clean room.
candidates.chinese: 她为自己干净的房间感到自豪。

candidates.english: He felt proud when he finished the race.
candidates.chinese: 完成比赛时他感到自豪。

candidates.english: The hotel provides free breakfast for guests.
candidates.chinese: 这家酒店为客人提供免费早餐。

candidates.english: The school provides lunch for students.
candidates.chinese: 学校为学生提供午餐。

candidates.english: Can you provide more information?
candidates.chinese: 你能提供更多信息吗？

candidates.english: This public library is open every day.
candidates.chinese: 这家公共图书馆每天开放。

candidates.english: The public park is near my home.
candidates.chinese: 公共公园在我家附近。

candidates.english: We took a public bus to the museum.
candidates.chinese: 我们乘坐公共汽车去博物馆。

candidates.english: Pull the door gently to open it.
candidates.chinese: 轻轻拉门把它打开。

candidates.english: Pull the rope to ring the bell.
candidates.chinese: 拉绳子敲钟。

candidates.english: She pulled the drawer open.
candidates.chinese: 她拉开抽屉。

candidates.english: The coach did not punish him for the mistake.
candidates.chinese: 教练没有因为这个错误惩罚他。

candidates.english: The teacher will punish late students.
candidates.chinese: 老师会惩罚迟到的学生。

candidates.english: Don't punish the dog for barking.
candidates.chinese: 不要因为狗叫就惩罚它。

candidates.english: Push the box closer to the wall.
candidates.chinese: 把箱子推近墙边。

candidates.english: Push the chair under the desk.
candidates.chinese: 把椅子推进书桌下面。

candidates.english: He pushed the swing gently.
candidates.chinese: 他轻轻推秋千。

candidates.english: Put your books back on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 把你的书放回书架上。

candidates.english: Put the milk in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 把牛奶放进冰箱。

candidates.english: She put her keys on the table.
candidates.chinese: 她把钥匙放在桌子上。

candidates.english: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 开会前我们匆匆吃了顿午饭。

candidates.english: He took a quick shower.
candidates.chinese: 他快速冲了个澡。

candidates.english: The quick fox ran across the road.
candidates.chinese: 那只敏捷的狐狸跑过了马路。

candidates.english: Please keep quiet in the reading room.
candidates.chinese: 请在阅览室保持安静。

candidates.english: The library is a quiet place.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆是个安静的地方。

candidates.english: She spoke in a quiet voice.
candidates.chinese: 她轻声说话。

candidates.english: The rain stopped just before noon.
candidates.chinese: 雨在中午前刚好停了。

candidates.english: The rain made the streets wet.
candidates.chinese: 雨把街道弄湿了。

candidates.english: We stayed inside because of the rain.
candidates.chinese: 因为下雨我们待在室内。

candidates.english: Please raise your hand before answering.
candidates.chinese: 回答前请举手。

candidates.english: Raise the flag at sunrise.
candidates.chinese: 日出时升起旗帜。

candidates.english: He raised the box above his head.
