candidates.chinese: 下一步是混合原料。

candidates.english: Stick the label on the front of the box.
candidates.chinese: 把标签贴在箱子正面。

candidates.english: Please stick the poster on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 请把海报贴在墙上。

candidates.english: He stuck the stamp on the envelope.
candidates.chinese: 他把邮票贴在信封上。

candidates.english: The rain stopped before the game began.
candidates.chinese: 比赛开始前雨停了。

candidates.english: Please stop talking during the movie.
candidates.chinese: 电影期间请停止说话。

candidates.english: The bus stopped at the corner.
candidates.chinese: 公共汽车在拐角处停了下来。

candidates.english: I heard a strange noise in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 我听到厨房里有奇怪的声音。

candidates.english: There is a strange smell in the room.
candidates.chinese: 房间里有一股奇怪的气味。

candidates.english: He gave me a strange look.
candidates.chinese: 他用奇怪的眼神看了我一眼。

candidates.english: Our coach is strict about safety.
candidates.chinese: 我们的教练对安全要求很严格。

candidates.english: The teacher is strict about homework.
candidates.chinese: 老师对作业要求严格。

candidates.english: My parents are strict about bedtime.
candidates.chinese: 我父母对就寝时间要求严格。

candidates.english: Regular exercise makes your body strong.
candidates.chinese: 经常锻炼会让你的身体强壮。

candidates.english: He is strong enough to lift the box.
candidates.chinese: 他强壮得能举起那个箱子。

candidates.english: She has strong arms from swimming.
candidates.chinese: 游泳使她拥有强壮的手臂。

candidates.english: We study English every weekday.
candidates.chinese: 我们每个工作日都学习英语。

candidates.english: She studies hard for her exams.
candidates.chinese: 她为考试努力学习。

candidates.english: They studied together at the library.
candidates.chinese: 他们一起在图书馆学习。

candidates.english: Science is my favourite subject.
candidates.chinese: 科学是我最喜欢的学科。

candidates.english: Math is a difficult subject for me.
candidates.chinese: 数学对我来说是一门困难的学科。

candidates.english: We have six subjects this term.
candidates.chinese: 这学期我们有六门学科。

candidates.english: You can succeed if you keep trying.
candidates.chinese: 只要坚持尝试，你就能成功。

candidates.english: She worked hard and succeeded in passing the test.
candidates.chinese: 她努力学习，成功通过了考试。

candidates.english: He hopes to succeed in his new job.
candidates.chinese: 他希望在新工作中成功。

candidates.english: Hard work was the key to her success.
candidates.chinese: 努力是她成功的关键。

candidates.english: The team celebrated their success after the match.
candidates.chinese: 比赛后，团队庆祝了他们的成功。

candidates.english: His success in the exam made his parents proud.
candidates.chinese: 他考试的成功让父母感到骄傲。

candidates.english: I have never seen such a bright star.
candidates.chinese: 我从未见过这样明亮的星星。

candidates.english: Such a beautiful garden needs daily care.
candidates.chinese: 这样美丽的花园需要日常照料。

candidates.english: Such a quiet room is perfect for reading.
candidates.chinese: 这样安静的房间很适合阅读。

candidates.english: A sudden storm forced us to go home.
candidates.chinese: 一场突如其来的暴风雨迫使我们回家。

candidates.english: The sudden noise made the baby cry.
candidates.chinese: 突然的噪音把婴儿吓哭了。

candidates.english: She felt a sudden pain in her back.
candidates.chinese: 她感到背部一阵突然的疼痛。

candidates.english: I suggest taking the earlier train.
candidates.chinese: 我建议乘坐更早的一班火车。

candidates.english: The doctor suggests drinking more water.
candidates.chinese: 医生建议多喝水。

candidates.english: Can you suggest a good book for me?
candidates.chinese: 你能给我推荐一本好书吗？

candidates.english: My family supports my decision.
candidates.chinese: 我的家人支持我的决定。

candidates.english: We all support the new school rule.
candidates.chinese: 我们都支持新的校规。

candidates.english: Thank you for your support during the hard time.
candidates.chinese: 感谢你在困难时期的支持。

candidates.english: I am sure we took the correct road.
candidates.chinese: 我确信我们走的是正确的路。

candidates.english: Are you sure the meeting is at nine?
candidates.chinese: 你确定会议是九点吗？

candidates.english: She is sure that she locked the door.
candidates.chinese: 她确信自己锁了门。

candidates.english: The party was a lovely surprise for Dad.
candidates.chinese: 这场聚会给了爸爸一个美好的惊喜。

candidates.english: The gift was a complete surprise to me.
candidates.chinese: 这份礼物对我来说完全是个惊喜。

candidates.english: What a surprise to see you here!
candidates.chinese: 在这里见到你真是个惊喜！

candidates.english: We swim at the sports centre on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 我们每周日在体育中心游泳。

candidates.english: Can you swim across the pool?
candidates.chinese: 你能游过这个游泳池吗？

candidates.english: She swims every morning before school.
candidates.chinese: 她每天早上上学前游泳。

candidates.english: Please take an umbrella with you.
candidates.chinese: 请随身带一把伞。

candidates.english: Don't forget to take your keys.
candidates.chinese: 别忘了带钥匙。

candidates.english: He took a book from the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 他从书架上拿了一本书。

candidates.english: We talked about our plans after class.
candidates.chinese: 课后我们谈了各自的计划。

candidates.english: Let's talk about the weekend trip.
candidates.chinese: 让我们谈谈周末旅行的事。

candidates.english: They are talking quietly in the library.
candidates.chinese: 他们正在图书馆里轻声交谈。

candidates.english: The soup tastes better with some salt.
candidates.chinese: 这汤加点盐尝起来更好。

candidates.english: This cake tastes like chocolate.
candidates.chinese: 这蛋糕尝起来像巧克力。

candidates.english: The milk tastes sour; don't drink it.
candidates.chinese: 这牛奶尝起来酸了，别喝。

candidates.english: Mr Li teaches us how to grow vegetables.
candidates.chinese: 李老师教我们怎样种蔬菜。

candidates.english: My mother teaches me to cook rice.
candidates.chinese: 我妈妈教我煮饭。

candidates.english: Can you teach me to ride a bike?
candidates.chinese: 你能教我骑自行车吗？

candidates.english: Please tell me when you arrive.
candidates.chinese: 你到了以后请告诉我。

candidates.english: She told us the good news.
candidates.chinese: 她告诉了我们这个好消息。

candidates.english: Can you tell me the way to the station?
candidates.chinese: 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

candidates.english: This path is shorter than the other one.
candidates.chinese: 这条路比另一条路短。

candidates.english: My brother is taller than me.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥比我高。

candidates.english: This book is more interesting than that one.
candidates.chinese: 这本书比那本更有趣。

candidates.english: I thanked Maya for her kind help.
candidates.chinese: 我感谢玛雅的热心帮助。

candidates.english: Thank you for your lovely gift.
candidates.chinese: 谢谢你的精美礼物。

candidates.english: He thanked the driver for the ride.
candidates.chinese: 他感谢司机让他搭车。

candidates.english: I think this plan will work.
candidates.chinese: 我认为这个计划会奏效。

candidates.english: Do you think it will rain tomorrow?
candidates.chinese: 你认为明天会下雨吗？

candidates.english: She thinks the movie is too long.
candidates.chinese: 她认为这部电影太长了。

candidates.english: Though it was cold, we kept walking.
candidates.chinese: 虽然天气很冷，我们还是继续走。

candidates.english: Though he is young, he is very brave.
candidates.chinese: 虽然他很年轻，但他很勇敢。

candidates.english: Though it was late, she finished her homework.
candidates.chinese: 虽然很晚了，她还是完成了作业。

candidates.english: We walked through the forest together.
candidates.chinese: 我们一起穿过森林。

candidates.english: The train goes through a long tunnel.
candidates.chinese: 火车穿过一条长长的隧道。

candidates.english: She looked through the window at the garden.
candidates.chinese: 她透过窗户看花园。

candidates.english: Please do not throw rubbish on the ground.
candidates.chinese: 请不要把垃圾扔在地上。

candidates.english: He threw the ball to his teammate.
candidates.chinese: 他把球扔给了队友。

candidates.english: She threw the paper into the bin.
candidates.chinese: 她把纸扔进了垃圾桶。

candidates.english: We still have time to catch the bus.
candidates.chinese: 我们还有时间赶上公交车。

candidates.english: What time does the movie start?
candidates.chinese: 电影什么时候开始？

candidates.english: I don't have time to play today.
candidates.chinese: 我今天没有时间玩。

candidates.english: I felt tired after the long walk.
candidates.chinese: 走了很久之后，我感到疲倦。

candidates.english: She looks tired after the exam.
candidates.chinese: 考试后她看起来很疲倦。

candidates.english: He was too tired to finish his homework.
candidates.chinese: 他太累了，无法完成作业。

candidates.english: She walked to the window.
candidates.chinese: 她走向窗户。

candidates.english: He pointed to the map on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 他指向墙上的地图。

candidates.english: She turned to face the class.
candidates.chinese: 她转身面向全班。

candidates.english: Do not touch the wet paint.
candidates.chinese: 不要触摸未干的油漆。

candidates.english: Please do not touch the exhibits in the museum.
candidates.chinese: 请勿触摸博物馆的展品。

candidates.english: He touched the hot pan and burned his finger.
candidates.chinese: 他摸了热锅，烫伤了手指。

candidates.english: Making lanterns is a local tradition.
candidates.chinese: 制作灯笼是当地的传统。

candidates.english: Eating mooncakes is a tradition at Mid-Autumn Festival.
candidates.chinese: 中秋节吃月饼是一种传统。

candidates.english: The village keeps the tradition of making handcrafts.
candidates.chinese: 这个村庄保留着制作手工艺品的传统。

candidates.english: The train leaves at half past eight.
candidates.chinese: 火车八点半出发。

candidates.english: We took the train to Beijing last summer.
candidates.chinese: 去年夏天我们乘火车去了北京。

candidates.english: A long train crossed the bridge at noon.
candidates.chinese: 一列长长的火车中午驶过了大桥。

candidates.english: My family plans to travel by train.
candidates.chinese: 我的家人计划乘火车旅行。

candidates.english: They hope to travel around the world one day.
candidates.chinese: 他们希望有一天能环游世界。

candidates.english: She loves to travel to new places.
candidates.chinese: 她喜欢去新地方旅行。

candidates.english: We should treat everyone with respect.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该尊重地对待每个人。

candidates.english: Treat others the way you want to be treated.
candidates.chinese: 你希望别人怎样对待你，你就怎样对待别人。

candidates.english: He treats his classmates with kindness.
candidates.chinese: 他友善地对待同学。

candidates.english: Ask the teacher if you have trouble with the task.
candidates.chinese: 如果完成任务有困难，就请教老师。

candidates.english: He got into trouble for being late.
candidates.chinese: 他因为迟到而惹上麻烦。

candidates.english: I had trouble finding the right address.
candidates.chinese: 我很难找到正确的地址。

candidates.english: Is the story true or made up?
candidates.chinese: 这个故事是真的还是编的？

candidates.english: The rumor turned out to be true.
candidates.chinese: 这个谣言结果是真的。

candidates.english: What she said is true.
candidates.chinese: 她说的话是真的。

candidates.english: I trust my friend to return the book.
candidates.chinese: 我相信朋友会归还这本书。

candidates.english: You can trust her to keep a secret.
candidates.chinese: 你可以信任她保守秘密。

candidates.english: He trusts his best friend completely.
candidates.chinese: 他完全信任他最好的朋友。

candidates.english: Try this simple method first.
candidates.chinese: 先试试这个简单的方法。

candidates.english: Let's try the new restaurant tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我们今晚试试那家新餐馆吧。

candidates.english: She tried to open the window but it was stuck.
candidates.chinese: 她试图打开窗户，但卡住了。

candidates.english: Turn left at the second crossing.
candidates.chinese: 在第二个十字路口左转。

candidates.english: Turn right at the traffic lights.
candidates.chinese: 在红绿灯处右转。

candidates.english: The car turned the corner slowly.
candidates.chinese: 汽车慢慢地转过街角。

candidates.english: I understand why you are worried.
candidates.chinese: 我理解你为什么担心。

candidates.english: I don't understand this math problem.
candidates.chinese: 我不理解这道数学题。

candidates.english: She understands how I feel.
candidates.chinese: 她理解我的感受。

candidates.english: Look up and you will see the stars.
candidates.chinese: 向上看，你就会看到星星。

candidates.english: He climbed up the ladder to reach the roof.
candidates.chinese: 他爬上梯子到达屋顶。

candidates.english: The balloon floated up into the sky.
candidates.chinese: 气球飘向天空。

candidates.english: We use this room for music lessons.
candidates.chinese: 我们用这个房间上音乐课。

candidates.english: May I use your pen for a moment?
candidates.chinese: 我可以用一下你的钢笔吗？

candidates.english: We use scissors to cut paper.
candidates.chinese: 我们用剪刀剪纸。

candidates.english: We met at our usual place after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后，我们在平常见面的地方碰面。

candidates.english: I had my usual breakfast of eggs and toast.
candidates.chinese: 我吃了通常的早餐：鸡蛋和吐司。

candidates.english: The usual meeting time is Monday morning.
candidates.chinese: 通常的会议时间是周一早上。

candidates.english: This old watch has special value for my family.
candidates.chinese: 这块旧手表对我家有特殊价值。

candidates.english: The old coin has great value to collectors.
candidates.chinese: 这枚旧硬币对收藏家来说很有价值。

candidates.english: We learned about the value of teamwork.
candidates.chinese: 我们了解了团队合作的价值。

candidates.english: We visited the science museum on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期五参观了科学博物馆。

candidates.english: They visited the zoo last weekend.
candidates.chinese: 他们上周末参观了动物园。

candidates.english: We plan to visit the art gallery tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们计划明天参观美术馆。

candidates.english: I recognised her voice at once.
candidates.chinese: 我立刻听出了她的声音。

candidates.english: Her voice is soft and clear.
candidates.chinese: 她的声音轻柔而清晰。

candidates.english: I heard a familiar voice in the hall.
candidates.chinese: 我在大厅里听到一个熟悉的声音。

candidates.english: Please wait here until I return.
candidates.chinese: 请在这里等到我回来。

candidates.english: We waited for the bus for ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 我们等了十分钟的公交车。

candidates.english: Please wait for me at the gate.
candidates.chinese: 请在门口等我。

candidates.english: I usually wake before the alarm rings.
candidates.chinese: 我通常在闹钟响之前醒来。

candidates.english: I wake up at six every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我每天早上六点醒来。

candidates.english: She woke early to catch the train.
candidates.chinese: 她早早醒来去赶火车。

candidates.english: We walk to school when the weather is fine.
candidates.chinese: 天气好时，我们步行去学校。

candidates.english: They walk along the beach every evening.
candidates.chinese: 他们每天傍晚沿着海滩散步。

candidates.english: He walked slowly because of the rain.
candidates.chinese: 因为下雨，他走得很慢。

candidates.english: I want a glass of water.
candidates.chinese: 我想要一杯水。

candidates.english: She wants a new bicycle for her birthday.
candidates.chinese: 她生日想要一辆新自行车。

candidates.english: Do you want some tea or coffee?
candidates.chinese: 你想要茶还是咖啡？

candidates.english: The warm sunlight came through the window.
candidates.chinese: 温暖的阳光从窗户照进来。

candidates.english: The soup is warm and tasty.
candidates.chinese: 这汤又暖又美味。

candidates.english: We stayed in a warm room during the storm.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨期间我们待在一个温暖的房间里。

candidates.english: Wash your hands before lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭前要洗手。

candidates.english: She washes the dishes after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚饭后洗碗。

candidates.english: Remember to wash your face before bed.
candidates.chinese: 记得睡前洗脸。

candidates.english: We watched a short film in class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在课堂上看了一部短片。

candidates.english: We watched a basketball game on TV.
candidates.chinese: 我们在电视上观看了一场篮球赛。

candidates.english: They watch the sunset from the hill.
candidates.chinese: 他们从山丘上观看日落。

candidates.english: This is an easy way to remember the word.
candidates.chinese: 这是记住这个单词的一种简单方法。

candidates.english: There is a better way to solve this problem.
candidates.chinese: 有更好的方法来解决这个问题。

candidates.english: She found a new way to learn English.
candidates.chinese: 她找到了一种学英语的新方法。

candidates.english: He felt weak after being ill.
candidates.chinese: 生病后他感到很虚弱。

candidates.english: She felt weak after standing in the sun too long.
candidates.chinese: 在阳光下站得太久后，她感到很虚弱。

candidates.english: After the long run, my legs felt weak.
candidates.chinese: 长跑后，我的腿感到虚弱。

candidates.english: Students wear sports shoes for the race.
candidates.chinese: 学生们穿运动鞋参加比赛。

candidates.english: She wears a red dress to the party.
candidates.chinese: 她穿着红色连衣裙去参加聚会。

candidates.english: He wore a hat to protect from the sun.
candidates.chinese: 他戴着帽子防晒。

candidates.english: The doctor checked my weight.
candidates.chinese: 医生检查了我的体重。

candidates.english: She is happy with her weight now.
candidates.chinese: 她现在对自己的体重很满意。

candidates.english: He wants to reduce his weight by exercising.
candidates.chinese: 他想通过锻炼来减轻体重。

candidates.english: Ella sings very well.
candidates.chinese: 埃拉歌唱得很好。

candidates.english: She speaks English well.
candidates.chinese: 她英语说得好。

candidates.english: The team played well in the final.
candidates.chinese: 球队在决赛中表现很好。

candidates.english: The river is too wide to swim across.
candidates.chinese: 这条河太宽，游不过去。

candidates.english: The road is wide enough for two cars.
candidates.chinese: 这条路足够宽，可以并排行驶两辆车。

candidates.english: The table is too wide for this room.
candidates.chinese: 这张桌子对这个房间来说太宽了。

candidates.english: Our team hopes to win the match.
candidates.chinese: 我们队希望赢得比赛。

candidates.english: He won the first prize in the contest.
candidates.chinese: 他在比赛中获得了一等奖。

candidates.english: We hope to win the game tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们希望明天赢得比赛。

candidates.english: Saving some money is a wise choice.
candidates.chinese: 存一些钱是明智的选择。

candidates.english: It was wise to bring an umbrella.
candidates.chinese: 带伞是明智的。

candidates.english: She made a wise decision about her study plan.
candidates.chinese: 她对自己的学习计划做出了明智的决定。

candidates.english: I went to the library with my sister.
candidates.chinese: 我和姐姐一起去了图书馆。

candidates.english: I had lunch with my classmates.
candidates.chinese: 我和同学们一起吃了午饭。

candidates.english: She watched a movie with her parents.
candidates.chinese: 她和父母一起看了一部电影。

candidates.english: I wonder where the path leads.
candidates.chinese: 我想知道这条小路通向哪里。

candidates.english: I wonder why the sky is blue.
candidates.chinese: 我想知道天空为什么是蓝色的。

candidates.english: She wondered what was inside the box.
candidates.chinese: 她想知道盒子里有什么。

candidates.english: The choir gave a wonderful performance.
candidates.chinese: 合唱团带来了一场精彩的演出。

candidates.english: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
candidates.chinese: 我们在海滩上度过了美好的时光。

candidates.english: The party was wonderful and full of fun.
candidates.chinese: 聚会很精彩，充满乐趣。

candidates.english: My parents work at the same hospital.
candidates.chinese: 我的父母在同一家医院工作。

candidates.english: My father works in a bank.
candidates.chinese: 我父亲在一家银行工作。

candidates.english: She works as a nurse.
candidates.chinese: 她是一名护士。

candidates.english: They are my best friends.
candidates.chinese: 他们是我最好的朋友。

candidates.english: The children built a sandcastle on the beach.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

candidates.english: We picked up shells on the beach.
candidates.chinese: 我们在海滩上捡贝壳。

candidates.english: My family walked along the beach at sunset.
candidates.chinese: 我的家人在日落时沿着海滩散步。

candidates.english: We saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
candidates.chinese: 雨后我们看到了一道美丽的彩虹。

candidates.english: This park is beautiful in spring.
candidates.chinese: 这个公园春天很美丽。

candidates.english: She painted a beautiful flower.
candidates.chinese: 她画了一朵美丽的花。

candidates.english: He went to bed early last night.
candidates.chinese: 他昨晚很早就上床睡觉了。

candidates.english: There is a book on my bed.
candidates.chinese: 我的床上有一本书。

candidates.english: The cat slept under the bed.
candidates.chinese: 那只猫睡在床下面。

candidates.english: There is a small desk in my bedroom.
candidates.chinese: 我的卧室里有一张小书桌。

candidates.english: I clean my bedroom every Saturday.
candidates.chinese: 我每周六打扫我的卧室。

candidates.english: Her bedroom has two bright windows.
candidates.chinese: 她的卧室有两扇明亮的窗户。

candidates.english: Dad cooked beef and potatoes for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸晚饭做了牛肉和土豆。

candidates.english: He ordered beef noodles for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 他午饭点了牛肉面。

candidates.english: The soup has some beef in it.
candidates.chinese: 汤里有一些牛肉。

candidates.english: Wash your hands before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭前要洗手。

candidates.english: Finish your homework before you watch TV.
candidates.chinese: 看电视之前先完成作业。

candidates.english: She reads for ten minutes before class.
candidates.chinese: 她上课前读十分钟书。

candidates.english: The children behaved well during the visit.
candidates.chinese: 参观期间，孩子们表现得很好。

candidates.english: Please behave politely at the museum.
candidates.chinese: 请在博物馆里举止礼貌。

candidates.english: He behaved calmly during the exam.
candidates.chinese: 考试期间他表现得很冷静。

candidates.english: The school bell rang at eight.
candidates.chinese: 校铃在八点响了。

candidates.english: I heard the bell at the door from the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 我在厨房听到了门口的铃声。

candidates.english: The bell on the desk is small.
candidates.chinese: 桌上的铃很小。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句door bell不如doorbell自然；为保持highlight精确覆盖bell并体现“铃”，改为the bell at the door。

candidates.english: This blue jacket belongs to my sister.
candidates.chinese: 这件蓝色夹克属于我姐姐。

candidates.english: These books belong to the school library.
candidates.chinese: 这些书属于学校图书馆。

candidates.english: This red cup belongs to my mother.
candidates.chinese: 这个红杯子属于我妈妈。

candidates.english: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
candidates.chinese: 经常锻炼对健康有很多益处。

candidates.english: One benefit of reading is better writing.
candidates.chinese: 阅读的一个益处是写作会更好。

candidates.english: Good sleep brings many benefits to students.
candidates.chinese: 良好的睡眠给学生带来许多益处。

candidates.english: A little dog sat beside the old man.
candidates.chinese: 一只小狗坐在老人旁边。

candidates.english: The lamp is beside my desk.
candidates.chinese: 台灯在我的书桌旁边。

candidates.english: She put her bag beside the chair.
candidates.chinese: 她把包放在椅子旁边。

candidates.english: This plan is better than the first one.
candidates.chinese: 这个计划比第一个更好。

candidates.english: This answer is better than the old one.
candidates.chinese: 这个答案比旧答案更好。

candidates.english: A warmer coat is better for winter.
candidates.chinese: 冬天穿更暖和的外套更好。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句涉及与个人答案比较，可能形成不必要的比较语境，改为物与物比较。

candidates.english: A big tree stands in front of our school.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校前面有一棵大树。

candidates.english: They live in a big house near the river.
candidates.chinese: 他们住在河边的一所大房子里。

candidates.english: I need a big box for these books.
candidates.chinese: 我需要一个大盒子装这些书。

candidates.english: I ride my bike to school every day.
candidates.chinese: 我每天骑自行车上学。

candidates.english: His new bike is under the tree.
candidates.chinese: 他的新自行车在树下。

candidates.english: Can you fix this bike for me?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我修这辆自行车吗？

candidates.english: A small bird is singing in the tree.
candidates.chinese: 一只小鸟正在树上歌唱。

candidates.english: A white bird flew over the river.
candidates.chinese: 一只白色的鸟飞过河面。

candidates.english: The bird built a nest in our garden.
candidates.chinese: 那只鸟在我们的花园里筑了巢。

candidates.english: The baby weighed three kilos at birth.
candidates.chinese: 这个婴儿出生时重三千克。

candidates.english: The hospital recorded the time of birth.
candidates.chinese: 医院记录了出生时间。

candidates.english: The nurse checked the baby's health after birth.
candidates.chinese: 护士在婴儿出生后检查了婴儿的健康状况。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原中文用“他的”补出了英文没有说明的性别，改为准确翻译。

candidates.english: We made a cake for Grandma's birthday.
candidates.chinese: 我们为奶奶的生日做了一个蛋糕。

candidates.english: My birthday is in October.
candidates.chinese: 我的生日在十月。

candidates.english: She got a book on her birthday.
candidates.chinese: 她生日那天收到了一本书。

candidates.english: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
candidates.chinese: 老师把日期写在黑板上。

candidates.english: Please clean the blackboard after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后请擦黑板。

candidates.english: There are three words on the blackboard.
candidates.chinese: 黑板上有三个单词。

candidates.english: The traveler is blind and uses a guide dog.
candidates.chinese: 这位旅行者失明，出行时使用导盲犬。

candidates.english: A blind student reads with Braille books.
candidates.chinese: 一名失明的学生用盲文书阅读。

candidates.english: The blind man finds his way by sound.
candidates.chinese: 这位失明的男子通过声音辨路。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“special books”不够自然具体，改为更准确的盲文书。C：原句“knows the way by sound”搭配不够自然，改为“finds his way”。

candidates.english: The heart sends blood around the body.
candidates.chinese: 心脏把血液输送到全身。

candidates.english: Blood moves through our bodies every second.
candidates.chinese: 血液每一秒都在我们的身体里流动。

candidates.english: The doctor checked her blood carefully.
candidates.chinese: 医生仔细检查了她的血液。

candidates.english: The wind blew the leaves to the other side of the road.
candidates.chinese: 风把树叶吹到了马路另一边。

candidates.english: Please blow on the soup to cool it.
candidates.chinese: 请吹一吹汤，让它凉一些。

candidates.english: He blew up a balloon for the game.
candidates.chinese: 他为游戏吹起了一个气球。

candidates.english: She wore a blue dress to the party.
candidates.chinese: 她穿着一条蓝色连衣裙参加聚会。

candidates.english: The sky is blue today.
candidates.chinese: 今天的天空是蓝色的。

candidates.english: He bought a blue schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 他买了一个蓝色的书包。

candidates.english: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
candidates.chinese: 老师把日期写在黑板上。

candidates.english: The notice board is near the library door.
candidates.chinese: 布告牌在图书馆门旁边。

candidates.english: She put the picture on a wooden board.
candidates.chinese: 她把图片放在一块木板上。

candidates.english: We crossed the lake in a small boat.
candidates.chinese: 我们乘一条小船穿过湖面。

candidates.english: A small boat waited by the river bank.
candidates.chinese: 一条小船停在河岸边。

candidates.english: The boat moved slowly across the pond.
candidates.chinese: 小船慢慢划过池塘。

candidates.english: Exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
candidates.chinese: 锻炼让你的身体强壮健康。

candidates.english: My body feels tired after the long walk.
candidates.chinese: 走了很久之后，我的身体感到疲惫。

candidates.english: Water is important for the body.
candidates.chinese: 水对身体很重要。

candidates.english: An adult boiled the water before making tea.
candidates.chinese: 一位成年人泡茶前把水烧开了。

candidates.english: Please boil the water before making soup.
candidates.chinese: 做汤前请把水煮沸。

candidates.english: The water will boil soon.
candidates.chinese: 水很快就会煮沸。

candidates.english: This book tells the story of a young explorer.
candidates.chinese: 这本书讲述了一位年轻探险家的故事。

candidates.english: I borrowed a book about animals from the library.
candidates.chinese: 我从图书馆借了一本关于动物的书。

candidates.english: Please put this book on the desk after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后请把这本书放在课桌上。

candidates.english: Her boss thanked the team for their hard work.
candidates.chinese: 她的老板感谢团队的辛勤工作。

candidates.english: The boss asked everyone to arrive before nine.
candidates.chinese: 老板要求大家九点前到。

candidates.english: My boss showed me how to use the new printer.
candidates.chinese: 我的上司教我如何使用新打印机。

candidates.english: Please fill the bottle with clean water.
candidates.chinese: 请把瓶子装满干净的水。

candidates.english: There is a green bottle on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 厨房桌子上有一个绿色瓶子。

candidates.english: She put the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
candidates.chinese: 她把空瓶子放进了回收箱。

candidates.english: Your name is at the bottom of the page.
candidates.chinese: 你的名字在页面底部。

candidates.english: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
candidates.chinese: 钥匙在我包的底部。

candidates.english: Some sand stayed at the bottom of the glass.
candidates.chinese: 一些沙子留在了玻璃杯底部。

candidates.english: He ate a bowl of rice for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 他午饭吃了一碗米饭。

candidates.english: Mom put hot soup in a blue bowl.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈把热汤盛进一个蓝色的碗里。

candidates.english: The child washed his bowl after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 那个孩子晚饭后洗了自己的碗。

candidates.english: Sleep gives your brain time to rest.
candidates.chinese: 睡眠让你的大脑得到休息。

candidates.english: The brain helps us think and remember.
candidates.chinese: 大脑帮助我们思考和记忆。

candidates.english: Reading can make your brain active.
candidates.chinese: 阅读能让你的大脑活跃起来。

candidates.english: I had bread and milk for breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我早餐吃了面包，喝了牛奶。

candidates.english: She bought fresh bread from the shop.
candidates.chinese: 她从商店买了新鲜面包。

candidates.english: Tom put some butter on the bread.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆在面包上抹了一些黄油。

candidates.english: A healthy breakfast helps me start the day well.
candidates.chinese: 健康的早餐帮助我精神饱满地开始一天。

candidates.english: We usually have breakfast at seven o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 我们通常七点吃早餐。

candidates.english: Dad made noodles for breakfast today.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸今天早餐做了面条。

candidates.english: The old bridge crosses a narrow river.
candidates.chinese: 这座老桥横跨一条狭窄的河。

candidates.english: Many people walk across the bridge every day.
candidates.chinese: 许多人每天走过这座桥。

candidates.english: The bus stopped near the bridge.
candidates.chinese: 公交车停在桥附近。

candidates.english: My brother teaches me how to swim.
candidates.chinese: 我的哥哥教我游泳。

candidates.english: His brother is two years older than him.
candidates.chinese: 他的哥哥比他大两岁。

candidates.english: My elder brother helped me carry the box upstairs.
candidates.chinese: 我的哥哥帮我把箱子搬上楼。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原中文“我的兄弟”不够自然，且英文未说明哥哥或弟弟；改为 elder brother，使中英文对应更准确。

candidates.english: Remember to brush your teeth twice a day.
candidates.chinese: 记得每天刷两次牙。

candidates.english: I brush dirt off my shoes before class.
candidates.chinese: 上课前我把鞋上的泥土刷掉。

candidates.english: Please brush the dust off the table.
candidates.chinese: 请把桌上的灰尘刷掉。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“I brush my shoes before the school show”搭配和时态不够自然；改为更地道的“brush dirt off my shoes”。

candidates.english: The library is the tallest building in our school.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆是我们学校最高的建筑物。

candidates.english: A new building stands beside the park.
candidates.chinese: 公园旁边有一栋新建筑物。

candidates.english: The white building has many large windows.
candidates.chinese: 那栋白色建筑物有许多大窗户。

candidates.english: No one should bully another student.
candidates.chinese: 任何人都不应该欺负其他学生。

candidates.english: Do not bully younger children in the playground.
candidates.chinese: 不要在操场上欺负年龄小的孩子。

candidates.english: The teacher told the class not to bully others.
candidates.chinese: 老师告诉全班不要欺负别人。

candidates.english: Dry leaves burn quickly.
candidates.chinese: 干树叶燃烧得很快。

candidates.english: The small fire will burn for a few minutes.
candidates.chinese: 这小团火会燃烧几分钟。

candidates.english: Wood can burn when it is very dry.
candidates.chinese: 木头很干时会燃烧。

candidates.english: We take the bus to school each morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天早上乘公交车上学。

candidates.english: The bus stops in front of the museum.
candidates.chinese: 公共汽车停在博物馆前。

candidates.english: She waited for the bus with her classmates.
candidates.chinese: 她和同学们一起等公共汽车。

candidates.english: Her family runs a small food business.
candidates.chinese: 她家经营着一家小型食品企业。

candidates.english: Online business is growing in many cities.
candidates.chinese: 许多城市的网上商业正在发展。

candidates.english: Mr. Li started a flower business last year.
candidates.chinese: 李先生去年开始做花卉生意。

candidates.english: The task was difficult, but we finished it.
candidates.chinese: 任务很难，但我们完成了。

candidates.english: I wanted to go outside, but it was too cold.
candidates.chinese: 我想出去，但是天气太冷了。

candidates.english: The bag looks small, but it can hold many books.
candidates.chinese: 这个包看起来小，但是能装很多书。

candidates.english: Lucy shared her birthday cake with us.
candidates.chinese: 露西和我们分享了她的生日蛋糕。

candidates.english: Grandma baked a chocolate cake this morning.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶今天早上烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

candidates.english: There is a piece of cake on the plate.
candidates.chinese: 盘子里有一块蛋糕。

candidates.english: Try to stay calm during the test.
candidates.chinese: 考试时尽量保持冷静。

candidates.english: The lake was calm in the early morning.
candidates.chinese: 清晨的湖面很平静。

candidates.english: Her voice sounded calm on the phone.
candidates.chinese: 她在电话里的声音听起来很平静。

candidates.english: I used my camera to take a picture of the sunset.
candidates.chinese: 我用相机拍了一张日落的照片。

candidates.english: This camera is light enough for a school trip.
candidates.chinese: 这台照相机很轻，适合学校旅行。

candidates.english: He forgot to bring his camera to the park.
candidates.chinese: 他忘了把照相机带到公园。

candidates.english: We camped by the lake for two nights.
candidates.chinese: 我们在湖边露营了两晚。

candidates.english: Our class will camp in the forest this weekend.
candidates.chinese: 我们班这个周末将在森林里露营。

candidates.english: They camp near the river every summer.
candidates.chinese: 他们每年夏天都在河边露营。

candidates.english: Ben can play the guitar very well.
candidates.chinese: 本吉他弹得很好。

candidates.english: I can read this story without a dictionary.
candidates.chinese: 我不用词典也能读这个故事。

candidates.english: Can you help me open the window?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我打开窗户吗？

candidates.english: They cancelled the match because of heavy rain.
candidates.chinese: 由于大雨，他们取消了比赛。

candidates.english: We had to cancel the picnic because the park was closed.
candidates.chinese: 因为公园关闭了，我们不得不取消野餐。

candidates.english: The school will cancel the trip if the weather is bad.
candidates.chinese: 如果天气不好，学校将取消这次旅行。

candidates.english: She lit a candle when the lights went out.
candidates.chinese: 停电时，她点燃了一支蜡烛。

candidates.english: A small candle stood on the dinner table.
candidates.chinese: 餐桌上放着一支小蜡烛。

candidates.english: The candle gave a warm light to the room.
candidates.chinese: 蜡烛给房间带来了温暖的光。

candidates.english: Beijing is the capital of China.
candidates.chinese: 北京是中国的首都。

candidates.english: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
candidates.chinese: 东京是日本的首都。

candidates.english: They marked the capital on the map.
candidates.chinese: 他们在地图上标出了首都。

candidates.english: Their new car uses less energy.
candidates.chinese: 他们的新车能耗更低。

candidates.english: The car stopped at the red light.
candidates.chinese: 汽车在红灯前停下了。

candidates.english: My uncle washes his car every Sunday.
candidates.chinese: 我叔叔每周日洗他的汽车。

candidates.english: I made a thank-you card for my teacher.
candidates.chinese: 我为老师做了一张感谢卡。

candidates.english: She wrote my name on a small card.
candidates.chinese: 她把我的名字写在一张小卡片上。

candidates.english: The museum ticket came with a picture card.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆门票附带一张图片卡片。

candidates.english: A careless mistake cost us the game.
candidates.chinese: 一个粗心的错误让我们输掉了比赛。

candidates.english: He was careless and left his umbrella on the bus.
candidates.chinese: 他很粗心，把伞落在了公交车上。

candidates.english: A careless reader may miss the important date.
candidates.chinese: 粗心的读者可能会漏掉那个重要日期。

candidates.english: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
candidates.chinese: 兔子正在吃一根胡萝卜。

candidates.english: Please cut the carrot into small pieces.
candidates.chinese: 请把胡萝卜切成小块。

candidates.english: Mom added one carrot to the soup.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈往汤里加了一根胡萝卜。

candidates.english: This cartoon makes the children laugh.
candidates.chinese: 这部动画片逗得孩子们发笑。

candidates.english: We watched a short cartoon after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后我们看了一部短动画片。

candidates.english: My sister likes the music in this cartoon.
candidates.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢这部动画片里的音乐。

candidates.english: In that case, we should leave earlier.
candidates.chinese: 既然那样，我们应该早点出发。

candidates.english: In this case, ask the teacher for help.
candidates.chinese: 在这种情况下，向老师求助。

candidates.english: In some cases, the bus arrives late.
candidates.chinese: 在某些情况下，公交车会晚到。

candidates.english: Too much noise can cause stress.
candidates.chinese: 过多噪声会导致压力。

candidates.english: A broken alarm may cause you to be late.
candidates.chinese: 坏掉的闹钟可能会导致你迟到。

candidates.english: Heavy rain caused the match to start late.
candidates.chinese: 大雨导致比赛晚开始。

candidates.english: The library is in the centre of town.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆位于镇中心。

candidates.english: Put the flowers in the centre of the table.
candidates.chinese: 把花放在桌子中央。

candidates.english: The clock hangs in the centre of the wall.
candidates.chinese: 钟挂在墙的中央。

candidates.english: The bridge was built in the last century.
candidates.chinese: 这座桥建于上个世纪。

candidates.english: This old photo is from the twentieth century.
candidates.chinese: 这张老照片来自二十世纪。

candidates.english: People used oil lamps in that century.
candidates.chinese: 那个世纪的人们使用油灯。

candidates.english: I am certain that I locked the door.
candidates.chinese: 我确定我锁门了。

candidates.english: Are you certain about the meeting time?
candidates.chinese: 你确定会议时间吗？

candidates.english: She is certain that her bag is at home.
candidates.chinese: 她确定她的包在家里。

candidates.english: There is an empty chair beside me.
candidates.chinese: 我旁边有一把空椅子。

candidates.english: Please move this chair near the window.
candidates.chinese: 请把这把椅子移到窗边。

candidates.english: He sat on a wooden chair to read.
candidates.chinese: 他坐在一把木椅上读书。

candidates.english: Learning to swim was a challenge for me.
candidates.chinese: 学习游泳对我来说是一项挑战。

candidates.english: The long walk was a challenge for the group.
candidates.chinese: 这段长途步行对这个小组来说是一项挑战。

candidates.english: Finishing the puzzle in ten minutes is a challenge.
candidates.chinese: 十分钟内完成拼图是一项挑战。

candidates.english: My favourite character in the story is the brave girl.
candidates.chinese: 故事中我最喜欢的角色是那个勇敢的女孩。

candidates.english: The main character in the play is a teacher.
candidates.chinese: 这部戏里的主要人物是一位老师。

candidates.english: Each character in the cartoon has a funny voice.
candidates.chinese: 这部动画片里的每个角色都有有趣的声音。

candidates.english: We chatted about our weekend plans.
candidates.chinese: 我们聊了聊周末计划。

candidates.english: They chat quietly before the lesson starts.
candidates.chinese: 上课前他们轻声聊天。

candidates.english: I had a short chat with my cousin online.
candidates.chinese: 我和我的表亲在网上简短聊了一会儿。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文原句把 cousin 译成“表弟”，增加了英文没有说明的性别和年龄信息。

candidates.english: Grandpa taught me to play chess.
candidates.chinese: 爷爷教我下国际象棋。

candidates.english: We play chess in the activity room on Fridays.
candidates.chinese: 我们周五在活动室下国际象棋。

candidates.english: The chessboard is on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 国际象棋棋盘在架子上。

entries.reviewNotes: C：chessboard 作“国际象棋棋盘”更地道，highlight 仍精确覆盖目标词。

candidates.english: Every child needs care and support.
candidates.chinese: 每个孩子都需要关爱和支持。

candidates.english: A child was reading quietly in the corner.
candidates.chinese: 一个孩子正在角落里安静地读书。

candidates.english: The children lined up outside the music room.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在音乐教室外排队。

candidates.english: China has a long and rich history.
candidates.chinese: 中国有着悠久而丰富的历史。

candidates.english: My pen friend lives in China.
candidates.chinese: 我的笔友住在中国。

candidates.english: Many students in China learn English at school.
candidates.chinese: 中国的许多学生在学校学习英语。

candidates.english: We learned about Chinese paper cutting today.
candidates.chinese: 我们今天学习了中国剪纸。

candidates.english: The museum shows Chinese paintings this month.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆这个月展出中国画。

candidates.english: My aunt bought a Chinese tea set.
candidates.chinese: 我姑姑买了一套中国茶具。

candidates.english: She can eat noodles with chopsticks.
candidates.chinese: 她会用筷子吃面条。

candidates.english: Please place the chopsticks beside the bowl.
candidates.chinese: 请把筷子放在碗旁边。

candidates.english: These bamboo chopsticks are light and clean.
candidates.chinese: 这些竹筷又轻又干净。

candidates.english: Washing the dishes is my daily chore.
candidates.chinese: 洗碗是我每天的家务。

candidates.english: Taking out the rubbish is my weekend chore.
candidates.chinese: 倒垃圾是我周末的家务活。

candidates.english: Each chore on the list has a time.
candidates.chinese: 清单上的每项家务活都有时间。

candidates.english: We watched a new film at the cinema.
candidates.chinese: 我们在电影院看了一部新电影。

candidates.english: The cinema is next to the bookstore.
candidates.chinese: 电影院在书店旁边。

candidates.english: We met at the cinema entrance after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后我们在电影院入口见面。

entries.reviewNotes: C：cinema gate 搭配不够自然，改为 cinema entrance，并相应调整中文。

candidates.english: Draw a circle around the correct answer.
candidates.chinese: 在正确答案周围画一个圈。

candidates.english: The children stood in a circle for the game.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们围成一个圆圈玩游戏。

candidates.english: She drew a small circle on the paper.
candidates.chinese: 她在纸上画了一个小圆圈。

candidates.english: Every citizen should help keep the city clean.
candidates.chinese: 每位市民都应该帮助保持城市清洁。

candidates.english: A good citizen follows public rules.
candidates.chinese: 好公民遵守公共规则。

candidates.english: Each citizen can use the public library.
candidates.chinese: 每位公民都可以使用公共图书馆。

candidates.english: The city has many parks and museums.
candidates.chinese: 这座城市有许多公园和博物馆。

candidates.english: My uncle works in a busy city.
candidates.chinese: 我叔叔在一座繁忙的城市工作。

candidates.english: The city lights looked beautiful at night.
candidates.chinese: 夜晚的城市灯光看起来很美。

candidates.english: Our English class begins at nine.
candidates.chinese: 我们的英语课九点开始。

candidates.english: Our class is planning a reading activity.
candidates.chinese: 我们班正在计划一次阅读活动。

candidates.english: The math class ended before lunch.
candidates.chinese: 数学课在午饭前结束了。

candidates.english: My classmate helped me with my homework.
candidates.chinese: 我的同班同学辅导我做作业。

candidates.english: A new classmate sat behind me today.
candidates.chinese: 今天一位新同班同学坐在我后面。

candidates.english: I borrowed a ruler from my classmate.
candidates.chinese: 我向同班同学借了一把尺子。

candidates.english: Students cleaned the classroom after school.
candidates.chinese: 学生们放学后打扫了教室。

candidates.english: The classroom door was open in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 早上教室的门开着。

candidates.english: There are thirty desks in our classroom.
candidates.chinese: 我们教室里有三十张课桌。

candidates.english: The clever fox found a way out.
candidates.chinese: 聪明的狐狸找到了出路。

candidates.english: That clever student solved the problem quickly.
candidates.chinese: 那个聪明的学生很快解出了这道题。

candidates.english: My sister is clever and learns new words fast.
candidates.chinese: 我妹妹很聪明，学新单词很快。

entries.reviewNotes: C：clever idea 更偏“巧妙的主意”，中文“聪明的想法”不自然；改为人物聪明的语境。

candidates.english: Hang your wet clothes outside to dry.
candidates.chinese: 把湿衣服挂到外面晾干。

candidates.english: Fold your clean clothes before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭前把你的干净衣服叠好。

candidates.english: She packed warm clothes for the trip.
candidates.chinese: 她为这次旅行打包了暖和的衣服。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文“保暖衣服”搭配生硬，改为更自然的“暖和的衣服”。

candidates.english: A dark cloud covered the sun.
candidates.chinese: 一片乌云遮住了太阳。

candidates.english: A white cloud floated above the hill.
candidates.chinese: 一朵白云飘在小山上方。

candidates.english: Look at that cloud shaped like a boat.
candidates.chinese: 看那朵像船一样的云。

candidates.english: I joined the school science club.
candidates.chinese: 我加入了学校科学社团。

candidates.english: The music club meets every Tuesday.
candidates.chinese: 音乐社团每周二活动。

candidates.english: She made two friends in the art club.
candidates.chinese: 她在美术社团交了两个朋友。

entries.reviewNotes: B：中文“见面”用于社团不够自然，改为“活动”。

candidates.english: Put on your coat because it is cold outside.
candidates.chinese: 外面很冷，穿上你的外套。

candidates.english: Her red coat is hanging by the door.
candidates.chinese: 她的红色外套挂在门旁。

candidates.english: I left my coat on the bus yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 我昨天把外套落在公交车上了。

candidates.english: I found a coin under the table.
candidates.chinese: 我在桌子下面发现了一枚硬币。

candidates.english: The coin fell out of my pocket.
candidates.chinese: 那枚硬币从我的口袋里掉了出来。

candidates.english: She put a shiny coin into the box.
candidates.chinese: 她把一枚亮闪闪的硬币放进盒子里。

candidates.english: The water is too cold for swimming.
candidates.chinese: 水太冷，不适合游泳。

candidates.english: It was a cold morning in January.
candidates.chinese: 那是一月里一个寒冷的早晨。

candidates.english: The wind felt cold on my face.
candidates.chinese: 风吹在我脸上感觉很冷。

candidates.english: My sister hopes to study art at college.
candidates.chinese: 我姐姐希望上大学学习艺术。

candidates.english: The college has a large sports field.
candidates.chinese: 这所大学有一个很大的运动场。

candidates.english: He teaches science at a local college.
candidates.chinese: 他在当地一所学院教科学。

candidates.english: Blue is my favourite colour.
candidates.chinese: 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色。

candidates.english: What colour is your new schoolbag?
candidates.chinese: 你的新书包是什么颜色？

candidates.english: Green is a calm colour for this poster.
candidates.chinese: 绿色是这张海报上让人平静的颜色。

candidates.english: Our community has a free sports centre.
candidates.chinese: 我们社区有一个免费的体育中心。

candidates.english: Many families in our community plant flowers together.
candidates.chinese: 我们社区的许多家庭一起种花。

candidates.english: The community library opens at nine every morning.
candidates.chinese: 社区图书馆每天早上九点开放。

candidates.english: The company makes electric buses.
candidates.chinese: 这家公司生产电动公交车。

candidates.english: My aunt works for a computer company.
candidates.chinese: 我姑姑在一家电脑公司工作。

candidates.english: This company sells school bags online.
candidates.chinese: 这家公司在网上销售书包。

candidates.english: We heard our favourite song at the concert.
candidates.chinese: 我们在音乐会上听到了最喜欢的歌。

candidates.english: The school concert starts at seven tonight.
candidates.chinese: 学校音乐会今晚七点开始。

candidates.english: Dad bought two tickets for the piano concert.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸买了两张钢琴音乐会的票。

candidates.english: The old bike is still in good condition.
candidates.chinese: 这辆旧自行车的状况仍然很好。

candidates.english: The library books are in excellent condition.
candidates.chinese: 这些图书馆的书状况极好。

candidates.english: Please check the condition of your desk.
candidates.chinese: 请检查一下你的课桌状况。

candidates.english: Practice gave her confidence before the speech.
candidates.chinese: 练习让她在演讲前有了信心。

candidates.english: The kind words gave Tom confidence.
candidates.chinese: 这些友善的话给了汤姆信心。

candidates.english: She answered the question with confidence.
candidates.chinese: 她满怀信心地回答了问题。

candidates.english: Congratulations on winning the race!
candidates.chinese: 祝贺你赢得比赛！

candidates.english: Congratulations on your new role in the club.
candidates.chinese: 祝贺你在社团里担任新职务。

candidates.english: I sent my congratulations to my classmate.
candidates.chinese: 我向同学表达了祝贺。

candidates.english: We had a friendly conversation after class.
candidates.chinese: 课后我们进行了一次友好的交谈。

candidates.english: Their conversation at lunch was about books.
candidates.chinese: 他们午餐时的交谈是关于书的。

candidates.english: I started a short conversation with my new neighbor.
candidates.chinese: 我和新邻居开始了一次简短的交谈。

candidates.english: My brother can cook a simple meal.
candidates.chinese: 我的哥哥会做一顿简单的饭。

candidates.english: Mom will cook noodles for breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈早饭会煮面条。

candidates.english: We cook vegetables in the school kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 我们在学校厨房烹饪蔬菜。

candidates.english: The room stays cool in the afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间下午仍然很凉爽。

candidates.english: A cool wind came through the window.
candidates.chinese: 一阵凉爽的风从窗户吹进来。

candidates.english: The water felt cool after the long walk.
candidates.chinese: 走了很久之后，这水感觉很凉爽。

candidates.english: Please copy the sentence into your notebook.
candidates.chinese: 请把这个句子抄到笔记本上。

candidates.english: I need to copy the address carefully.
candidates.chinese: 我需要仔细抄写这个地址。

candidates.english: The students copy new words after reading.
candidates.chinese: 学生们读完后抄写新单词。

candidates.english: I could swim when I was six.
candidates.chinese: 我六岁时就会游泳。

candidates.english: She could read simple stories last year.
candidates.chinese: 她去年就能读简单的故事了。

candidates.english: We could see the lake from the hill.
candidates.chinese: 我们从山上能看到那个湖。

candidates.english: Can you count from one to twenty?
candidates.chinese: 你能从一数到二十吗？

candidates.english: The child can count the apples on the table.
candidates.chinese: 这个孩子会数桌上的苹果。

candidates.english: Let us count the chairs before class.
candidates.chinese: 上课前我们来数一数椅子。

candidates.english: China is a country with a long history.
candidates.chinese: 中国是一个历史悠久的国家。

candidates.english: Japan is a country near China.
candidates.chinese: 日本是中国附近的一个国家。

candidates.english: Each country has its own flag.
candidates.chinese: 每个国家都有自己的国旗。

candidates.english: I joined a short painting course.
candidates.chinese: 我参加了一个短期绘画课程。

candidates.english: This science course is fun and useful.
candidates.chinese: 这门科学课程有趣又有用。

candidates.english: He takes an English course on Saturdays.
candidates.chinese: 他每周六上一门英语课程。

candidates.english: My cousin lives in the next town.
candidates.chinese: 我的表弟住在邻镇。

candidates.english: My cousin helped me with the model plane.
candidates.chinese: 我的表哥帮我做了模型飞机。

candidates.english: Her cousin visits us every summer.
candidates.chinese: 她的表姐每年夏天来看我们。

candidates.english: The cow is eating grass by the river.
candidates.chinese: 那头奶牛正在河边吃草。

candidates.english: A black and white cow stood near the fence.
candidates.chinese: 一头黑白相间的奶牛站在栅栏旁。

candidates.english: The farmer gave the cow fresh water.
candidates.chinese: 农民给那头奶牛准备了新鲜的水。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文原句“给那头奶牛喝了新鲜的水”表达不自然，改为更准确的翻译。

candidates.english: The story has a crazy ending that made us laugh.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事有个疯狂的结局，把我们逗笑了。

candidates.english: We had a crazy idea for the class show.
candidates.chinese: 我们为班级表演想出了一个疯狂的主意。

candidates.english: The game became crazy in the last minute.
candidates.chinese: 比赛在最后一分钟变得疯狂起来。

candidates.english: Nora found a creative way to reuse the boxes.
candidates.chinese: 诺拉想出了一个有创意的办法来重复使用这些箱子。

candidates.english: The creative student made a lamp from paper.
candidates.chinese: 那位有创造力的学生用纸做了一盏灯。

candidates.english: We need a creative plan for the art wall.
candidates.chinese: 我们需要一个有创意的计划来设计艺术墙。

candidates.english: Use the bridge to cross the river safely.
candidates.chinese: 请从桥上过河，以确保安全。

candidates.english: Wait for the green light before you cross the road.
candidates.chinese: 过马路前要等绿灯。

candidates.english: They cross the small bridge to reach school.
candidates.chinese: 他们穿过小桥到达学校。

candidates.english: The bus was crowded after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后公交车很拥挤。

candidates.english: The market is crowded on Sunday morning.
candidates.chinese: 周日早上的市场很拥挤。

candidates.english: The train station looked crowded before the holiday.
candidates.chinese: 假期前火车站看起来很拥挤。

candidates.english: The baby began to cry when he woke up.
candidates.chinese: 婴儿醒来后开始哭。

candidates.english: She did not cry when she missed the bus.
candidates.chinese: 她错过公交车时没有哭。

candidates.english: Some children cry on their first day at school.
candidates.chinese: 有些孩子上学第一天会哭。

candidates.english: She poured some tea into my cup.
candidates.chinese: 她往我的杯子里倒了些茶。

candidates.english: There is a clean cup beside the sink.
candidates.chinese: 水槽旁有一个干净的杯子。

candidates.english: I put my pencil in a paper cup.
candidates.chinese: 我把铅笔放进一个纸杯里。

candidates.english: The children were curious about the old machine.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们对这台旧机器很好奇。

candidates.english: I am curious about how bread is made.
candidates.chinese: 我很好奇面包是怎么做出来的。

candidates.english: The class was curious about the new map.
candidates.chinese: 全班对这张新地图很好奇。

candidates.english: The shop assistant greeted every customer warmly.
candidates.chinese: 店员热情地问候每位顾客。

candidates.english: A customer asked for a smaller T-shirt.
candidates.chinese: 一位顾客要了一件小一点的T恤。

candidates.english: The customer paid for the books at the desk.
candidates.chinese: 那位顾客在柜台为这些书付款。

candidates.english: That puppy looks very cute in the photo.
candidates.chinese: 照片里的那只小狗看起来很可爱。

candidates.english: The baby has a cute smile.
candidates.chinese: 这个婴儿有可爱的笑容。

candidates.english: She drew a cute cat on the card.
candidates.chinese: 她在卡片上画了一只可爱的猫。

candidates.english: A daily walk is good for your health.
candidates.chinese: 每天散步对健康有好处。

candidates.english: I do my daily reading before bed.
candidates.chinese: 我睡前完成每日阅读。

candidates.english: Our teacher checks the daily homework list.
candidates.chinese: 我们的老师查看每日作业清单。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句 daily life 更偏“日常生活”，没有准确体现 teachingSense“每日的”，改为“每日阅读”。

candidates.english: We danced together at the school festival.
candidates.chinese: 我们在校园节上一起跳舞。

candidates.english: They dance after music class every Friday.
candidates.chinese: 他们每周五音乐课后跳舞。

candidates.english: Lily wants to dance on the stage.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉想在舞台上跳舞。

candidates.english: The street became dark after the lights went out.
candidates.chinese: 灯灭后，街道变得黑暗。

candidates.english: The cave was dark and quiet inside.
candidates.chinese: 洞里黑暗又安静。

candidates.english: It was too dark to read the menu.
candidates.chinese: 光线太暗，看不清菜单。

candidates.english: Their daughter started school this year.
candidates.chinese: 他们的女儿今年开始上学。

candidates.english: His daughter likes reading picture books.
candidates.chinese: 他的女儿喜欢读绘本。

candidates.english: The doctor's daughter is in my class.
candidates.chinese: 那位医生的女儿在我班里。

candidates.english: The old tree is dead, but new flowers grow nearby.
candidates.chinese: 那棵老树死了，但附近长出了新花。

candidates.english: The flower in the vase is dead.
candidates.chinese: 花瓶里的花枯死了。

candidates.english: A dead leaf fell onto my desk.
candidates.chinese: 一片枯死的叶子落到我的书桌上。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句用碗里的鱼死亡，语境不够适合中学生例句，改为中性植物语境。

candidates.english: The story tells of the hero’s death.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事讲述了英雄的死亡。

candidates.english: The lesson explains the death of stars.
candidates.chinese: 这节课讲解恒星的死亡。

candidates.english: The scientist studied the death of the plant.
candidates.chinese: 那位科学家研究了这株植物的死亡。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“explains the death of the old king”不够自然，且与A同属人物死亡叙事，改为中性科普语境。

candidates.english: The temperature rose by one degree.
candidates.chinese: 温度升高了一度。

candidates.english: Set the oven one degree lower.
candidates.chinese: 把烤箱温度调低一度。

candidates.english: The angle is ninety degrees.
candidates.chinese: 这个角是九十度。

candidates.english: The dumplings taste delicious.
candidates.chinese: 这些饺子味道鲜美。

candidates.english: This soup smells delicious.
candidates.chinese: 这汤闻起来很美味。

candidates.english: Mom made a delicious cake for us.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈给我们做了一个美味的蛋糕。

candidates.english: Can you describe the person you saw?
candidates.chinese: 你能描述一下你看到的那个人吗？

candidates.english: Please describe your classroom in three sentences.
candidates.chinese: 请用三句话描述你的教室。

candidates.english: She described the bag to the lost-and-found office.
candidates.chinese: 她向失物招领处描述了那个包。

candidates.english: Few plants can grow in this desert.
candidates.chinese: 很少有植物能在这片沙漠中生长。

candidates.english: Camels can walk for days in the desert.
candidates.chinese: 骆驼能在沙漠中行走好几天。

candidates.english: The map shows a large desert in the west.
candidates.chinese: 地图显示西部有一大片沙漠。

candidates.english: Students designed a poster for the book fair.
candidates.chinese: 学生们为书展设计了一张海报。

candidates.english: My brother will design a simple website.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥将设计一个简单的网站。

candidates.english: We designed a new cover for the class magazine.
candidates.chinese: 我们为班级杂志设计了一个新封面。

candidates.english: I write about my day in my diary.
candidates.chinese: 我在日记里记录每天的生活。

candidates.english: Her diary is full of small drawings.
candidates.chinese: 她的日记里满是小画。

candidates.english: Tom put his diary in the top drawer.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆把他的日记放进了最上面的抽屉。

candidates.english: Can you see the difference between the two pictures?
candidates.chinese: 你能看出这两幅图的不同吗？

candidates.english: There is a big difference in their prices.
candidates.chinese: 它们的价格有很大差别。

candidates.english: I noticed one small difference in the two maps.
candidates.chinese: 我注意到这两张地图中有一个小差别。

candidates.english: We dug a small hole for the tree.
candidates.chinese: 我们为这棵树挖了一个小坑。

candidates.english: The children dig in the sand with small shovels.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们用小铲子在沙子里挖。

candidates.english: Dad dug potatoes from the garden.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸从菜园里挖出了土豆。

candidates.english: Dinner will be ready at six.
candidates.chinese: 晚餐六点就能准备好。

candidates.english: We had noodles for dinner yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 我们昨天晚餐吃了面条。

candidates.english: Dad washed the dishes after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸晚餐后洗了碗。

candidates.english: Wash your hands because they are dirty.
candidates.chinese: 洗洗手，因为手脏了。

candidates.english: My shoes got dirty in the rain.
candidates.chinese: 我的鞋在雨中弄脏了。

candidates.english: The dirty window needs cleaning.
candidates.chinese: 这扇脏窗户需要清洁。

candidates.english: I do not want to disappoint my team.
candidates.chinese: 我不想让我的团队失望。

candidates.english: The canceled trip disappointed the class.
candidates.chinese: 取消的旅行让全班失望了。

candidates.english: Try not to disappoint your little sister.
candidates.chinese: 尽量不要让你的小妹妹失望。

candidates.english: This rice dish is easy to make.
candidates.chinese: 这道米饭菜肴很容易做。

candidates.english: The fish dish is popular in our school canteen.
candidates.chinese: 这道鱼肉菜肴在我们学校食堂很受欢迎。

candidates.english: She ordered a vegetable dish for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 她午餐点了一道蔬菜菜肴。

entries.reviewNotes: B、C：原中文“鱼菜”“蔬菜菜”不自然，改为准确自然的“菜肴”表达。

candidates.english: I do my homework before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 我在晚饭前做作业。

candidates.english: Can you do the cleaning today?
candidates.chinese: 你今天能做清洁吗？

candidates.english: We did a science project last week.
candidates.chinese: 我们上周做了一个科学项目。

candidates.english: The doctor checked my injured arm.
candidates.chinese: 医生检查了我受伤的手臂。

candidates.english: The doctor gave me some medicine.
candidates.chinese: 医生给了我一些药。

candidates.english: A doctor works in the clinic near our school.
candidates.chinese: 一名医生在我们学校附近的诊所工作。

candidates.english: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 我们的狗每天下午都在门边等候。

candidates.english: The small dog sleeps under the table.
candidates.chinese: 那只小狗睡在桌子下面。

candidates.english: I saw a brown dog in the park.
candidates.chinese: 我在公园里看见一只棕色的狗。

candidates.english: Someone knocked on the front door.
candidates.chinese: 有人敲了前门。

candidates.english: Close the door before you leave.
candidates.chinese: 离开前请关门。

candidates.english: The classroom door is open.
candidates.chinese: 教室的门开着。

candidates.english: A golden dragon was painted on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 墙上画着一条金色的龙。

candidates.english: The kite looks like a blue dragon.
candidates.chinese: 这个风筝看起来像一条蓝色的龙。

candidates.english: He drew a dragon on his notebook.
candidates.chinese: 他在笔记本上画了一条龙。

candidates.english: The red dress has two deep pockets.
candidates.chinese: 这条红色连衣裙有两个深口袋。

candidates.english: She wore a yellow dress to the party.
candidates.chinese: 她穿了一条黄色连衣裙去聚会。

candidates.english: The dress on the chair is clean.
candidates.chinese: 椅子上的那条连衣裙是干净的。

candidates.english: The bus driver helped us find the right stop.
candidates.chinese: 公交车司机帮助我们找到了正确的站点。

candidates.english: The taxi driver opened the back door.
candidates.chinese: 出租车司机打开了后门。

candidates.english: Our driver stopped near the museum.
candidates.chinese: 我们的司机在博物馆附近停了车。

candidates.english: Keep the books in a cool, dry place.
candidates.chinese: 把书放在阴凉干燥的地方。

candidates.english: The towel is dry now.
candidates.chinese: 毛巾现在干了。

candidates.english: Put the dry clothes in this basket.
candidates.chinese: 把干衣服放进这个篮子里。

candidates.english: Grandma taught me how to make a dumpling.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶教我怎样包一个饺子。

candidates.english: I ate one dumpling with vinegar.
candidates.chinese: 我蘸醋吃了一个饺子。

candidates.english: This dumpling has cabbage inside.
candidates.chinese: 这个饺子里面有白菜。

candidates.english: Please stay quiet during the film.
candidates.chinese: 电影播放期间请保持安静。

candidates.english: I took notes during the lesson.
candidates.chinese: 我在上课期间做了笔记。

candidates.english: The library was quiet during the exam.
candidates.chinese: 考试期间图书馆很安静。

candidates.english: It is our duty to protect the environment.
candidates.chinese: 保护环境是我们的责任。

candidates.english: It is my duty to lock the classroom door.
candidates.chinese: 锁教室门是我的责任。

candidates.english: Cleaning the board is her duty today.
candidates.chinese: 今天擦黑板是她的责任。

candidates.english: Each student received a new notebook.
candidates.chinese: 每个学生都收到了一本新笔记本。

candidates.english: Each box has a pencil inside.
candidates.chinese: 每个盒子里都有一支铅笔。

candidates.english: Give each child a cup of water.
candidates.chinese: 给每个孩子一杯水。

candidates.english: The rabbit has one black ear.
candidates.chinese: 这只兔子有一只黑耳朵。

candidates.english: My left ear hurts a little.
candidates.chinese: 我的左耳有点疼。

candidates.english: She put the phone near her ear.
candidates.chinese: 她把电话放在耳朵旁边。

candidates.english: The Earth travels around the Sun.
candidates.chinese: 地球绕着太阳运行。

candidates.english: We should keep the Earth clean.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该保持地球清洁。

candidates.english: The Earth is our home.
candidates.chinese: 地球是我们的家园。

candidates.english: The sun rises in the east.
candidates.chinese: 太阳从东方升起。

candidates.english: Our school is in the east of the city.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校在城市的东部。

candidates.english: The wind came from the east this morning.
candidates.chinese: 今天早上风从东方吹来。

candidates.english: Noise can have a bad effect on sleep.
candidates.chinese: 噪声会对睡眠产生不良影响。

candidates.english: The new rule had a positive effect on the class.
candidates.chinese: 这条新规则对班级产生了积极影响。

candidates.english: Music can have a calming effect on people.
candidates.chinese: 音乐能对人产生安抚的影响。

entries.reviewNotes: B：good effect 搭配不如 positive effect 自然，中文相应改为“积极影响”。

candidates.english: The elephant used its trunk to drink water.
candidates.chinese: 大象用鼻子喝水。

candidates.english: An elephant walked slowly beside the river.
candidates.chinese: 一头大象在河边慢慢走。

candidates.english: The baby elephant stayed close to its mother.
candidates.chinese: 小象紧紧待在妈妈身边。

candidates.english: Would you like anything else?
candidates.chinese: 你还想要其他东西吗？

candidates.english: Ask someone else to open the box.
candidates.chinese: 请其他人打开这个盒子。

candidates.english: Is there anything else in your bag?
candidates.chinese: 你的包里还有其他东西吗？

candidates.english: I received an email from my teacher.
candidates.chinese: 我收到了一封老师发来的电子邮件。

candidates.english: Please send me the homework by email.
candidates.chinese: 请通过电子邮件把作业发给我。

candidates.english: Dad wrote a short email to the hotel.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸给酒店写了一封简短的电子邮件。

candidates.english: The two enemies finally agreed to make peace.
candidates.chinese: 两个敌人最终同意和平相处。

candidates.english: In the story, the king's enemy lived across the river.
candidates.chinese: 在故事中，国王的敌人住在河对岸。

candidates.english: The game character ran away from an enemy.
candidates.chinese: 游戏角色从一个敌人身边跑开了。

candidates.english: The engineer designed a safer bridge.
candidates.chinese: 工程师设计了一座更安全的桥。

candidates.english: An engineer checked the lift before it opened.
candidates.chinese: 一名工程师在电梯启用前检查了它。

candidates.english: My aunt is an engineer at a car company.
candidates.chinese: 我姑姑是一家汽车公司的工程师。

candidates.english: We practise English in pairs every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天早晨两人一组练习英语。

candidates.english: English is my favorite school subject.
candidates.chinese: 英语是我最喜欢的学校科目。

candidates.english: She reads an English story after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚饭后读一个英语故事。

candidates.english: Everyone can help protect the environment.
candidates.chinese: 每个人都能帮助保护环境。

candidates.english: Plants need a clean environment to grow well.
candidates.chinese: 植物需要干净的环境才能长得好。

candidates.english: The new library has a quiet reading environment.
candidates.chinese: 新图书馆有安静的阅读环境。

candidates.english: I enjoy fruit, especially oranges.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢水果，尤其是橙子。

candidates.english: I like spring, especially the warm mornings.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢春天，尤其是温暖的早晨。

candidates.english: This soup tastes good, especially with fresh tomatoes.
candidates.chinese: 这汤味道很好，尤其是加了新鲜番茄。

candidates.english: Have you ever visited a science museum?
candidates.chinese: 你曾经参观过科学博物馆吗？

candidates.english: Have you ever made bread at home?
candidates.chinese: 你曾经在家做过面包吗？

candidates.english: She is the kindest person I have ever met.
candidates.chinese: 她是我曾经遇到过的最善良的人。

candidates.english: Every window in the classroom is open.
candidates.chinese: 教室里的每扇窗户都开着。

candidates.english: Every student brought a notebook to class.
candidates.chinese: 每个学生都带了一本笔记本来上课。

candidates.english: I water every plant on the balcony.
candidates.chinese: 我给阳台上的每株植物浇水。

candidates.english: Everyone helped clean the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 每个人都帮忙打扫了教室。

candidates.english: Everybody stood up when the music began.
candidates.chinese: 音乐响起时，每个人都站了起来。

candidates.english: Everyone wrote their name on the card.
candidates.chinese: 每个人都在卡片上写下了自己的名字。

candidates.english: These are useful words for everyday life.
candidates.chinese: 这些是日常生活中的实用词汇。

candidates.english: A dictionary is useful for everyday study.
candidates.chinese: 词典对日常学习很有用。

candidates.english: She wears simple everyday shoes to school.
candidates.chinese: 她上学穿简单的日常便鞋。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原中文“日常鞋”不够自然，改为“日常便鞋”以准确表达 everyday shoes。

candidates.english: Everything is ready for the class party.
candidates.chinese: 班级聚会的一切都准备好了。

candidates.english: Everything in the room looked clean and bright.
candidates.chinese: 房间里的一切看起来干净又明亮。

candidates.english: He put everything back into his schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 他把所有东西都放回书包里。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原中文“一切”在此处不如“所有东西”自然准确，改为完整对应 put everything back。

candidates.english: We looked everywhere for the missing cat.
candidates.chinese: 我们到处寻找走失的猫。

candidates.english: Spring flowers are everywhere in the park.
candidates.chinese: 公园里到处都是春天的花。

candidates.english: I searched everywhere for my blue pencil.
candidates.chinese: 我到处找我的蓝色铅笔。

candidates.english: Our final exam begins next Monday.
candidates.chinese: 我们的期末考试下周一开始。

candidates.english: She studied hard for the math exam.
candidates.chinese: 她为数学考试努力学习。

candidates.english: The English exam has three listening parts.
candidates.chinese: 英语考试有三个听力部分。

candidates.english: Mei did an excellent job on the project.
candidates.chinese: 梅出色地完成了这个项目。

candidates.english: This is an excellent answer to the question.
candidates.chinese: 这是这个问题的优秀答案。

candidates.english: The school choir gave an excellent performance.
candidates.chinese: 学校合唱团带来了一场出色的表演。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文“进行了优秀的表演”不自然，改为更准确自然的译文。

candidates.english: The basketball final was exciting.
candidates.chinese: 这场篮球决赛令人兴奋。

candidates.english: Our trip to the science center was exciting.
candidates.chinese: 我们去科学中心的旅行令人兴奋。

candidates.english: The last minute of the race was exciting.
candidates.chinese: 比赛的最后一分钟令人兴奋。

candidates.english: Being tired is no excuse for being rude.
candidates.chinese: 疲惫不是无礼的借口。

candidates.english: He made an excuse for arriving late.
candidates.chinese: 他为迟到找了一个借口。

candidates.english: A broken pencil is not an excuse for unfinished homework.
candidates.chinese: 铅笔坏了不是作业没完成的借口。

candidates.english: Regular exercise keeps your heart healthy.
candidates.chinese: 经常锻炼能保持心脏健康。

candidates.english: Morning exercise helps me feel awake.
candidates.chinese: 晨练帮助我感到清醒。

candidates.english: Swimming is good exercise for the whole body.
candidates.chinese: 游泳是对全身有益的锻炼。

candidates.english: This coat is too expensive for me.
candidates.chinese: 这件外套对我来说太贵了。

candidates.english: The camera looks nice, but it is expensive.
candidates.chinese: 这台相机看起来不错，但是很昂贵。

candidates.english: We chose a cheaper bag instead of the expensive one.
candidates.chinese: 我们选了一个更便宜的包，而不是那个昂贵的包。

candidates.english: We explored the forest with a guide.
candidates.chinese: 我们在向导带领下探索了森林。

candidates.english: The children explored the science museum.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们探索了科学博物馆。

candidates.english: Next weekend, we will explore a new hiking path.
candidates.chinese: 下周末，我们将探索一条新的徒步小路。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“explored the old town map”更像研究地图，未准确体现“探索”某个地方，改为探索科学博物馆。

candidates.english: A speck of dust got into his eye.
candidates.chinese: 一粒灰尘进了他的眼睛。

candidates.english: She closed one eye to draw a straight line.
candidates.chinese: 她闭上一只眼睛来画直线。

candidates.english: His left eye looked red after swimming.
candidates.chinese: 游泳后他的左眼看起来发红。

candidates.english: This factory makes electric buses.
candidates.chinese: 这家工厂生产电动公交车。

candidates.english: My uncle works in a shoe factory.
candidates.chinese: 我叔叔在一家鞋厂工作。

candidates.english: The factory near the station closes at six.
candidates.chinese: 车站附近的工厂六点关门。

candidates.english: The teacher gave everyone a fair chance.
candidates.chinese: 老师给了每个人公平的机会。

candidates.english: It is fair to take turns using the computer.
candidates.chinese: 轮流使用电脑是公平的。

candidates.english: The coach made a fair rule for all players.
candidates.chinese: 教练为所有队员制定了一条公平的规则。

candidates.english: Her voice sounded familiar to me.
candidates.chinese: 她的声音听起来很熟悉。

candidates.english: This street is familiar because I walk here often.
candidates.chinese: 这条街让我感到熟悉，因为我经常走这里。

candidates.english: The song sounds familiar, but I forget its name.
candidates.chinese: 这首歌听起来很熟悉，但我忘了它的名字。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文“这条街很熟悉”不够自然，补出“让我感到熟悉”以准确对应英文。

candidates.english: My family eats dinner together on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 我们家每周日一起吃晚饭。

candidates.english: Her family moved to a new apartment.
candidates.chinese: 她一家人搬进了一套新公寓。

candidates.english: My family plans a picnic for Saturday.
candidates.chinese: 我们家计划周六去野餐。

entries.reviewNotes: B、C：原中文“她的家庭”“我们家庭”不符合自然汉语表达，改为“一家人/我们家”。

candidates.english: My brother is a big football fan.
candidates.chinese: 我的哥哥是个忠实的足球迷。

candidates.english: She is a fan of this cartoon series.
candidates.chinese: 她是这部动画片系列的迷。

candidates.english: Tom became a music fan after the concert.
candidates.chinese: 音乐会后，汤姆成了一个音乐迷。

candidates.english: We had a fantastic day at the beach.
candidates.chinese: 我们在海滩度过了极好的一天。

candidates.english: The view from the hill was fantastic.
candidates.chinese: 从山上看到的景色极好。

candidates.english: You gave me a fantastic idea for the poster.
candidates.chinese: 你给了我一个极好的海报创意。

candidates.english: The farm grows rice and vegetables.
candidates.chinese: 这个农场种植水稻和蔬菜。

candidates.english: We picked apples on a farm last autumn.
candidates.chinese: 去年秋天我们在一个农场摘苹果。

candidates.english: The farm has a small house and a wide field.
candidates.chinese: 这个农场有一座小房子和一片宽阔的田地。

candidates.english: The farmer feeds the chickens every morning.
candidates.chinese: 这位农民每天早晨喂鸡。

candidates.english: A farmer showed us how to plant corn.
candidates.chinese: 一位农民向我们展示如何种玉米。

candidates.english: The young farmer sells fresh tomatoes at the market.
candidates.chinese: 这位年轻农民在市场上卖新鲜番茄。

candidates.english: That train is very fast.
candidates.chinese: 那列火车速度很快。

candidates.english: This new bus is fast on the highway.
candidates.chinese: 这辆新公交车在高速路上开得很快。

candidates.english: Lucy is a fast runner in our class.
candidates.chinese: 露西是我们班跑得快的学生。

candidates.english: The fat cat slept beside the fire.
candidates.chinese: 那只胖猫睡在炉火旁。

candidates.english: A fat rabbit sat under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 一只胖兔子坐在椅子下面。

candidates.english: The fat dog walked slowly in the yard.
candidates.chinese: 那只胖狗在院子里慢慢走。

candidates.english: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
candidates.chinese: 我的父亲教会我骑自行车。

candidates.english: Her father cooks breakfast every morning.
candidates.chinese: 她的父亲每天早上做早餐。

candidates.english: Tom's dad works in a small hospital.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆的爸爸在一家小医院工作。

candidates.english: Autumn is my favourite season for hiking.
candidates.chinese: 秋天是我最喜欢的徒步季节。

candidates.english: Science is my favourite subject at school.
candidates.chinese: 科学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

candidates.english: This is Jack's favorite book.
candidates.chinese: 这是杰克最喜欢的书。

candidates.english: Please feed the fish before school.
candidates.chinese: 上学前请喂鱼。

candidates.english: Grandma feeds the chickens every afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶每天下午喂鸡。

candidates.english: Can you feed the little rabbit now?
candidates.chinese: 你现在能喂一下小兔子吗？

candidates.english: I had a strange feeling about the empty house.
candidates.chinese: 我对那座空房子有种奇怪的感觉。

candidates.english: She had a warm feeling when she saw the old photo.
candidates.chinese: 她看到那张旧照片时有一种温暖的感觉。

candidates.english: I got a good feeling after the talk.
candidates.chinese: 谈话之后我有一种很好的感觉。

candidates.english: Families gather for the Spring Festival.
candidates.chinese: 家人们在春节团聚。

candidates.english: The children made lanterns for the festival.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们为这个节日制作了灯笼。

candidates.english: The festival begins with a family dinner.
candidates.chinese: 这个节日以一顿家庭晚餐开始。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句 music festival 偏向“音乐节/活动”，不够准确体现“节日”，已改为节日场景。

candidates.english: The horses are running across the field.
candidates.chinese: 马儿正在田野上奔跑。

candidates.english: Farmers worked in the field after sunrise.
candidates.chinese: 日出后，农民们在田地里劳作。

candidates.english: Corn grows well in this field.
candidates.chinese: 玉米在这块田地里长得很好。

candidates.english: We kept a safe distance from the fire.
candidates.chinese: 我们与火源保持了安全距离。

candidates.english: The cook used a small fire to heat the soup.
candidates.chinese: 厨师用小火加热汤。

candidates.english: The fire in the stove kept the room warm.
candidates.chinese: 炉子里的火让房间保持温暖。

candidates.english: A silver fish swam under the boat.
candidates.chinese: 一条银色的鱼游过船底。

candidates.english: Dad bought a fresh fish from the market.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸从市场买了一条新鲜的鱼。

candidates.english: The small fish hid behind a stone.
candidates.chinese: 那条小鱼躲在一块石头后面。

candidates.english: A yellow flower grew beside the path.
candidates.chinese: 小路旁长出了一朵黄花。

candidates.english: She put a red flower in the vase.
candidates.chinese: 她把一朵红花放进花瓶里。

candidates.english: This flower smells sweet after the rain.
candidates.chinese: 雨后这朵花闻起来很香。

candidates.english: Please focus on the first question.
candidates.chinese: 请把注意力集中在第一个问题上。

candidates.english: Try to focus during the listening test.
candidates.chinese: 听力测试时尽量集中注意力。

candidates.english: He focused on his homework for an hour.
candidates.chinese: 他集中注意力写了一个小时作业。

candidates.english: We learned a traditional folk song.
candidates.chinese: 我们学唱了一首传统民歌。

candidates.english: The museum shows many folk paintings.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆展出了许多民间绘画。

candidates.english: Grandpa told us a folk story after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爷爷晚饭后给我们讲了一个民间故事。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句 folk costumes 的中文“民间服饰”不够自然，且容易偏向民族/传统服饰，已改为更准确的民间故事。

candidates.english: Fresh food gives us energy.
candidates.chinese: 新鲜食物为我们提供能量。

candidates.english: There is enough food for the picnic.
candidates.chinese: 野餐有足够的食物。

candidates.english: The school kitchen prepares hot food at noon.
candidates.chinese: 学校食堂中午准备热食。

candidates.english: My left foot hurts after the long walk.
candidates.chinese: 走了很远的路后，我的左脚很疼。

candidates.english: He washed each foot before bed.
candidates.chinese: 他睡前洗了每只脚。

candidates.english: My feet got wet in the rain.
candidates.chinese: 我的脚在雨中湿了。

candidates.english: We play football after school on Fridays.
candidates.chinese: 我们每周五放学后踢足球。

candidates.english: Football is popular in our school.
candidates.chinese: 足球运动在我们学校很受欢迎。

candidates.english: My brother watches football on Sunday afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥星期天下午看足球比赛。

candidates.english: The heavy rain forced us to turn back.
candidates.chinese: 大雨迫使我们返回。

candidates.english: The strong wind forced us to close the windows.
candidates.chinese: 大风迫使我们关上窗户。

candidates.english: The noise forced me to leave the room.
candidates.chinese: 噪声迫使我离开了房间。

candidates.english: She enjoys learning about foreign cultures.
candidates.chinese: 她喜欢了解外国文化。

candidates.english: We read a foreign story in English class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在英语课上读了一个外国故事。

candidates.english: The shop sells foreign stamps.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店出售外国邮票。

candidates.english: A narrow path leads through the forest.
candidates.chinese: 一条窄路穿过森林。

candidates.english: Many birds live in the forest near our village.
candidates.chinese: 许多鸟住在我们村附近的森林里。

candidates.english: The class drew a map of the forest.
candidates.chinese: 全班画了一张森林地图。

candidates.english: Please write your name on this form.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的名字写在这张表格上。

candidates.english: Fill in the form before you join the trip.
candidates.chinese: 参加旅行前请填写表格。

candidates.english: The nurse checked my form at the desk.
candidates.chinese: 护士在服务台查看了我的表格。

candidates.english: Take one step forward and stop.
candidates.chinese: 向前走一步，然后停下。

candidates.english: The bus moved forward slowly in the snow.
candidates.chinese: 公交车在雪中慢慢向前移动。

candidates.english: She looked forward and saw the library.
candidates.chinese: 她向前看，看到了图书馆。

candidates.english: They founded the reading club last year.
candidates.chinese: 他们去年创建了阅读社团。

candidates.english: The teacher founded a science group in 2024.
candidates.chinese: 这位老师在2024年创建了一个科学小组。

candidates.english: Three students founded a school newspaper.
candidates.chinese: 三名学生创建了一份校报。

candidates.english: Put the milk back in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 把牛奶放回冰箱。

candidates.english: There are apples in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 冰箱里有苹果。

candidates.english: Please clean the fridge after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后请清理冰箱。

candidates.english: Their friendship began at primary school.
candidates.chinese: 他们的友谊始于小学。

candidates.english: A good friendship needs trust and care.
candidates.chinese: 一段良好的友谊需要信任和关心。

candidates.english: Their friendship grew during the school trip.
candidates.chinese: 他们的友谊在学校旅行中加深了。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“Good friendship”缺少冠词，不够自然，已改为更地道的表达并相应调整中文。

candidates.english: Fresh fruit makes a healthy snack.
candidates.chinese: 新鲜水果是一种健康的零食。

candidates.english: Mom cut some fruit for us.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈给我们切了一些水果。

candidates.english: I bought fruit at the small shop.
candidates.chinese: 我在小店买了水果。

candidates.english: That funny story made us laugh.
candidates.chinese: 那个有趣的故事把我们逗笑了。

candidates.english: The funny picture made my sister smile.
candidates.chinese: 那张有趣的图片让妹妹笑了。

candidates.english: We watched a funny video after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们看了一个有趣的视频。

candidates.english: I hope to become a doctor in the future.
candidates.chinese: 我希望将来成为一名医生。

candidates.english: No one knows what will happen in the future.
candidates.chinese: 没有人知道未来会发生什么。

candidates.english: She dreams of a bright future.
candidates.chinese: 她梦想着一个光明的未来。

candidates.english: We played a word game in class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在课堂上玩了一个单词游戏。

candidates.english: This board game is easy to learn.
candidates.chinese: 这个桌面游戏很容易学。

candidates.english: The children made a new game with cards.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们用卡片做了一个新游戏。

candidates.english: Meet me at the school gate after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后在校门口等我。

candidates.english: The garden gate is green.
candidates.chinese: 花园的大门是绿色的。

candidates.english: Please close the gate when you leave.
candidates.chinese: 你离开时请关上大门。

candidates.english: This book gives a general introduction to space.
candidates.chinese: 这本书对太空作了一般性介绍。

candidates.english: The teacher gave us a general idea of the lesson.
candidates.chinese: 老师让我们对这节课有了大致了解。

candidates.english: This is a general rule for the game.
candidates.chinese: 这是这个游戏的一般规则。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文“一般概念”不自然，也没有准确表达 general idea 的完整句意，已改为“大致了解”。

candidates.english: The girl is carrying a red umbrella.
candidates.chinese: 那个女孩正拿着一把红伞。

candidates.english: A girl is drawing a cat in her notebook.
candidates.chinese: 一个女孩正在笔记本上画一只猫。

candidates.english: The girl in a yellow coat waved to her mother.
candidates.chinese: 穿黄外套的那个女孩向她妈妈挥手。

candidates.chinese: 我很高兴你今天来了。

candidates.chinese: 她很高兴看到她的新教室。

candidates.english: Tom felt glad after finding his lost pencil.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆找到丢失的铅笔后感到高兴。

candidates.english: He poured water into a clean glass.
candidates.chinese: 他把水倒进一个干净的玻璃杯。
