candidates.chinese: 请把空玻璃杯放在桌子上。

candidates.english: Mary washed a glass after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 玛丽早餐后洗了一个玻璃杯。

candidates.english: I found one glove under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 我在椅子下面找到了一只手套。

candidates.english: She put on a warm glove before going outside.
candidates.chinese: 她出门前戴上了一只暖和的手套。

candidates.english: This glove is too small for my hand.
candidates.chinese: 这只手套对我的手来说太小了。

candidates.english: My goal is to read twenty books this year.
candidates.chinese: 我的目标是今年读二十本书。

candidates.english: His goal is to learn ten new words every day.
candidates.chinese: 他的目标是每天学十个新单词。

candidates.english: Our goal is to keep the classroom clean.
candidates.chinese: 我们的目标是保持教室干净。

candidates.english: The ring is made of gold.
candidates.chinese: 这枚戒指是金制的。

candidates.english: The small medal is made of gold.
candidates.chinese: 这枚小奖牌是金制的。

candidates.english: They found a thin piece of gold in the box.
candidates.chinese: 他们在盒子里找到了一小片金。

candidates.english: The government built a new hospital here.
candidates.chinese: 政府在这里建了一家新医院。

candidates.english: The government opened a new library for children.
candidates.chinese: 政府为孩子们开设了一座新图书馆。

candidates.english: The local government repaired the road near our school.
candidates.chinese: 当地政府修好了我们学校附近的道路。

candidates.english: My little brother is in Grade Three.
candidates.chinese: 我的弟弟上三年级。

candidates.english: Jenny is in Grade Seven this year.
candidates.chinese: 珍妮今年上七年级。

candidates.english: Students in Grade Eight have a science test today.
candidates.chinese: 八年级的学生今天有一场科学测试。

candidates.english: She will graduate from high school in June.
candidates.chinese: 她将在六月高中毕业。

candidates.english: My cousin will graduate next summer.
candidates.chinese: 我的表哥明年夏天将毕业。

candidates.english: They hope to graduate from middle school together.
candidates.chinese: 他们希望一起从初中毕业。

candidates.english: My grandfather grows tomatoes in his garden.
candidates.chinese: 我的爷爷在花园里种西红柿。

candidates.english: My grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我的爷爷每天早上读报纸。

candidates.english: Her grandfather fixed the small wooden chair.
candidates.chinese: 她的外公修好了那把小木椅。

candidates.english: My grandmother taught me this song.
candidates.chinese: 我的奶奶教会了我这首歌。

candidates.english: My grandma makes noodles on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 我的奶奶星期天做面条。

candidates.english: His grandmother keeps old photos in a box.
candidates.chinese: 他的外婆把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。

candidates.english: The children sat on the soft grass.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们坐在柔软的草地上。

candidates.chinese: 早晨的雨把草弄湿了。

candidates.chinese: 一片绿叶漂在水面上。

candidates.chinese: 她昨天买了一个绿色的书包。

candidates.english: The green bus stopped near the park.
candidates.chinese: 那辆绿色的公共汽车停在公园附近。

candidates.english: We greeted our guests at the door.
candidates.chinese: 我们在门口迎接客人。

candidates.chinese: 老师微笑着问候每一位学生。

candidates.english: We greet our neighbors every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天早上问候邻居。

candidates.english: Dark grey clouds covered the sky.
candidates.chinese: 深灰色的云遮住了天空。

candidates.english: He wore a grey sweater to school.
candidates.chinese: 他穿了一件灰色毛衣去上学。

candidates.english: A gray cat slept beside the window.
candidates.chinese: 一只灰色的猫睡在窗边。

candidates.english: The ball rolled across the ground.
candidates.chinese: 球滚过了地面。

candidates.english: Leaves fell to the ground after the wind blew.
candidates.chinese: 风吹过后，树叶落到了地面上。

candidates.english: Put your bag on the dry ground.
candidates.chinese: 把你的书包放在干燥的地面上。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“after the wind”不自然，改为自然表达。

candidates.english: Our group planted five young trees.
candidates.chinese: 我们小组种了五棵小树。

candidates.english: Each group made a poster about healthy food.
candidates.chinese: 每个小组都制作了一张关于健康食物的海报。

candidates.english: Our group discussed the story after class.
candidates.chinese: 我们小组课后讨论了这个故事。

candidates.english: A guard stood beside the museum entrance.
candidates.chinese: 一名警卫站在博物馆入口旁。

candidates.chinese: 警卫在门口检查票。

candidates.english: A school guard helped visitors find the office.
candidates.chinese: 一名学校警卫帮助访客找到办公室。

candidates.chinese: 你能猜出盒子里有什么吗？

candidates.chinese: 我能根据图片猜出答案。

candidates.chinese: 她根据他的校服猜测了他的年龄。

candidates.english: Each guest received a warm welcome.
candidates.chinese: 每位客人都受到了热情欢迎。

candidates.chinese: 那位客人坐在窗边。

candidates.chinese: 我们为每位客人准备了干净的杯子。

candidates.english: Our guide showed us around the old town.
candidates.chinese: 向导带我们参观了古镇。

candidates.english: The guide led us to the science hall.
candidates.chinese: 向导带我们去了科学馆。

candidates.english: A young guide explained the map to the class.
candidates.chinese: 一位年轻向导向全班讲解了地图。

candidates.english: Leo plays the guitar in the school band.
candidates.chinese: 利奥在学校乐队里弹吉他。

candidates.english: She practiced the guitar after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚饭后练习吉他。

candidates.english: There is a brown guitar beside the desk.
candidates.chinese: 书桌旁有一把棕色的吉他。

candidates.english: I ate half of the apple.
candidates.chinese: 我吃了半个苹果。

candidates.english: Half of the cake is for my sister.
candidates.chinese: 蛋糕的一半是给我妹妹的。

candidates.english: We spent half an hour cleaning the room.
candidates.chinese: 我们花了半个小时打扫房间。

candidates.english: He ordered a hamburger and some juice.
candidates.chinese: 他点了一个汉堡包和一些果汁。

candidates.english: She made a hamburger for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 她午餐做了一个汉堡包。

candidates.english: The hamburger on the plate is still warm.
candidates.chinese: 盘子里的汉堡包还热着。

candidates.english: I hate wasting food.
candidates.chinese: 我讨厌浪费食物。

candidates.english: I hate getting up late for school.
candidates.chinese: 我讨厌上学起晚。

candidates.english: She hates the smell of wet shoes.
candidates.chinese: 她讨厌湿鞋子的味道。

candidates.english: He walks to school with his sister.
candidates.chinese: 他和妹妹一起步行上学。

candidates.english: He is reading a story by the window.
candidates.chinese: 他正在窗边读一个故事。

candidates.english: He helped his father wash the car.
candidates.chinese: 他帮爸爸洗车。

candidates.english: She wore a blue hat on her head.
candidates.chinese: 她头上戴着一顶蓝帽子。

candidates.english: Tom turned his head when he heard his name.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆听到自己的名字时转过头。

candidates.english: The baby put her head on the pillow.
candidates.chinese: 婴儿把头放在枕头上。

candidates.english: Exercise helps keep your heart strong.
candidates.chinese: 锻炼有助于保持心脏强健。

candidates.english: The doctor listened to my heart.
candidates.chinese: 医生听了听我的心脏。

candidates.chinese: 健康的心脏有规律地跳动。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文“听了我的心脏”不够自然完整，调整译文。

candidates.english: The heat made us feel tired.
candidates.chinese: 炎热让我们感到疲倦。

candidates.english: I could feel the heat from the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 我能感觉到厨房里的热。

candidates.english: The heat in the room made the ice melt.
candidates.chinese: 房间里的热使冰融化了。

candidates.chinese: 护士测量了我的身高。

candidates.chinese: 请在这张表格上写下你的身高。

candidates.english: His height changed a lot this year.
candidates.chinese: 他的身高今年变化很大。

candidates.chinese: 米娅把她的笔记本落在了桌上。

candidates.english: Lily put her bag under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉把她的书包放在椅子下面。

candidates.english: Anna showed me her new pencil case.
candidates.chinese: 安娜给我看了她的新铅笔盒。

candidates.english: Your seat is here, next to mine.
candidates.chinese: 你的座位在这里，就在我的座位旁边。

candidates.english: Please write your name here.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的名字写在这里。

candidates.english: The bus stops here every morning.
candidates.chinese: 这辆公交车每天早上在这里停。

candidates.english: The red umbrella is hers.
candidates.chinese: 那把红伞是她的。

candidates.english: This clean cup is hers.
candidates.chinese: 这个干净的杯子是她的。

candidates.english: The seat near the window is hers.
candidates.chinese: 靠窗的座位是她的。

candidates.chinese: 她独自做了整个蛋糕。

candidates.chinese: 她自己搬了那个小箱子。

candidates.chinese: 我们班计划在湖边远足。

candidates.english: Dad packed water for the morning hike.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸为早晨的远足装了水。

candidates.english: I gave him the message after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后我把消息告诉了他。

candidates.english: The teacher asked him to read the sentence.
candidates.chinese: 老师让他读这个句子。

candidates.english: I saw him at the school gate.
candidates.chinese: 我在学校门口看见了他。

candidates.english: Ben fixed the chair himself.
candidates.chinese: 本独自修好了椅子。

candidates.english: Jack cleaned his desk himself.
candidates.chinese: 杰克自己清理了他的书桌。

candidates.english: He found the answer himself.
candidates.chinese: 他自己找到了答案。

candidates.english: His bicycle is beside the gate.
candidates.chinese: 他的自行车在大门旁边。

candidates.english: His lunch box is on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 他的午餐盒在架子上。

candidates.english: Mark forgot his umbrella after school.
candidates.chinese: 马克放学后忘带了他的雨伞。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文原句“忘了他的雨伞”不够自然，改为更准确的完整表达。

candidates.english: The ball hit the wall and bounced back.
candidates.chinese: 球撞到墙后弹了回来。

candidates.english: The beanbag hit the target board.
candidates.chinese: 豆袋击中了目标板。

candidates.english: A tennis ball hit the backboard.
candidates.chinese: 一个网球击中了挡板。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“stone hit the metal sign”容易带出不安全或破坏性场景，改为课堂活动语境。C：原句纸飞机击中教室门带有课堂不当行为色彩，改为中性运动语境。

candidates.english: Painting is a relaxing hobby.
candidates.chinese: 绘画是一项令人放松的爱好。

candidates.english: My hobby is collecting postcards.
candidates.chinese: 我的业余爱好是收集明信片。

candidates.english: Reading after dinner became her hobby.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后阅读成了她的业余爱好。

candidates.english: A rabbit disappeared into the hole.
candidates.chinese: 一只兔子消失在洞里。

candidates.english: There is a small hole in my sock.
candidates.chinese: 我的袜子上有一个小洞。

candidates.english: Rain water filled the hole in the road.
candidates.chinese: 雨水填满了路上的那个洞。

candidates.english: We visited the coast during the summer holiday.
candidates.chinese: 暑假期间我们去了海边。

candidates.english: I finished three books during the holiday.
candidates.chinese: 假期里我读完了三本书。

candidates.english: The library opened again after the holiday.
candidates.chinese: 假期结束后图书馆又开放了。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原句“on the holiday”偏向“某个假日当天”，比“假期”窄，改为明确表示假期。

candidates.english: It took me twenty minutes to do my maths homework.
candidates.chinese: 我花了二十分钟做数学家庭作业。

candidates.english: Please hand in your English homework tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 请明天交你的英语家庭作业。

candidates.english: She checked her homework after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚饭后检查了她的家庭作业。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文补出“her”，更完整对应英文。

candidates.english: It was an honour to represent our school.
candidates.chinese: 能代表学校是一种荣誉。

candidates.english: Winning the school prize was a great honour.
candidates.chinese: 获得学校奖项是一种很大的荣誉。

candidates.english: Helping at the event was an honour for us.
candidates.chinese: 能在活动中帮忙对我们来说是一种荣誉。

entries.reviewNotes: B：中文“一项很大的荣誉”搭配不自然，改为“一种很大的荣誉”。

candidates.english: The nearest hospital is two kilometres away.
candidates.chinese: 最近的医院在两公里外。

candidates.english: My aunt is a nurse at this hospital.
candidates.chinese: 我阿姨是这家医院的护士。

candidates.english: We waited quietly outside the hospital.
candidates.chinese: 我们在医院外安静地等候。

candidates.english: Their house has a small garden.
candidates.chinese: 他们的房子有一个小花园。

candidates.english: A white house stands near the river.
candidates.chinese: 河边有一座白色的房屋。

candidates.english: The old house has two windows upstairs.
candidates.chinese: 那座老房屋楼上有两扇窗。

candidates.english: We share the housework at weekends.
candidates.chinese: 周末我们一起分担家务。

candidates.english: Doing housework teaches me to care for my home.
candidates.chinese: 做家务劳动教会我照顾自己的家。

candidates.english: My brother does housework after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥早饭后做家务劳动。

candidates.english: The task was difficult; however, we finished it.
candidates.chinese: 任务很难，然而我们完成了。

candidates.english: It was raining; however, the playground stayed open.
candidates.chinese: 当时在下雨，然而操场仍然开放。

candidates.english: The bag looked small; however, it held many books.
candidates.chinese: 这个包看起来小，然而它装下了许多书。

candidates.english: Mum hugged me when I came home.
candidates.chinese: 我回家时妈妈拥抱了我。

candidates.english: Grandpa gave the child a warm hug.
candidates.chinese: 爷爷给了孩子一个温暖的拥抱。

candidates.english: She hugged her little sister before the trip.
candidates.chinese: 旅行前她拥抱了她的妹妹。

candidates.english: His gentle humour made everyone relax.
candidates.chinese: 他温和的幽默让大家放松下来。

candidates.english: The story has a little humour in it.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事里有一点幽默。

candidates.english: Her humour made the long wait easier.
candidates.chinese: 她的幽默让漫长的等待轻松了一些。

candidates.english: Hurry, or we will miss the bus.
candidates.chinese: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。

candidates.english: Hurry and put on your shoes.
candidates.chinese: 快点穿上你的鞋。

candidates.english: We must hurry before class starts.
candidates.chinese: 我们必须赶快，不然上课就要开始了。

entries.reviewNotes: C原句与A同属赶交通工具场景，具体情境重复；已改为上课前赶快。

candidates.english: Her husband works at the local hospital.
candidates.chinese: 她的丈夫在当地医院工作。

candidates.english: Mary and her husband live near the park.
candidates.chinese: 玛丽和她的丈夫住在公园附近。

candidates.english: Her husband cooked dinner for the family.
candidates.chinese: 她的丈夫为家人做了晚饭。

candidates.english: I walk to school every morning.
candidates.chinese: 我每天早晨步行上学。

candidates.english: I like music and science.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢音乐和科学。

candidates.english: I put my books in order.
candidates.chinese: 我把我的书整理好了。

candidates.english: Tom stayed home because he was ill.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆因为生病而待在家里。

candidates.english: She felt ill after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后她觉得不舒服。

candidates.english: My brother is ill today.
candidates.chinese: 我弟弟今天生病了。

candidates.english: The illness kept her away from school.
candidates.chinese: 疾病让她无法去上学。

candidates.english: His illness lasted for three days.
candidates.chinese: 他的疾病持续了三天。

candidates.english: The doctor explained the illness clearly.
candidates.chinese: 医生清楚地解释了这种疾病。

candidates.english: This website provides useful travel information.
candidates.chinese: 这个网站提供实用的旅行信息。

candidates.english: The notice gives information about the school trip.
candidates.chinese: 通知提供了关于学校旅行的信息。

candidates.english: I wrote the information in my notebook.
candidates.chinese: 我把这些信息写在了笔记本上。

candidates.english: The keys are inside the blue bag.
candidates.chinese: 钥匙在蓝色包里。

candidates.english: Put the ticket inside your wallet.
candidates.chinese: 把票放在你的钱包里面。

candidates.english: There is a map inside the book.
candidates.chinese: 书里面有一张地图。

candidates.english: Read each instruction before starting the test.
candidates.chinese: 开始考试前先阅读每条指示。

candidates.english: Follow the instruction on the screen.
candidates.chinese: 按照屏幕上的指示操作。

candidates.english: The first instruction tells us to open the box.
candidates.chinese: 第一条指示告诉我们打开盒子。

candidates.english: The violin is a difficult instrument to learn.
candidates.chinese: 小提琴是一种很难学的乐器。

candidates.english: The drum is his favourite instrument.
candidates.chinese: 鼓是他最喜欢的乐器。

candidates.english: Each student chose an instrument for music class.
candidates.chinese: 每个学生为音乐课选择了一种乐器。

candidates.english: The box is heavy, so leave it here.
candidates.chinese: 这个箱子很重，所以把它放在这里。

candidates.english: The cat is hungry, so feed it now.
candidates.chinese: 这只猫饿了，所以现在喂它吧。

candidates.english: I found a coin and put it in my pocket.
candidates.chinese: 我找到一枚硬币，并把它放进了口袋。

candidates.english: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
candidates.chinese: 鸟儿展开它的翅膀飞走了。

candidates.english: The dog wagged its tail at the gate.
candidates.chinese: 那只狗在门口摇着它的尾巴。

candidates.english: The robot moved its arms slowly.
candidates.chinese: 机器人慢慢移动它的手臂。

candidates.english: The door closed by itself.
candidates.chinese: 门自己关上了。

candidates.english: The cat cleaned itself after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 那只猫晚饭后清洁了自己的身体。

candidates.english: The machine stopped itself at noon.
candidates.chinese: 机器在中午自己停了下来。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文“自己清洁身体”不够自然，改为更完整准确的表达。

candidates.english: Take a warm jacket for the evening.
candidates.chinese: 晚上带一件暖和的夹克衫。

candidates.english: My blue jacket is on the chair.
candidates.chinese: 我的蓝色夹克衫在椅子上。

candidates.english: She wore a light jacket to school.
candidates.chinese: 她穿了一件轻薄的夹克衫去上学。

candidates.english: We jog around the park before breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我们早餐前绕公园慢跑。

candidates.english: I jog along the river every Saturday.
candidates.chinese: 我每周六沿着河边慢跑。

candidates.english: They jog on the school track after class.
candidates.chinese: 他们下课后在学校跑道上慢跑。

candidates.english: His joke made the whole class laugh.
candidates.chinese: 他的笑话逗得全班大笑。

candidates.english: Tom told a funny joke at lunch.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆午饭时讲了一个有趣的笑话。

candidates.english: This simple joke made Grandma smile.
candidates.chinese: 这个简单的笑话让奶奶笑了。

candidates.english: The train journey took three hours.
candidates.chinese: 这段火车旅程用了三个小时。

candidates.english: Our journey to the village began early.
candidates.chinese: 我们去村庄的旅行很早就开始了。

candidates.english: She kept a diary during the journey.
candidates.chinese: 她在旅行期间写日记。

candidates.english: Her face was full of joy.
candidates.chinese: 她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。

candidates.english: The good news brought us great joy.
candidates.chinese: 这个好消息给我们带来了巨大的喜悦。

candidates.english: He felt joy when he saw the clean classroom.
candidates.chinese: 看到干净的教室时，他感到喜悦。

candidates.english: Would you like some orange juice?
candidates.chinese: 你想喝点橙汁吗？

candidates.english: I bought a bottle of apple juice.
candidates.chinese: 我买了一瓶苹果汁。

candidates.english: Please put the grape juice in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 请把葡萄汁放进冰箱。

candidates.english: I found the missing key under the sofa.
candidates.chinese: 我在沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

candidates.english: She put the key in her schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 她把钥匙放进书包里。

candidates.english: This key opens the front door.
candidates.chinese: 这把钥匙能打开前门。

candidates.english: Every kid received a small gift.
candidates.chinese: 每个孩子都收到了一份小礼物。

candidates.english: A little kid waved at the bus.
candidates.chinese: 一个小孩朝公共汽车挥手。

candidates.english: The kid in the yellow hat likes drawing.
candidates.chinese: 戴黄帽子的小孩喜欢画画。

candidates.english: Polluted water can kill fish.
candidates.chinese: 受污染的水会使鱼死亡。

candidates.english: A hard frost can kill small plants.
candidates.chinese: 严重的霜冻会杀死小植物。

candidates.english: Too little water may kill the young tree.
candidates.chinese: 水太少可能会杀死那棵小树。

candidates.english: The station is one kilometre from here.
candidates.chinese: 车站离这里一公里。

candidates.english: We walked half a kilometre to the museum.
candidates.chinese: 我们步行半公里到了博物馆。

candidates.english: The bridge is about one kilometre long.
candidates.chinese: 这座桥大约一公里长。

candidates.english: Mum kissed the baby goodnight.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈亲吻宝宝道晚安。

candidates.english: Dad gave his daughter a kiss on the forehead.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸亲吻了女儿的额头。

candidates.english: The child blew a kiss to Grandma.
candidates.chinese: 孩子给奶奶送了一个飞吻。

candidates.english: Dad is making soup in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸正在厨房里做汤。

candidates.english: There are clean plates in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 厨房里有干净的盘子。

candidates.english: Mum put fresh flowers by the kitchen window.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈把鲜花放在厨房窗边。

candidates.english: The red kite rose high above the field.
candidates.chinese: 红风筝高高飞过田野。

candidates.english: He bought a new kite for the picnic.
candidates.chinese: 他为野餐买了一个新风筝。

candidates.english: The kite danced in the spring wind.
candidates.chinese: 风筝在春风中飞舞。

candidates.english: An adult used a sharp knife to cut the bread.
candidates.chinese: 一位成年人用锋利的刀切面包。

candidates.english: Please use a butter knife for the jam.
candidates.chinese: 请用黄油刀抹果酱。

candidates.english: The cook washed the knife after cutting fruit.
candidates.chinese: 厨师切完水果后洗了刀。

candidates.english: Please knock before entering the room.
candidates.chinese: 进入房间前请先敲门。

candidates.english: I heard someone knock at the back door.
candidates.chinese: 我听见有人敲后门。

candidates.english: The teacher asked us to knock softly.
candidates.chinese: 老师让我们轻轻地敲。

candidates.english: Books can increase our knowledge of nature.
candidates.chinese: 书籍可以增进我们对自然的了解。

candidates.english: She has a good knowledge of Chinese history.
candidates.chinese: 她有丰富的中国历史知识。

candidates.english: This lesson gives students useful knowledge about food.
candidates.chinese: 这节课给学生提供有关食物的有用知识。

entries.reviewNotes: B：补出冠词，使搭配 has a good knowledge of 更自然。

candidates.english: We walked around the lake at sunset.
candidates.chinese: 日落时我们绕湖散步。

candidates.english: Many ducks swam across the lake.
candidates.chinese: 许多鸭子游过湖面。

candidates.english: The small hotel stands beside a quiet lake.
candidates.chinese: 那家小旅馆坐落在一个安静的湖边。

candidates.english: Music is a language shared by many people.
candidates.chinese: 音乐是许多人共同的语言。

candidates.english: English is an important language at school.
candidates.chinese: 英语是学校里一门重要的语言。

candidates.english: She wants to learn a new language this year.
candidates.chinese: 她今年想学一门新语言。

candidates.english: The law protects children from harm.
candidates.chinese: 法律保护儿童免受伤害。

candidates.english: Everyone should follow the traffic law.
candidates.chinese: 每个人都应该遵守交通法律。

candidates.english: A new law helps keep the park clean.
candidates.chinese: 一项新法律有助于保持公园整洁。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原句 The new law keeps the park clean 不够自然，改为 helps keep 表达更地道。

candidates.english: Lay the map flat on the table.
candidates.chinese: 把地图平放在桌上。

candidates.english: Lay your notebook beside the pencil box.
candidates.chinese: 把你的笔记本放在铅笔盒旁边。

candidates.english: Please lay the cards in a straight line.
candidates.chinese: 请把卡片放成一条直线。

candidates.english: The lazy cat slept in the sun all afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 那只懒猫整个下午都在阳光下睡觉。

candidates.english: I feel lazy on rainy Sunday mornings.
candidates.chinese: 下雨的周日早晨，我觉得很懒。

candidates.english: The lazy dog stayed under the table.
candidates.chinese: 那只懒惰的狗待在桌子下面。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句直接评价学生 lazy，有贬低学生的风险，改为中性的个人状态场景。

candidates.english: The bank is on the left side of the road.
candidates.chinese: 银行在道路左侧。

candidates.english: Raise your left hand, please.
candidates.chinese: 请举起你的左手。

candidates.english: The left pocket of my coat is empty.
candidates.chinese: 我外套左边的口袋是空的。

candidates.english: He hurt his leg during the match.
candidates.chinese: 他在比赛中伤了腿。

candidates.english: The table has one short leg.
candidates.chinese: 这张桌子有一条短腿。

candidates.english: She stretched each leg before running.
candidates.chinese: 她跑步前伸展每条腿。

candidates.english: Could you lend me your ruler?
candidates.chinese: 你能把尺子借给我吗？

candidates.english: My sister will lend me her dictionary.
candidates.chinese: 我姐姐会把她的词典借给我。

candidates.english: Can you lend this book to Jack?
candidates.chinese: 你能把这本书借给杰克吗？

candidates.english: Let me carry that heavy box.
candidates.chinese: 让我来搬那个重箱子。

candidates.english: Please let the children play outside.
candidates.chinese: 请让孩子们在外面玩。

candidates.english: The guard let us enter the hall.
candidates.chinese: 保安让我们进入大厅。

candidates.english: I wrote a letter to my old friend.
candidates.chinese: 我给老朋友写了一封信。

candidates.english: A letter arrived from my cousin today.
candidates.chinese: 今天收到了一封我表亲寄来的信。

candidates.english: She put the letter into a white envelope.
candidates.chinese: 她把信放进一个白色信封里。

candidates.english: The library closes at six today.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆今天六点关门。

candidates.english: We borrowed three books from the library.
candidates.chinese: 我们从图书馆借了三本书。

candidates.english: The town library has a bright reading room.
candidates.chinese: 镇图书馆有一间明亮的阅览室。

entries.reviewNotes: C 与其他批次例句重复，改为不同的图书馆场景。

candidates.english: Take the lift to the fifth floor.
candidates.chinese: 乘电梯到五楼。

candidates.english: The lift stopped on the second floor.
candidates.chinese: 电梯停在了二楼。

candidates.english: There is a lift near the front desk.
candidates.chinese: 前台附近有一部电梯。

candidates.english: Please wait in line outside the hall.
candidates.chinese: 请在大厅外排队等候。

candidates.english: There was a long line at the school gate.
candidates.chinese: 学校门口排着长队。

candidates.english: Join the line before you get your lunch.
candidates.chinese: 领午餐前先排队。

candidates.english: I made a list of things to buy.
candidates.chinese: 我列了一张购物清单。

candidates.english: The teacher wrote a list of names on the board.
candidates.chinese: 老师在黑板上写了一份名单。

candidates.english: Dad checked the list before packing the bag.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在收拾包前核对了清单。

candidates.english: Please put your litter in the bin.
candidates.chinese: 请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。

candidates.english: There was some litter under the park bench.
candidates.chinese: 公园长椅下面有一些垃圾。

candidates.english: The students picked up litter after the picnic.
candidates.chinese: 学生们在野餐后捡起了垃圾。

candidates.english: The lively child asked many questions.
candidates.chinese: 那个活泼的孩子问了许多问题。

candidates.english: Our music teacher is lively and friendly.
candidates.chinese: 我们的音乐老师活泼又友好。

candidates.english: The lively puppy ran around the garden.
candidates.chinese: 那只活泼的小狗在花园里跑来跑去。

candidates.english: We bought vegetables from a local farmer.
candidates.chinese: 我们从当地农民那里买了蔬菜。

candidates.english: The local library opens at nine.
candidates.chinese: 当地的图书馆九点开门。

candidates.english: We visited a local museum on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期五参观了当地的一家博物馆。

candidates.english: Remember to lock the door before leaving.
candidates.chinese: 离开前记得锁门。

candidates.english: Please lock your bike near the gate.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的自行车锁在大门附近。

candidates.english: I always lock the classroom after club practice.
candidates.chinese: 社团练习后我总是锁上教室。

candidates.english: We got lost in the old town.
candidates.chinese: 我们在古镇里迷路了。

candidates.english: The lost boy asked a teacher for help.
candidates.chinese: 那个迷路的男孩向老师求助。

candidates.english: I was lost in the large station.
candidates.chinese: 我在那个大车站里迷路了。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原句 felt lost 容易表示“不知所措”，不够精确对应“迷路的”，改为明确的迷路场景。

candidates.english: We learned a lot from the science trip.
candidates.chinese: 我们从科学之旅中学到了很多。

candidates.english: A lot of students joined the art club.
candidates.chinese: 许多学生加入了美术社团。

candidates.english: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 书架上有许多书。

entries.reviewNotes: B、C：原 highlight 未完整覆盖表示“许多”的短语 a lot of，已补全。

candidates.english: We had a lovely afternoon by the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们在湖边度过了一个美好的下午。

candidates.english: What a lovely morning for a walk!
candidates.chinese: 多么适合散步的美好早晨啊！

candidates.english: Grandma told us a lovely story after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后奶奶给我们讲了一个美好的故事。

candidates.english: The wall is low enough to see over.
candidates.chinese: 这堵墙很低，可以看到另一边。

candidates.english: The table is too low for this chair.
candidates.chinese: 这张桌子对这把椅子来说太低了。

candidates.english: A low shelf is easy for children to reach.
candidates.chinese: 低矮的架子方便孩子们够到。

candidates.english: This machine turns old paper into new paper.
candidates.chinese: 这台机器把废纸变成新纸。

candidates.english: The washing machine is in the bathroom.
candidates.chinese: 洗衣机在浴室里。

candidates.english: This machine prints tickets at the station.
candidates.chinese: 这台机器在车站打印车票。

candidates.english: Mum was mad at me for coming home late.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈因我晚回家而生气。

candidates.english: Tom got mad when he lost his notebook.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆丢了笔记本时生气了。

candidates.english: My sister was mad when she saw the broken cup.
candidates.chinese: 我姐姐看到碎了的杯子时很生气。

entries.reviewNotes: C：原句 mad about 容易产生歧义，改为更明确自然地表达“生气的”。

candidates.english: The magician showed us a simple magic trick.
candidates.chinese: 魔术师给我们表演了一个简单的魔术。

candidates.english: The children watched a magic show at school.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在学校观看了一场魔术表演。

candidates.english: He learned a magic trick with a coin.
candidates.chinese: 他学了一个用硬币表演的魔术。

candidates.english: A man helped us carry the heavy table.
candidates.chinese: 一名男子帮助我们搬这张重桌子。

candidates.english: The man at the desk gave me a form.
candidates.chinese: 桌旁的那名男子给了我一张表格。

candidates.english: Two men waited outside the shop.
candidates.chinese: 两名成年男子在商店外等候。

candidates.english: She answered in a calm manner.
candidates.chinese: 她以冷静的方式作了回答。

candidates.english: Please speak in a polite manner.
candidates.chinese: 请以礼貌的方式说话。

candidates.english: He solved the problem in a simple manner.
candidates.chinese: 他用简单的方式解决了这个问题。

candidates.english: The map shows every path in the park.
candidates.chinese: 这张地图标出了公园里的每条小路。

candidates.english: I used a map to find the library.
candidates.chinese: 我用地图找到了图书馆。

candidates.english: This map shows the bus stops near our school.
candidates.chinese: 这张地图显示了我们学校附近的公交站。

candidates.english: Ella received a high mark in English.
candidates.chinese: 埃拉的英语得了高分。

candidates.english: My mark for the math quiz was eighty.
candidates.chinese: 我数学小测的分数是八十分。

candidates.english: He checked his mark after the test.
candidates.chinese: 考试后他查看了自己的分数。

candidates.english: They plan to marry next spring.
candidates.chinese: 他们计划明年春天结婚。

candidates.english: My aunt will marry in October.
candidates.chinese: 我的姑姑将在十月结婚。

candidates.english: In the story, the queen will marry next week.
candidates.chinese: 在这个故事里，女王将在下周结婚。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句“after many years together”带有恋爱情境，不适合该安全要求；改为中性故事语境。

candidates.english: Practice helps you master a new skill.
candidates.chinese: 练习帮助你掌握一项新技能。

candidates.english: You can master the song with daily practice.
candidates.chinese: 你可以通过每天练习掌握这首歌。

candidates.english: Lily wants to master basic cooking skills.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉想掌握基本的烹饪技能。

candidates.english: Wood is a useful building material.
candidates.chinese: 木材是一种实用的建筑材料。

candidates.english: Cotton is a soft material for shirts.
candidates.chinese: 棉是一种适合做衬衫的柔软材料。

candidates.english: We need strong material for the kite.
candidates.chinese: 我们需要结实的材料来做风筝。

candidates.english: We need to discuss an important matter.
candidates.chinese: 我们需要讨论一件重要的事情。

candidates.english: This matter can wait until Monday.
candidates.chinese: 这件事情可以等到星期一再处理。

candidates.english: The class meeting began with a small matter.
candidates.chinese: 班会从一件小事开始。

candidates.english: It may rain later this afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 今天下午晚些时候可能会下雨。

candidates.english: She may arrive before six o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 她可能六点前到达。

candidates.english: The shop may close early today.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店今天可能会早关门。

candidates.english: Maybe we can visit the museum tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 也许我们明天可以参观博物馆。

candidates.english: Maybe he left his keys at home.
candidates.chinese: 也许他把钥匙落在家里了。

candidates.english: Maybe the bus will come soon.
candidates.chinese: 也许公交车很快就会来。

candidates.english: Please show me the way to the station.
candidates.chinese: 请告诉我去车站的路。

candidates.english: Can you help me carry this box?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？

candidates.english: My brother gave me a blue pen.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥给了我一支蓝色钢笔。

candidates.english: Breakfast is an important meal.
candidates.chinese: 早餐是重要的一餐。

candidates.english: We shared a warm meal after the game.
candidates.chinese: 比赛后我们一起吃了一顿热乎的饭。

candidates.english: Lunch is my favorite meal of the day.
candidates.chinese: 午餐是我一天中最喜欢的一餐。

candidates.english: We added some meat to the soup.
candidates.chinese: 我们在汤里加了一些肉。

candidates.english: The cook cut the meat into small pieces.
candidates.chinese: 厨师把肉切成小块。

candidates.english: There is no meat in this vegetable dish.
candidates.chinese: 这道蔬菜菜肴里没有肉。

candidates.english: She won a gold medal in the race.
candidates.chinese: 她在比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

candidates.english: Jack kept his medal in a small box.
candidates.chinese: 杰克把他的奖牌放在一个小盒子里。

candidates.english: Our class received a medal for the sports day.
candidates.chinese: 我们班在运动日获得了一枚奖牌。

candidates.english: The village needs better medical care.
candidates.chinese: 这个村庄需要更好的医疗服务。

candidates.english: A medical team visited our school today.
candidates.chinese: 一支医疗队今天访问了我们学校。

candidates.english: The hospital opened a new medical center.
candidates.chinese: 这家医院开设了一个新的医疗中心。

candidates.english: Take this medicine after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 早餐后服用这种药。

candidates.english: The doctor gave him medicine for his cough.
candidates.chinese: 医生给了他治咳嗽的药。

candidates.english: Keep the medicine in a cool place.
candidates.chinese: 把药放在阴凉处保存。

candidates.english: Every team member has a different job.
candidates.chinese: 每个团队成员都有不同的任务。

candidates.english: She is a new member of the chess club.
candidates.chinese: 她是国际象棋俱乐部的新成员。

candidates.english: One member of our group drew the poster.
candidates.chinese: 我们小组的一名成员画了海报。

candidates.english: She mentioned your idea during the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 她在会议期间提到了你的想法。

candidates.english: Please mention my name at the front desk.
candidates.chinese: 请在前台提到我的名字。

candidates.english: He did not mention the homework in class.
candidates.chinese: 他在课堂上没有提到作业。

candidates.english: The menu includes several vegetarian dishes.
candidates.chinese: 菜单上有几道素菜。

candidates.english: Can I see the lunch menu, please?
candidates.chinese: 请给我看一下午餐菜单好吗？

candidates.english: The waiter brought us a new menu.
candidates.chinese: 服务员给我们拿来了一份新菜单。

candidates.english: Your books are in a mess on the floor.
candidates.chinese: 你的书杂乱地堆在地板上。

candidates.english: The kitchen was a mess after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 早饭后厨房一片杂乱。

candidates.english: There is a mess of papers on my desk.
candidates.chinese: 我的书桌上有一堆杂乱的纸。

candidates.english: I left a message for your teacher.
candidates.chinese: 我给你的老师留了一条消息。

candidates.english: Tom sent me a message after school.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆放学后给我发了一条消息。

candidates.english: Did you read the message on the board?
candidates.chinese: 你读公告板上的那条消息了吗？

candidates.english: This method makes the task much easier.
candidates.chinese: 这个方法让任务容易多了。

candidates.english: Our teacher showed us a new method for reading.
candidates.chinese: 老师教给我们一种新的阅读方法。

candidates.english: This method helps me remember words.
candidates.chinese: 这个方法帮助我记单词。

candidates.english: The table is one metre long.
candidates.chinese: 这张桌子长一米。

candidates.english: The rope is five metres long.
candidates.chinese: 这根绳子长五米。

candidates.english: Stand one metre away from the wall.
candidates.chinese: 站在离墙一米远的地方。

candidates.english: A tall tree stands in the middle of the garden.
candidates.chinese: 花园中央立着一棵高树。

candidates.english: Put the vase in the middle of the table.
candidates.chinese: 把花瓶放在桌子中间。

candidates.english: I sat in the middle row of the bus.
candidates.chinese: 我坐在公交车的中间一排。

candidates.english: We might see snow tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我们今晚可能会看到雪。

candidates.english: It might rain after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后可能会下雨。

candidates.english: She might come to the library later.
candidates.chinese: 她稍后可能会来图书馆。

candidates.english: Please buy some milk on your way home.
candidates.chinese: 回家路上请买些牛奶。

candidates.english: I drink milk with breakfast every day.
candidates.chinese: 我每天早餐喝牛奶。

candidates.english: There is a glass of milk on the table.
candidates.chinese: 桌上有一杯牛奶。

candidates.english: That blue pencil case is mine.
candidates.chinese: 那个蓝色铅笔盒是我的。

candidates.english: This red notebook is mine.
candidates.chinese: 这个红色笔记本是我的。

candidates.english: The seat by the window is mine.
candidates.chinese: 靠窗的座位是我的。

candidates.english: She looked at herself in the mirror.
candidates.chinese: 她照镜子看自己。

candidates.english: There is a small mirror in the bathroom.
candidates.chinese: 浴室里有一面小镜子。

candidates.english: He cleaned the mirror with a soft cloth.
candidates.chinese: 他用软布擦了镜子。

candidates.english: Mix the flour and water in a bowl.
candidates.chinese: 把面粉和水在碗里混合。

candidates.english: Mix the fruit with yogurt.
candidates.chinese: 把水果和酸奶混合。

candidates.english: Please mix these colors carefully.
candidates.chinese: 请仔细混合这些颜色。

candidates.english: A mobile library visits the village every week.
candidates.chinese: 流动图书馆每周都会来到这个村庄。

candidates.english: The school uses a mobile science lab.
candidates.chinese: 学校使用一个流动科学实验室。

candidates.english: A mobile shop sells fruit near the park.
candidates.chinese: 一家流动商店在公园附近卖水果。

candidates.english: The city has a modern train station.
candidates.chinese: 这座城市有一个现代化火车站。

candidates.english: We study in a modern classroom.
candidates.chinese: 我们在一间现代化教室里学习。

candidates.english: This modern kitchen is bright and clean.
candidates.chinese: 这个现代化厨房明亮又干净。

candidates.english: Please wait here for a moment.
candidates.chinese: 请在这里稍等片刻。

candidates.english: He thought for a moment before answering.
candidates.chinese: 他回答前思考了片刻。

candidates.english: The room was quiet for a moment.
candidates.chinese: 房间安静了片刻。

candidates.english: The monkey climbed to the top of the tree.
candidates.chinese: 猴子爬到了树顶。

candidates.english: A monkey ate a banana at the zoo.
candidates.chinese: 一只猴子在动物园里吃香蕉。

candidates.english: The little monkey sat beside its mother.
candidates.chinese: 小猴子坐在它妈妈旁边。

candidates.english: Next month we will start a new project.
candidates.chinese: 下个月我们将开始一个新项目。

candidates.english: This month has thirty days.
candidates.chinese: 这个月有三十天。

candidates.english: I visit my grandparents once a month.
candidates.chinese: 我每月看望一次祖父母。

candidates.english: The moon appeared above the mountains.
candidates.chinese: 月亮出现在群山上方。

candidates.english: The moon looked round and bright tonight.
candidates.chinese: 今晚月亮看起来又圆又亮。

candidates.english: We saw the moon through the window.
candidates.chinese: 我们透过窗户看到了月亮。

candidates.english: My mother works at a primary school.
candidates.chinese: 我的母亲在一所小学工作。

candidates.english: His mother made breakfast early.
candidates.chinese: 他的母亲很早做了早餐。

candidates.english: My mother reads with me every evening.
candidates.chinese: 我的母亲每天晚上和我一起读书。

candidates.english: Snow covered the top of the mountain.
candidates.chinese: 白雪覆盖了山顶。

candidates.english: We walked up a small mountain in spring.
candidates.chinese: 春天我们爬上了一座小山。

candidates.english: The mountain behind our school is green.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校后面的山是绿色的。

candidates.english: Cover your mouth when you cough.
candidates.chinese: 咳嗽时捂住嘴。

candidates.english: The child opened his mouth to speak.
candidates.chinese: 那个孩子张开嘴说话。

candidates.english: Brush your teeth and rinse your mouth.
candidates.chinese: 刷牙并漱口。

candidates.english: We watched a funny movie last night.
candidates.chinese: 我们昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。

candidates.english: This movie is about school life.
candidates.chinese: 这部电影是关于校园生活的。

candidates.english: Dad bought tickets for the afternoon movie.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸买了下午场电影的票。

candidates.english: The museum displays many ancient objects.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆展出了许多古代物品。

candidates.english: Our class visited the science museum.
candidates.chinese: 我们班参观了科学博物馆。

candidates.english: The museum opens at nine in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆早上九点开放。

candidates.english: Soft music helped the baby sleep.
candidates.chinese: 轻柔的音乐帮助宝宝入睡。

candidates.english: I like listening to music after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐。

candidates.english: The music from the piano was beautiful.
candidates.chinese: 钢琴传出的音乐很美。

candidates.english: Passengers must wear seat belts.
candidates.chinese: 乘客必须系安全带。

candidates.english: You must finish the form before Friday.
candidates.chinese: 你必须在星期五前填完表格。

candidates.english: We must keep the classroom clean.
candidates.chinese: 我们必须保持教室干净。

candidates.english: My school is near the river.
candidates.chinese: 我的学校在河边。

candidates.english: My bag is under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 我的包在椅子下面。

candidates.english: This is my favorite picture.
candidates.chinese: 这是我最喜欢的照片。

candidates.english: I painted the room myself.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间是我亲自粉刷的。

candidates.english: I made this card myself.
candidates.chinese: 这张卡片是我自己做的。

candidates.english: I can carry the box myself.
candidates.chinese: 我可以自己搬这个箱子。

candidates.english: Students across the nation joined the reading event.
candidates.chinese: 全国各地的学生参加了这次阅读活动。

candidates.english: Every nation has its own history.
candidates.chinese: 每个国家都有自己的历史。

candidates.english: People in this nation speak many languages.
candidates.chinese: 这个国家的人说多种语言。

candidates.english: We waited nearly an hour for the bus.
candidates.chinese: 我们等公交车等了将近一小时。

candidates.english: The bottle is nearly empty.
candidates.chinese: 这个瓶子几乎空了。

candidates.english: Nearly everyone in our class joined the trip.
candidates.chinese: 我们班几乎每个人都参加了这次旅行。

candidates.english: Our neighbour helped us repair the fence.
candidates.chinese: 我们的邻居帮助我们修理了篱笆。

candidates.english: My neighbour waters our plants when we travel.
candidates.chinese: 我们旅行时，我的邻居帮我们给植物浇水。

candidates.english: The new neighbour lives on the second floor.
candidates.chinese: 新邻居住在二楼。

candidates.english: I need a new notebook for science.
candidates.chinese: 我的科学课需要一本新笔记本。

candidates.english: She bought a new schoolbag yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 她昨天买了一个新书包。

candidates.english: There is a new clock on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 墙上有一个新钟。

candidates.english: I have some good news to share.
candidates.chinese: 我有一些好消息要分享。

candidates.english: The news made my parents happy.
candidates.chinese: 这个消息让我父母很高兴。

candidates.english: Did you hear the news about the school trip?
candidates.chinese: 你听说学校旅行的消息了吗？

candidates.english: The next train leaves at ten.
candidates.chinese: 下一班火车十点出发。

candidates.english: Please turn to the next page.
candidates.chinese: 请翻到下一页。

candidates.english: My next class starts after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我的下一节课午饭后开始。

candidates.english: The new student was nice to everyone.
candidates.chinese: 这名新生对每个人都很友好。

candidates.english: Our neighbor is always nice to children.
candidates.chinese: 我们的邻居总是对孩子们很友好。

candidates.english: The shop assistant was nice and helped me choose a pen.
candidates.chinese: 店员很友好，帮我挑了一支钢笔。

candidates.english: The stars were bright last night.
candidates.chinese: 昨晚星星很明亮。

candidates.english: We arrived home late at night.
candidates.chinese: 我们深夜才到家。

candidates.english: The street is quiet at night.
candidates.chinese: 这条街在夜晚很安静。

candidates.english: Nobody knew the answer to the question.
candidates.chinese: 没有人知道这个问题的答案。

candidates.english: Nobody was in the music room after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后音乐教室里没有人。

candidates.english: Nobody called me this morning.
candidates.chinese: 今天早上没有人给我打电话。

candidates.english: She nodded to show that she agreed.
candidates.chinese: 她点头表示同意。

candidates.english: Tom nodded when he heard his name.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆听到自己的名字时点了点头。

candidates.english: The teacher nodded and let us begin.
candidates.chinese: 老师点了点头，让我们开始。

candidates.english: I checked the boxes, but none were empty.
candidates.chinese: 我检查了这些箱子，但没有一个是空的。

candidates.english: I invited three friends, but none came.
candidates.chinese: 我邀请了三个朋友，但没有一个来。

candidates.english: There were many chairs, but none were blue.
candidates.chinese: 那里有很多椅子，但没有一把是蓝色的。

entries.reviewNotes: C：将“none was blue”改为“none were blue”，与 many chairs 的复数语境搭配更自然。

candidates.english: I had a bowl of noodles for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我午餐吃了一碗面条。

candidates.english: The noodles smell delicious.
candidates.chinese: 这些面条闻起来很香。

candidates.english: Dad cooked tomato noodles for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸晚餐做了番茄面条。

candidates.english: He can neither read nor write in French.
candidates.chinese: 他既不会读法语，也不会用法语写。

candidates.english: Neither Jack nor Lily wanted more rice.
candidates.chinese: 杰克和莉莉都不想再要米饭。

candidates.english: The room had neither a desk nor a chair.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间既没有书桌，也没有椅子。

candidates.english: Her temperature is normal again.
candidates.chinese: 她的体温又恢复正常了。

candidates.english: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
candidates.chinese: 考试前感到紧张是正常的。

candidates.english: The bus service is back to normal today.
candidates.chinese: 今天公交服务恢复正常了。

candidates.chinese: 强风从北方吹来。

candidates.chinese: 我的祖父母住在北方。

candidates.english: Snow is common in the north in winter.
candidates.chinese: 北方冬天常见下雪。

candidates.english: The cold air made my nose red.
candidates.chinese: 冷空气冻红了我的鼻子。

candidates.chinese: 他用一根手指碰了碰鼻子。

candidates.english: My nose hurts when I sneeze.
candidates.chinese: 我打喷嚏时鼻子疼。

candidates.english: Write the new words in your notebook.
candidates.chinese: 把新单词写在笔记本里。

candidates.english: I left my notebook on the bus.
candidates.chinese: 我把笔记本落在公交车上了。

candidates.english: This notebook has a blue cover.
candidates.chinese: 这个笔记本有蓝色封面。

candidates.english: She borrowed a historical novel from the library.
candidates.chinese: 她从图书馆借了一本历史小说。

candidates.english: He reads a short novel every month.
candidates.chinese: 他每个月读一本短篇小说。

candidates.english: The novel tells a story about a small town.
candidates.chinese: 这本小说讲述了一个小镇的故事。

candidates.english: We need to leave now.
candidates.chinese: 我们现在需要离开。

candidates.english: The meeting is starting now.
candidates.chinese: 会议现在开始。

candidates.english: I am doing my homework now.
candidates.chinese: 我现在正在做作业。

candidates.english: The nurse gave the patient some water.
candidates.chinese: 护士给病人喝了些水。

candidates.english: A nurse checked my brother's arm.
candidates.chinese: 一名护士检查了我弟弟的胳膊。

candidates.english: The nurse spoke softly to the old man.
candidates.chinese: 护士轻声和那位老人说话。

candidates.english: Plastic waste harms animals in the ocean.
candidates.chinese: 塑料垃圾会伤害海洋里的动物。

candidates.chinese: 轮船横渡了海洋。

candidates.chinese: 许多种鱼生活在海洋里。

entries.reviewNotes: B：中文“驶过海洋”不够自然准确，改为“横渡了海洋”。

candidates.english: The head teacher is in her office.
candidates.chinese: 校长在她的办公室里。

candidates.chinese: 请把这张表送到学校办公室。

candidates.english: My mother works in a small office.
candidates.chinese: 我妈妈在一间小办公室工作。

candidates.chinese: 一名警官帮助我们过马路。

candidates.chinese: 警官让我们在门边等候。

candidates.english: A police officer gave directions to the visitors.
candidates.chinese: 一名警官给游客指路。

candidates.chinese: 我们在网上订了票。

candidates.english: She studies English online after school.
candidates.chinese: 她放学后在网上学英语。

candidates.chinese: 我在网上查到了博物馆的开放时间。

candidates.chinese: 只有受过训练的工人才能操作这台机器。

candidates.english: Can you operate the new printer?
candidates.chinese: 你会操作这台新打印机吗？

candidates.english: The guide showed us how to operate the camera.
candidates.chinese: 导游向我们展示了如何操作相机。

candidates.english: The bank is opposite the post office.
candidates.chinese: 银行在邮局对面。

candidates.english: The bookstore is opposite the bus stop.
candidates.chinese: 书店在公交车站对面。

candidates.english: Our hotel is opposite a small park.
candidates.chinese: 我们的旅馆在一个小公园对面。

candidates.english: I put an orange in my lunch box.
candidates.chinese: 我在午餐盒里放了一个橙子。

candidates.chinese: 她给弟弟剥了一个橙子。

candidates.english: This orange tastes sweet.
candidates.chinese: 这个橙子尝起来很甜。

candidates.english: Students organised a clean-up day at school.
candidates.chinese: 学生们在学校组织了一次清洁日活动。

candidates.english: The club will organise a reading activity.
candidates.chinese: 俱乐部将组织一次阅读活动。

candidates.english: Our teacher asked us to organise the class picnic.
candidates.chinese: 老师让我们组织班级野餐。

entries.reviewNotes: B：“reading party”搭配不够自然，改为更适合教学语境的“reading activity”。

candidates.english: Our classroom is on the second floor.
candidates.chinese: 我们的教室在二楼。

candidates.english: Our team practises every Friday.
candidates.chinese: 我们的队每周五练习。

candidates.english: We cleaned our desks before the lesson.
candidates.chinese: 上课前我们清理了自己的课桌。

entries.reviewNotes: C：中文“我们的课桌”略生硬，改为更自然且准确表达归属的“自己的课桌”。

candidates.english: Their classroom is larger than ours.
candidates.chinese: 他们的教室比我们的教室大。

candidates.english: This table is ours for the group work.
candidates.chinese: 这张桌子是我们小组活动用的。

candidates.english: The red umbrellas are ours.
candidates.chinese: 这些红伞是我们的。

candidates.english: We made the decorations ourselves.
candidates.chinese: 我们自己制作了装饰品。

candidates.english: We cleaned the classroom ourselves.
candidates.chinese: 我们自己打扫了教室。

candidates.english: We found the way to the museum ourselves.
candidates.chinese: 我们自己找到了去博物馆的路。

candidates.english: Your friends are waiting outside the gate.
candidates.chinese: 你的朋友们正在大门外等候。

candidates.english: The bike is parked outside the library.
candidates.chinese: 自行车停在图书馆外面。

candidates.english: Please put your wet shoes outside the room.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的湿鞋放在房间外面。

candidates.english: We need to pack our bags tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我们今晚需要收拾行李。

candidates.english: I will pack my suitcase before breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我会在早饭前收拾好行李箱。

candidates.chinese: 她帮弟弟为旅行收拾行李。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“pack my clothes”偏向收拾衣服，改为“pack my suitcase”以更准确体现“收拾行李”。

candidates.english: Turn to page twenty in your book.
candidates.chinese: 把书翻到第二十页。

candidates.chinese: 这个故事从第五页开始。

candidates.english: There is a map on the last page.
candidates.chinese: 最后一页上有一张地图。

candidates.english: I bought a new pair of shoes.
candidates.chinese: 我买了一双新鞋。

candidates.english: She put on a warm pair of socks.
candidates.chinese: 她穿上了一双暖和的袜子。

candidates.english: Tom needs a pair of gloves for winter.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆冬天需要一双手套。

candidates.english: The panda was eating bamboo leaves.
candidates.chinese: 那只大熊猫正在吃竹叶。

candidates.chinese: 一只大熊猫宝宝在妈妈身边玩耍。

candidates.english: We saw a panda at the zoo.
candidates.chinese: 我们在动物园看见了一只大熊猫。

candidates.english: Please write your answer on the paper.
candidates.chinese: 请把答案写在纸上。

candidates.english: She folded the paper into a boat.
candidates.chinese: 她把纸折成了一只小船。

candidates.english: I need clean paper for my drawing.
candidates.chinese: 我画画需要干净的纸。

candidates.english: A parent signed the permission form.
candidates.chinese: 一位家长在同意书上签了字。

candidates.english: Each parent waited outside the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 每位家长都在教室外等候。

candidates.english: A parent asked about the homework plan.
candidates.chinese: 一位家长询问了作业安排。

candidates.english: Families were having picnics in the park.
candidates.chinese: 许多家庭正在公园里野餐。

candidates.english: We walked through the park after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们穿过了公园。

candidates.english: There are tall trees in the park.
candidates.chinese: 公园里有高大的树。

candidates.english: We are planning a party for Saturday.
candidates.chinese: 我们正在筹划星期六的聚会。

candidates.chinese: 安娜带了水果去班级聚会。

candidates.english: The birthday party ended at six.
candidates.chinese: 生日聚会六点结束。

candidates.english: The town was much smaller in the past.
candidates.chinese: 这座城镇过去小得多。

candidates.chinese: 过去人们更常寄信。

candidates.english: My grandfather often talks about the past.
candidates.chinese: 我爷爷经常谈起过去。

candidates.english: We have PE on Tuesday afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期二下午有体育课。

candidates.chinese: 今天体育课上我们玩了一个新游戏。

candidates.chinese: 明天体育课带上你的运动鞋。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句中的“PE teacher”对应“体育老师”，没有直接体现“体育课”，已改为体育课场景。

candidates.english: May I borrow your blue pen?
candidates.chinese: 我可以借你的蓝色笔吗？

candidates.english: This pen writes very smoothly.
candidates.chinese: 这支笔写起来很流畅。

candidates.english: He put the pen back in his bag.
candidates.chinese: 他把笔放回了书包。

candidates.chinese: 我的铅笔太短了，不能用了。

candidates.chinese: 考试前她削了铅笔。

candidates.chinese: 我们班将表演一个短剧。

candidates.chinese: 学生们将在学校表演一首歌。

candidates.chinese: 她想在才艺展示中表演。

candidates.chinese: 他把个人物品放在这个抽屉里。

entries.reviewNotes: C：personal password 搭配不够自然，且与A的个人信息安全场景接近，改为个人物品场景。

candidates.chinese: 她穿着粉红色外套参加聚会。

candidates.chinese: 那个女孩选了一个粉红色的笔记本。

candidates.english: Pink flowers grew beside the path.
candidates.chinese: 小路旁长着粉红色的花。

candidates.chinese: 我们午饭分吃了一个蔬菜比萨饼。

candidates.chinese: 爸爸把比萨饼切成八块。

candidates.chinese: 这个比萨饼上有西红柿和奶酪。

candidates.chinese: 飞机在雨中安全降落。

candidates.chinese: 我们看着飞机离开机场。

candidates.chinese: 火星是太空中的一颗红色行星。

candidates.chinese: 科学书清楚地展示了每颗行星。

candidates.chinese: 这个瓶子由再生塑料制成。

candidates.chinese: 这个塑料杯又轻又结实。

candidates.chinese: 孩子们跑过操场。

candidates.chinese: 学生们在操场上排队。

candidates.chinese: 放学后操场很安静。

candidates.chinese: 篮子里有很多苹果。

entries.reviewNotes: B、C：原中文“大量时间”“大量苹果”不够自然，改为更符合plenty of语境的译法。

candidates.english: The police closed the road after the accident.
candidates.chinese: 事故发生后，警方封闭了道路。

candidates.chinese: 警方在学校附近帮助指挥交通。

candidates.chinese: 一名男警察给我们指了去车站的路。

candidates.chinese: 那名女警察在门口回答问题。

candidates.chinese: 游泳池每天上午九点开放。

candidates.english: The hotel pool is clean and warm.
candidates.chinese: 酒店的游泳池干净又暖和。

candidates.chinese: 把椅子移回原来的位置。

candidates.chinese: 请在地图上标出你家的位置。

candidates.english: The lamp is in a good position for reading.
candidates.chinese: 这盏灯的位置很适合阅读。

candidates.english: Has today's post arrived yet?
candidates.chinese: 今天的邮件到了吗？

candidates.chinese: 按下这个键开始播放歌曲。

candidates.chinese: 她按了开关，灯亮了。

candidates.english: A pretty flower grew beside the path.
candidates.chinese: 小路旁长着一朵漂亮的花。

candidates.chinese: 她穿了一条漂亮的连衣裙去聚会。

candidates.english: The room looks pretty with blue curtains.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间配上蓝色窗帘看起来很漂亮。

candidates.english: The price of the ticket includes lunch.
candidates.chinese: 票价包含午餐。

candidates.chinese: 这支钢笔的价格是五元。

candidates.english: Can you check the price of the notebook?
candidates.chinese: 你能查一下这本笔记本的价格吗？

candidates.english: This diary is private, so please do not read it.
candidates.chinese: 这本日记是私人的，请不要看。

candidates.english: He keeps his private photos in a drawer.
candidates.chinese: 他把私人照片放在抽屉里。

candidates.english: She uses a private email address for family messages.
candidates.chinese: 她用一个私人邮箱收发家人的消息。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句 private room for teachers 更像“专用的/非公开的房间”，不够准确体现“私人的”；已改为私人邮箱场景。

candidates.english: The winner received a book as a prize.
candidates.chinese: 获胜者得到一本书作为奖品。

candidates.english: The prize for the class game was a new notebook.
candidates.chinese: 班级游戏的奖品是一本新笔记本。

candidates.english: She chose a pencil box as her prize.
candidates.chinese: 她选择了一个铅笔盒作为奖品。

entries.reviewNotes: B 原句 first prize 容易理解为“一等奖/奖项”，不够精准体现“奖品”；已改为具体奖品。

candidates.english: It will probably rain this evening.
candidates.chinese: 今天晚上很可能会下雨。

candidates.english: Tom is probably at the library now.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆现在很可能在图书馆。

candidates.english: The bus will probably arrive in ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 公交车很可能十分钟后到。

candidates.english: This local product is made from bamboo.
candidates.chinese: 这种本地产品由竹子制成。

candidates.english: This new product is easy to use.
candidates.chinese: 这款新产品很容易使用。

candidates.english: The shop sells a popular milk product.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店销售一种受欢迎的奶制产品。

candidates.english: We watched a wildlife programme after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们看了一个野生动物节目。

candidates.english: My sister likes this music programme.
candidates.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢这个音乐节目。

candidates.english: The cooking program starts at seven.
candidates.chinese: 这个烹饪节目七点开始。

candidates.english: You have made good progress in reading.
candidates.chinese: 你在阅读方面取得了很大进步。

candidates.english: Her progress in math made her parents happy.
candidates.chinese: 她在数学上的进步让父母很高兴。

candidates.english: We can see clear progress after two weeks.
candidates.chinese: 两周后我们能看到明显的进步。

candidates.english: Our science project is about clean water.
candidates.chinese: 我们的科学项目与清洁水源有关。

candidates.english: They finished the art project on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 他们星期五完成了美术项目。

candidates.english: Our class project needs three posters.
candidates.chinese: 我们的班级项目需要三张海报。

candidates.english: Can you pronounce this word correctly?
candidates.chinese: 你能正确读出这个单词吗？

candidates.english: Please pronounce my name slowly.
candidates.chinese: 请慢慢读出我的名字。

candidates.english: He pronounced the new word clearly.
candidates.chinese: 他清楚地读出了这个新单词。

candidates.english: The school will publish our stories online.
candidates.chinese: 学校将在网上发表我们的故事。

candidates.english: The writer will publish a new book next month.
candidates.chinese: 这位作家下个月将出版一本新书。

candidates.english: They published the class magazine in June.
candidates.chinese: 他们在六月出版了班级杂志。

candidates.english: The purpose of the meeting is to share ideas.
candidates.chinese: 这次会议的目的是分享想法。

candidates.english: What is the purpose of this game?
candidates.chinese: 这个游戏的目的是什么？

candidates.english: The purpose of the sign is to give directions.
candidates.chinese: 这个标志的目的是指路。

candidates.english: The quality of this paper is very good.
candidates.chinese: 这种纸的质量很好。

candidates.english: The quality of the bag is better than before.
candidates.chinese: 这个包的质量比以前更好了。

candidates.english: We should check the quality before buying it.
candidates.chinese: 购买前我们应该检查质量。

candidates.english: The lesson starts at a quarter past eight.
candidates.chinese: 这节课八点一刻开始。

candidates.english: I waited for a quarter of an hour at the bus stop.
candidates.chinese: 我在公交车站等了一刻钟。

candidates.english: The train leaves at a quarter to six.
candidates.chinese: 火车五点四十五分离开。

candidates.english: Please answer the final question.
candidates.chinese: 请回答最后一个问题。

candidates.english: I have a question about this sentence.
candidates.chinese: 我有一个关于这个句子的问题。

candidates.english: The teacher wrote a question on the board.
candidates.chinese: 老师在黑板上写了一个问题。

candidates.english: The library is quite busy today.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆今天相当忙。

candidates.english: This story is quite interesting.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事相当有趣。

candidates.english: The classroom was quite quiet after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后教室相当安静。

candidates.english: Grandpa listens to the radio every morning.
candidates.chinese: 爷爷每天早上听收音机。

candidates.english: There is an old radio on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 架子上有一台旧收音机。

candidates.english: Dad turned off the radio before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸晚饭前关掉了收音机。

candidates.english: The water is rather cold today.
candidates.chinese: 今天的水相当凉。

candidates.english: The test was rather easy for her.
candidates.chinese: 这次测试对她来说相当容易。

candidates.english: The room became rather warm at noon.
candidates.chinese: 中午房间变得相当暖和。

candidates.english: Dinner is ready, so please wash your hands.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭准备好了，请洗手。

candidates.english: The bags are ready for the trip.
candidates.chinese: 旅行用的包已经准备好了。

candidates.english: Are you ready for your English class?
candidates.chinese: 你准备好上英语课了吗？

candidates.english: I really enjoyed the school concert.
candidates.chinese: 我确实很喜欢学校音乐会。

candidates.english: This answer really is correct.
candidates.chinese: 这个答案确实是正确的。

candidates.english: She really needs a quiet place to study.
candidates.chinese: 她确实需要一个安静的地方学习。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句 really correct 搭配不够自然，改为更地道的强调结构。

candidates.english: You will receive an email tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 你明天会收到一封电子邮件。

candidates.english: I received a postcard from my aunt.
candidates.chinese: 我收到了姑姑寄来的一张明信片。

candidates.english: Students receive their books on Monday.
candidates.chinese: 学生们星期一收到他们的书。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文把 cousin 具体译成“表妹”，信息不准确，改为明确且可准确翻译的亲属。

candidates.english: A recent report shows cleaner air in the city.
candidates.chinese: 最近的一份报告显示城市空气更清洁了。

candidates.english: A recent photo shows the new school gate.
candidates.chinese: 最近的一张照片显示了新的校门。

candidates.english: In a recent lesson, we learned about plants.
candidates.chinese: 在最近的一节课上，我们学习了植物知识。

candidates.english: I recognised her voice on the phone.
candidates.chinese: 我在电话里认出了她的声音。

candidates.english: I recognised my old teacher at the station.
candidates.chinese: 我在车站认出了我以前的老师。

candidates.english: He recognized the song after a few notes.
candidates.chinese: 听了几个音符后，他认出了那首歌。

entries.reviewNotes: B 中文“旧老师”不自然，改为“以前的老师”。

candidates.english: Can you recommend a good book for me?
candidates.chinese: 你能给我推荐一本好书吗？

candidates.english: The waiter recommended the vegetable soup.
candidates.chinese: 服务员推荐了蔬菜汤。

candidates.english: My coach recommends this warm-up before running.
candidates.chinese: 我的教练推荐跑步前做这个热身。

candidates.english: Keep a record of the books you read.
candidates.chinese: 记录你读过的书。

candidates.english: The nurse recorded my height on the form.
candidates.chinese: 护士把我的身高记录在表格上。

candidates.english: Dad records our family expenses every Sunday.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸每周日记录家庭开支。

entries.reviewNotes: C 英文“records the family spending”搭配不够自然，改为更地道的“records our family expenses”。

candidates.english: We recycle paper and glass at school.
candidates.chinese: 我们在学校回收利用纸张和玻璃。

candidates.english: Please recycle these empty bottles.
candidates.chinese: 请回收利用这些空瓶子。

candidates.english: Our town recycles old newspapers every week.
candidates.chinese: 我们镇每周回收利用旧报纸。

candidates.english: Stop when the traffic light is red.
candidates.chinese: 交通灯为红色时要停下。

candidates.english: Mum bought a red scarf for winter.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈买了一条冬天用的红色围巾。

candidates.english: The red bag on the chair is mine.
candidates.chinese: 椅子上的那个红色书包是我的。

candidates.english: We should reduce the amount of plastic we use.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该减少塑料使用量。

candidates.english: Turning off the lights can reduce waste.
candidates.chinese: 关灯可以减少浪费。

candidates.english: The new bus route reduces travel time.
candidates.chinese: 新的公交路线减少了出行时间。

candidates.english: Trust is important in any relationship.
candidates.chinese: 信任在任何关系中都很重要。

candidates.english: The relationship between the two teams became better after the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 会议之后，两个小组之间的关系变好了。

candidates.english: A good relationship with neighbors makes life easier.
candidates.chinese: 与邻居的良好关系让生活更轻松。

entries.reviewNotes: B 原句“Their relationship”指代较泛，可能让语境偏成人关系；改为小组关系，语境更安全明确。

candidates.english: A relative from London stayed with us.
candidates.chinese: 一位来自伦敦的亲戚住在我们家。

candidates.english: We visited a relative in Hangzhou last weekend.
candidates.chinese: 上周末我们拜访了一位在杭州的亲戚。

candidates.english: Every relative brought a dish to the family meal.
candidates.chinese: 每位亲戚都给家庭聚餐带了一道菜。

candidates.english: Please remain calm and follow the signs.
candidates.chinese: 请保持冷静并按照标志行动。

candidates.chinese: 会议期间门必须保持开着。

candidates.chinese: 请保持坐着，直到公交车停下。

candidates.chinese: 请提醒我带相机。

candidates.english: The note reminded me to water the flowers.
candidates.chinese: 这张便条提醒我给花浇水。

candidates.english: Set an alarm to remind you about the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 设个闹钟提醒你开会。

candidates.english: Could you repeat the last sentence?
candidates.chinese: 你能重复一下最后一句吗？

candidates.english: The teacher asked us to repeat the new word.
candidates.chinese: 老师让我们重复这个新单词。

candidates.english: Please repeat your address more slowly.
candidates.chinese: 请更慢地重复一下你的地址。

candidates.english: I replied to her message after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后我回复了她的消息。

candidates.english: Tom replied to the email before lunch.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆午饭前回复了那封邮件。

candidates.english: Please reply to my question in English.
candidates.chinese: 请用英语回复我的问题。

candidates.english: This job requires patience and care.
candidates.chinese: 这项工作需要耐心和细心。

candidates.english: The recipe requires two eggs and some milk.
candidates.chinese: 这个食谱需要两个鸡蛋和一些牛奶。

candidates.english: This game requires a quiet room.
candidates.chinese: 这个游戏需要一个安静的房间。

candidates.english: Our research focuses on local birds.
candidates.chinese: 我们的研究关注本地鸟类。

candidates.english: The students did research on clean water.
candidates.chinese: 学生们做了关于清洁用水的研究。

candidates.english: Her research helped the class understand plants.
candidates.chinese: 她的研究帮助全班了解植物。

candidates.english: We should respect other people's choices.
candidates.chinese: 我们应该尊重别人的选择。

candidates.english: Please respect your classmates' ideas.
candidates.chinese: 请尊重同学们的想法。

candidates.english: Good listeners respect each speaker.
candidates.chinese: 好的听众尊重每一位发言者。

candidates.chinese: 每名学生负责照料一株植物。

candidates.english: Lily is responsible for closing the windows.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉负责关窗。

candidates.english: The guide is responsible for the group's schedule.
candidates.chinese: 导游负责团队的日程。

candidates.chinese: 继续之前短暂休息一下。

candidates.chinese: 爷爷散步后需要休息。

candidates.chinese: 中午我们在一棵树下休息。

candidates.english: This restaurant serves fresh local food.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆供应新鲜的本地食物。

candidates.chinese: 我们选了博物馆附近的一家小餐馆。

candidates.english: The restaurant opens at six in the evening.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆晚上六点开门。

candidates.chinese: 测试结果让我们感到惊讶。

candidates.chinese: 离开前查看结果。

candidates.english: The final result will be on the board.
candidates.chinese: 最终结果会在公告板上。

candidates.chinese: 我们晚饭吃了米饭和蔬菜。

candidates.chinese: 我今天午饭带了米饭。

candidates.english: The rice is still warm in the bowl.
candidates.chinese: 碗里的米饭还热着。

candidates.english: The story follows a rich merchant on a long journey.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事讲述了一位富商的长途旅程。

candidates.chinese: 一位富有的农民为镇上建了一座新图书馆。

candidates.chinese: 她的手指上戴着一枚银戒指。

candidates.english: He found a gold ring in the old box.
candidates.chinese: 他在旧盒子里找到了一枚金戒指。

candidates.english: The ring on the table belongs to my aunt.
candidates.chinese: 桌上的那枚戒指是我姑姑的。

candidates.english: The sun rises behind the hills.
candidates.chinese: 太阳从山丘后面升起。

candidates.english: Smoke rose from the kitchen chimney.
candidates.chinese: 烟从厨房烟囱里升起。

candidates.english: The price of vegetables may rise in winter.
candidates.chinese: 冬天蔬菜价格可能会上升。

candidates.english: Cycling without a helmet is a serious risk.
candidates.chinese: 骑车不戴头盔是严重的风险。

candidates.english: There is a risk of slipping on the wet floor.
candidates.chinese: 在湿地板上有滑倒的风险。

candidates.english: The teacher explained the risk of online shopping.
candidates.chinese: 老师解释了网上购物的风险。

candidates.english: A clear river runs through the valley.
candidates.chinese: 一条清澈的河流穿过山谷。

candidates.english: Children played beside the river after school.
candidates.chinese: 放学后孩子们在河流旁玩耍。

candidates.english: The bridge crosses a wide river.
candidates.chinese: 这座桥横跨一条宽阔的河流。

candidates.english: This road leads directly to the village.
candidates.chinese: 这条路直通那个村庄。

candidates.english: Workers cleaned the road after the storm.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨后，工人们清理了道路。

candidates.english: A new road connects the two towns.
candidates.chinese: 一条新道路连接了这两个城镇。

candidates.english: The robot can carry heavy boxes.
candidates.chinese: 这个机器人能搬运重箱子。

candidates.chinese: 一个小机器人清洁了教室地板。

candidates.chinese: 一株小植物长在岩石之间。

candidates.english: We sat on a flat rock by the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们坐在湖边一块平坦的岩石上。

candidates.english: The path was covered with dark rocks.
candidates.chinese: 小路上覆盖着深色岩石。

candidates.chinese: 尼娜扮演女王的角色。

candidates.chinese: 我在剧中的角色是一位友善的医生。

candidates.english: This role has only three short lines.
candidates.chinese: 这个角色只有三句短台词。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句中的 role 指团队项目中的职责，更接近“作用/分工”，不精确对应“角色”；已改为剧中角色场景。

candidates.english: Sunlight filled the whole room.
candidates.chinese: 阳光照满了整个房间。

candidates.english: Please clean your room before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭前请打扫你的房间。

candidates.english: There is a piano in the music room.
candidates.chinese: 音乐房间里有一架钢琴。

candidates.english: Tie the box with this strong rope.
candidates.chinese: 用这根结实的绳子把箱子捆好。

candidates.english: The children pulled the bucket up with a rope.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们用一根绳子把水桶拉了上来。

candidates.chinese: 学校攀爬墙旁边挂着一根绳子。

candidates.chinese: 我们在路边种了一排树。

candidates.chinese: 门边有一排鞋。

candidates.chinese: 请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。

candidates.english: We picked up rubbish after the picnic.
candidates.chinese: 野餐后我们捡起了垃圾。

candidates.english: The park looks cleaner without rubbish on the grass.
candidates.chinese: 草地上没有垃圾，公园看起来更干净。

candidates.chinese: 过街时不要匆忙。

candidates.english: Safety comes first during the science experiment.
candidates.chinese: 做科学实验时安全第一。

candidates.chinese: 出行前老师检查了安全规则。

candidates.english: Wear a helmet for safety when you ride a bike.
candidates.chinese: 骑自行车时戴头盔以保证安全。

candidates.english: These notebooks are on sale today.
candidates.chinese: 这些笔记本今天特价销售。

candidates.english: This blue jacket is in the winter sale.
candidates.chinese: 这件蓝色夹克正在冬季特价销售。
