candidates.chinese: 把书放回书包里。

candidates.english: Her red schoolbag is under the desk.
candidates.chinese: 她的红色书包在书桌下面。

candidates.english: I found a ruler in my schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 我在书包里找到了一把尺子。

candidates.english: Science helps us understand the natural world.
candidates.chinese: 科学帮助我们理解自然世界。

candidates.english: We have science on Tuesday morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期二上午有科学课。

candidates.english: The science book has pictures of space.
candidates.chinese: 这本科学书里有太空图片。

candidates.english: The scientist studies plants in dry places.
candidates.chinese: 这位科学家研究干旱地区的植物。

candidates.english: A scientist explained how clouds form.
candidates.chinese: 一位科学家解释了云是怎样形成的。

candidates.english: The young scientist works in a quiet lab.
candidates.chinese: 这位年轻的科学家在一间安静的实验室工作。

candidates.english: Use these scissors to cut the paper.
candidates.chinese: 用这把剪刀剪纸。

candidates.english: The scissors are on the art room table.
candidates.chinese: 剪刀在美术教室的桌子上。

candidates.english: Please pass me the small scissors.
candidates.chinese: 请把那把小剪刀递给我。

candidates.english: Our team scored two goals in the second half.
candidates.chinese: 我们队在下半场进了两个球。

candidates.english: Lily scored ten points in the quiz.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉在小测验中得了十分。

candidates.english: His score in the spelling game was 18.
candidates.chinese: 他在拼写游戏中的得分是18分。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句中的 score 更偏“比分/结果”，中文“查看了得分”不够准确；改为明确表示个人得分的场景。

candidates.english: The sun sank slowly into the sea.
candidates.chinese: 太阳慢慢沉入海中。

candidates.english: We collected shells near the sea.
candidates.chinese: 我们在海边捡贝壳。

candidates.english: The sea was calm in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 早晨的大海很平静。

candidates.english: Is this seat free?
candidates.chinese: 这个座位有人吗？

candidates.english: Please take a seat near the window.
candidates.chinese: 请在窗边找个座位坐下。

candidates.english: My seat number is twelve.
candidates.chinese: 我的座位号是十二。

candidates.english: The children seem excited about the trip.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们似乎对这次旅行很兴奋。

candidates.english: The soup seems too hot to drink.
candidates.chinese: 这汤似乎太烫，不能喝。

candidates.english: It seems quiet in the library today.
candidates.chinese: 今天图书馆里似乎很安静。

candidates.english: We seldom watch television on school nights.
candidates.chinese: 上学日的晚上我们很少看电视。

candidates.english: My grandfather seldom eats sweet food.
candidates.chinese: 我爷爷很少吃甜食。

candidates.english: She seldom forgets to do her homework.
candidates.chinese: 她很少忘记做作业。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句和中文“忘记作业”不够自然、完整，改为更清楚的“忘记做作业”。

candidates.english: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
candidates.chinese: 狗有很强的嗅觉。

candidates.english: I had a strange sense of excitement before the game.
candidates.chinese: 比赛前我有一种奇怪的兴奋感。

candidates.english: The soft music gave me a sense of peace.
candidates.chinese: 这轻柔的音乐给我一种平静的感觉。

entries.reviewNotes: B 原句 a strange sense of cold 搭配不够自然，改为更地道的感觉类表达。

candidates.english: Write a sentence with the word friendly.
candidates.chinese: 用 friendly 这个词写一个句子。

candidates.english: This sentence is easy to read.
candidates.chinese: 这个句子很容易读。

candidates.english: Please copy the last sentence into your notebook.
candidates.chinese: 请把最后一个句子抄到笔记本上。

candidates.english: Separate the white clothes from the coloured ones.
candidates.chinese: 把白色衣服和彩色衣服分开。

candidates.english: Separate the cards into two groups.
candidates.chinese: 把这些卡片分成两组。

candidates.english: We separate glass and paper for recycling.
candidates.chinese: 我们把玻璃和纸分开回收。

candidates.english: The restaurant offers friendly service.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆提供友好的服务。

candidates.english: The hotel service was quick and helpful.
candidates.chinese: 这家旅馆的服务快捷又有帮助。

candidates.english: Good service makes customers feel welcome.
candidates.chinese: 好的服务让顾客感到受欢迎。

candidates.english: Shall we meet outside the library?
candidates.chinese: 我们在图书馆外面见面好吗？

candidates.english: Shall I open the window now?
candidates.chinese: 我要现在打开窗户吗？

candidates.english: Shall we start our homework after dinner?
candidates.chinese: 我们晚饭后开始做作业好吗？

candidates.english: It is a shame that you missed the concert.
candidates.chinese: 你错过了音乐会，真遗憾。

candidates.english: It was a shame that the match was cancelled.
candidates.chinese: 比赛取消了，真是令人遗憾的事。

candidates.english: What a shame that the shop closed early.
candidates.chinese: 商店早早关门了，真遗憾。

candidates.english: The pool is in the shape of a star.
candidates.chinese: 游泳池是星星的形状。

candidates.english: The cake is in the shape of a heart.
candidates.chinese: 这个蛋糕是心形的。

candidates.english: Can you name the shape of this window?
candidates.chinese: 你能说出这扇窗户的形状吗？

entries.reviewNotes: B 原句 has the shape of a heart 不如固定搭配 in the shape of 自然，中文也去掉重复的“心形的形状”。

candidates.english: She walks to school with her brother.
candidates.chinese: 她和弟弟一起步行上学。

candidates.english: She is reading quietly in the library.
candidates.chinese: 她正在图书馆安静地读书。

candidates.english: She helped her mother water the flowers.
candidates.chinese: 她帮妈妈浇花。

candidates.english: Several sheep are eating grass on the hill.
candidates.chinese: 几只绵羊正在山坡上吃草。

candidates.english: One sheep stood near the old tree.
candidates.chinese: 一只绵羊站在老树旁边。

candidates.english: The farmer counted the sheep before evening.
candidates.chinese: 傍晚前农民数了数绵羊。

candidates.english: The sun shone through the classroom window.
candidates.chinese: 阳光透过教室的窗户照进来。

candidates.english: The stars shine brightly on clear nights.
candidates.chinese: 晴朗的夜晚星星明亮地发光。

candidates.english: A small lamp shone on the desk.
candidates.chinese: 一盏小台灯照在书桌上。

entries.reviewNotes: C 中文“在书桌上发光”不够准确，shone on the desk 应译为“照在书桌上”。

candidates.english: The ship left the harbour before sunrise.
candidates.chinese: 这艘船在日出前离开了港口。

candidates.english: We saw a large ship at the port.
candidates.chinese: 我们在港口看到一艘大船。

candidates.english: The ship carried fruit across the sea.
candidates.chinese: 这艘船把水果运过大海。

candidates.english: Tom wore a clean white shirt to the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆穿着一件干净的白衬衫参加会议。

candidates.english: I need a blue shirt for the school show.
candidates.chinese: 我需要一件蓝色衬衫参加学校演出。

candidates.english: His shirt was still wet after the rain.
candidates.chinese: 雨后他的衬衫还是湿的。

candidates.english: The news came as a shock to everyone.
candidates.chinese: 这个消息让所有人都感到震惊。

candidates.english: Her sudden visit was a shock to me.
candidates.chinese: 她突然来访让我感到震惊。

candidates.english: It was a shock to see the broken window.
candidates.chinese: 看到破了的窗户让人感到震惊。

entries.reviewNotes: C 原句 I felt shock 不够地道，改为自然搭配 was a shock。

candidates.english: I found one shoe under the bed.
candidates.chinese: 我在床下找到了一只鞋。

candidates.english: My new shoe feels comfortable on my foot.
candidates.chinese: 我的新鞋穿在脚上很舒服。

candidates.english: Please put your wet shoe by the door.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的湿鞋放在门边。

candidates.english: There is a small bookshop near the station.
candidates.chinese: 车站附近有一家小书店。

candidates.english: The fruit shop opens at eight in the morning.
candidates.chinese: 水果店早上八点开门。

candidates.english: Mum bought some bread at the shop downstairs.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈在楼下的商店买了一些面包。

candidates.english: We took a short break after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后我们短暂休息了一会儿。

candidates.english: Tom wrote a short note to his classmate.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆给同学写了一张简短的便条。

candidates.english: This short path leads to the park.
candidates.chinese: 这条短小路通向公园。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原中文“短便条”不够自然，改为更准确的“简短的便条”。C：原中文“短路”容易误解为电路故障，英文也改为更自然的具体场景。

candidates.english: You should drink more water after exercise.
candidates.chinese: 运动后你应该多喝水。

candidates.english: We should clean the classroom before we leave.
candidates.chinese: 我们离开前应该打扫教室。

candidates.english: You should check your answers again.
candidates.chinese: 你应该再检查一遍答案。

candidates.english: Do not shout in the library.
candidates.chinese: 不要在图书馆里大声喊叫。

candidates.english: The coach had to shout over the strong wind.
candidates.chinese: 教练不得不顶着大风喊话。

candidates.english: Please raise your hand instead of shouting the answer.
candidates.chinese: 请举手，不要喊出答案。

candidates.english: I took a quick shower before breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 早餐前我快速冲了个澡。

candidates.english: The hotel room has a clean shower.
candidates.chinese: 这间旅馆房间有一个干净的淋浴间。

candidates.english: Dad fixed the shower in the bathroom.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸修好了浴室里的淋浴器。

candidates.english: Please shut the gate behind you.
candidates.chinese: 请随手关上大门。

candidates.english: Can you shut the window before the rain comes in?
candidates.chinese: 雨飘进来前，你能关上窗户吗？

candidates.english: He shut his notebook after class.
candidates.chinese: 下课后他合上了笔记本。

candidates.english: The shy boy spoke quietly to the new teacher.
candidates.chinese: 那个害羞的男孩轻声和新老师说话。

candidates.english: Anna felt shy on her first day at school.
candidates.chinese: 安娜上学第一天感到害羞。

candidates.english: The shy girl smiled but did not speak.
candidates.chinese: 那个害羞的女孩笑了笑，但没有说话。

candidates.english: Lily stayed home because she was sick.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉因为生病待在家里。

candidates.english: My brother looks sick and needs some rest.
candidates.chinese: 我弟弟看起来生病了，需要休息。

candidates.english: The sick child slept early last night.
candidates.chinese: 那个生病的孩子昨晚很早就睡了。

candidates.english: The sign says that we must not park here.
candidates.chinese: 标志上写着这里禁止停车。

candidates.english: A red sign points to the school office.
candidates.chinese: 一个红色标志指向学校办公室。

candidates.english: We followed the sign to the bus stop.
candidates.chinese: 我们按照标志走到了公交车站。

candidates.english: This scarf is made of silk.
candidates.chinese: 这条围巾是丝绸做的。

candidates.english: Grandma keeps a silk dress in the box.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶把一条丝绸连衣裙放在盒子里。

candidates.english: The silk cloth feels soft and light.
candidates.chinese: 这块丝绸布料摸起来又软又轻。

candidates.english: I made a silly mistake and corrected it calmly.
candidates.chinese: 我犯了一个小错误，并冷静地改正了它。

candidates.english: It was silly to wear thin shoes in the snow.
candidates.chinese: 在雪地里穿薄鞋是愚蠢的。

candidates.english: That silly idea made the work harder.
candidates.chinese: 那个愚蠢的想法让工作更难了。

candidates.english: The two bags are similar in colour and size.
candidates.chinese: 这两个包在颜色和大小上很相似。

candidates.english: Our school uniforms look similar from far away.
candidates.chinese: 从远处看，我们的校服很相似。

candidates.english: These two songs have similar rhythms.
candidates.chinese: 这两首歌有相似的节奏。

candidates.english: My sister and I share a bedroom.
candidates.chinese: 我和姐姐共用一间卧室。

candidates.english: My sister helps me with English on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 我姐姐每周日帮我学英语。

candidates.english: His younger sister is reading in the living room.
candidates.chinese: 他的妹妹正在客厅里读书。

candidates.english: We stayed calm in a difficult situation.
candidates.chinese: 在困难的情况下，我们保持了冷静。

candidates.english: The teacher explained the situation to the parents.
candidates.chinese: 老师向家长解释了情况。

candidates.english: This situation needs a simple plan.
candidates.chinese: 这种情况需要一个简单的计划。

candidates.english: Do you have this shirt in a smaller size?
candidates.chinese: 这件衬衫有小一点的尺码吗？

candidates.english: What size shoes do you wear?
candidates.chinese: 你穿多大尺码的鞋？

candidates.english: The size of the room surprised me.
candidates.chinese: 这个房间的大小让我惊讶。

candidates.english: We skate at the ice rink in winter.
candidates.chinese: 冬天我们在滑冰场滑冰。

candidates.english: Can you skate slowly on the ice?
candidates.chinese: 你能在冰上慢慢滑冰吗？

candidates.english: She wants to skate with her friends this weekend.
candidates.chinese: 她这个周末想和朋友们一起滑冰。

candidates.english: They learned to ski during the winter holiday.
candidates.chinese: 他们在寒假期间学会了滑雪。

candidates.english: We will ski on the mountain tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们明天将在山上滑雪。

candidates.english: Jack can ski well after many lessons.
candidates.chinese: 上了许多课后，杰克能滑雪滑得很好。

candidates.english: The stars filled the clear night sky.
candidates.chinese: 星星布满了晴朗的夜空。

candidates.english: White clouds moved across the blue sky.
candidates.chinese: 白云飘过蓝天。

candidates.english: Birds flew high in the morning sky.
candidates.chinese: 鸟儿在清晨的天空中高飞。

candidates.english: A small garden lies behind the house.
candidates.chinese: 房子后面有一个小花园。

candidates.english: She put a small cup on the table.
candidates.chinese: 她把一个小杯子放在桌上。

candidates.english: A small dog waited outside the shop.
candidates.chinese: 一只小狗在商店外面等着。

candidates.english: She smiled when she saw the little puppy.
candidates.chinese: 她看到小狗时笑了。

candidates.english: The teacher gave us a warm smile.
candidates.chinese: 老师给了我们一个温暖的微笑。

candidates.english: He smiled at his classmates after the game.
candidates.chinese: 比赛后他对同学们微笑了。

candidates.english: Dark smoke rose from the old building.
candidates.chinese: 黑烟从那座旧建筑中升起。

candidates.english: Smoke came from the pan in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 烟从厨房里的平底锅里冒出来。

candidates.english: We saw a little smoke above the barbecue stand.
candidates.chinese: 我们看到烧烤摊上方有一点烟。

entries.reviewNotes: B：原句“the kitchen pan”搭配不够自然，改为更地道的“the pan in the kitchen”。

candidates.english: Fresh snow covered the playground.
candidates.chinese: 新雪覆盖了操场。

candidates.english: The children made a small ball of snow.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们做了一个小雪球。

candidates.english: Snow fell quietly outside the window.
candidates.chinese: 雪在窗外静静地下着。

candidates.english: Access to clean water is an important social issue.
candidates.chinese: 获得清洁用水是一个重要的社会问题。

candidates.english: Better buses can solve some social problems in a city.
candidates.chinese: 更好的公交车可以解决城市中的一些社会问题。

candidates.english: The class discussed social changes after the new park opened.
candidates.chinese: 全班讨论了新公园开放后的社会变化。

candidates.english: I cannot find my other sock.
candidates.chinese: 我找不到另一只袜子了。

candidates.english: My blue sock has a small hole in it.
candidates.chinese: 我的蓝色短袜上有一个小洞。

candidates.english: She put a clean sock in her sports bag.
candidates.chinese: 她把一只干净的短袜放进运动包里。

candidates.english: We bought some fruit for the picnic.
candidates.chinese: 我们为野餐买了一些水果。

candidates.english: There are some chairs near the window.
candidates.chinese: 窗户旁边有一些椅子。

candidates.english: Could you give me some paper for drawing?
candidates.chinese: 你能给我一些画画用的纸吗？

candidates.english: Someone left a notebook on the desk.
candidates.chinese: 有人把一本笔记本落在桌上了。

candidates.english: Somebody is waiting outside the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 有人正在教室外面等着。

candidates.english: I heard someone calling my name in the hall.
candidates.chinese: 我听见有人在大厅里叫我的名字。

candidates.english: I have something important to tell you.
candidates.chinese: 我有一件重要的事要告诉你。

candidates.english: There is something under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 椅子下面有某样东西。

candidates.english: She wants to buy something for her mother.
candidates.chinese: 她想给妈妈买某样东西。

candidates.english: I sometimes walk home after school.
candidates.chinese: 我有时放学后走路回家。

candidates.english: We sometimes play chess during lunch break.
candidates.chinese: 我们有时在午休时下棋。

candidates.english: My father sometimes cooks noodles on Sundays.
candidates.chinese: 我爸爸有时在星期天煮面条。

candidates.english: Their son starts school this autumn.
candidates.chinese: 他们的儿子今年秋天开始上学。

candidates.english: Mr. Li teaches his son to ride a bike.
candidates.chinese: 李先生教他的儿子骑自行车。

candidates.english: Her son draws a picture for Grandma.
candidates.chinese: 她的儿子给奶奶画了一幅画。

candidates.english: This song always makes me feel happy.
candidates.chinese: 这首歌总能让我感到快乐。

candidates.english: We learned a new song in music class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在音乐课上学了一首新歌曲。

candidates.english: The children sang a song at the school show.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在学校演出中唱了一首歌曲。

candidates.english: I am sorry that I broke your cup.
candidates.chinese: 很抱歉我打破了你的杯子。

candidates.english: She felt sorry for arriving late.
candidates.chinese: 她因迟到而感到抱歉。

candidates.english: Tom was sorry about the mistake in his homework.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆对作业中的错误感到抱歉。

candidates.english: The hot soup warmed us after the walk.
candidates.chinese: 散步后，热汤让我们暖和起来。

candidates.english: Mom made tomato soup for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈晚餐做了番茄汤。

candidates.english: He ordered a bowl of chicken soup.
candidates.chinese: 他点了一碗鸡汤。

candidates.english: Many birds fly south in winter.
candidates.chinese: 许多鸟冬天飞往南方。

candidates.english: Our grandparents live in the south.
candidates.chinese: 我们的祖父母住在南方。

candidates.english: They moved to the south for warmer weather.
candidates.chinese: 他们搬到南方去享受更暖和的天气。

candidates.english: I read books in my spare time.
candidates.chinese: 我在空闲时间读书。

candidates.english: Do you have a spare minute after class?
candidates.chinese: 你课后有空闲的一分钟吗？

candidates.english: She keeps a diary in her spare hours.
candidates.chinese: 她在空闲时间写日记。

candidates.english: Her speech about kindness moved the audience.
candidates.chinese: 她关于善意的演讲打动了观众。

candidates.english: Jack gave a short speech at the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 杰克在会议上做了一个简短的演讲。

candidates.english: Lily gave a clear speech about her school garden.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉做了一场关于学校花园的清晰演讲。

candidates.english: Please reduce your speed near the school.
candidates.chinese: 在学校附近请减速。

candidates.english: The train reached a high speed on the straight track.
candidates.chinese: 火车在笔直的轨道上达到了很高的速度。

candidates.english: The wind speed is high on the mountain today.
candidates.chinese: 今天山上的风速很高。

candidates.english: Can you spell your family name?
candidates.chinese: 你能拼写你的姓吗？

candidates.english: Please spell this word on the blackboard.
candidates.chinese: 请在黑板上拼写这个单词。

candidates.english: I can spell your English name now.
candidates.chinese: 我现在能拼写你的英文名了。

candidates.english: Use a spoon to stir the soup.
candidates.chinese: 用勺子搅拌汤。

candidates.english: She ate the yogurt with a small spoon.
candidates.chinese: 她用一把小勺子吃酸奶。

candidates.english: There is a clean spoon beside the bowl.
candidates.chinese: 碗旁边有一把干净的勺子。

candidates.english: Flowers begin to grow in spring.
candidates.chinese: 花朵在春天开始生长。

candidates.english: We often have warm rain in spring.
candidates.chinese: 春天我们经常有温暖的雨。

candidates.english: The park looks green in spring.
candidates.chinese: 公园在春天看起来绿意盎然。

candidates.english: He put a stamp on the envelope.
candidates.chinese: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。

candidates.english: This old stamp shows a blue bird.
candidates.chinese: 这张旧邮票上有一只蓝色的鸟。

candidates.english: I bought a stamp before mailing the card.
candidates.chinese: 寄卡片前我买了一张邮票。

candidates.english: The work meets the required standard.
candidates.chinese: 这项工作达到了要求的标准。

candidates.english: Our school has a high standard for safety.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校有很高的安全标准。

candidates.english: The teacher explained the standard for this project.
candidates.chinese: 老师解释了这个项目的标准。

candidates.english: The first star appeared in the evening sky.
candidates.chinese: 第一颗星星出现在傍晚的天空中。

candidates.english: A bright star shone above the trees.
candidates.chinese: 一颗明亮的星星在树上方闪耀。

candidates.english: We saw one star through the window.
candidates.chinese: 我们透过窗户看到了一颗星星。

candidates.english: The house is in a poor state after the storm.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨过后，这所房子的状况很差。

candidates.english: The old bike is in a good state now.
candidates.chinese: 那辆旧自行车现在状态很好。

candidates.english: Please check the state of the classroom after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后请检查教室的状态。

candidates.english: It was late, but the shop was still open.
candidates.chinese: 时间很晚了，但商店仍然开着。

candidates.english: My brother is still asleep at eight.
candidates.chinese: 我弟弟八点仍然在睡觉。

candidates.english: The water is still warm after an hour.
candidates.chinese: 一个小时后，水仍然是温的。

candidates.english: The child found a smooth stone beside the river.
candidates.chinese: 那个孩子在河边发现了一块光滑的石头。

candidates.english: A small stone lay on the garden path.
candidates.chinese: 一块小石头躺在花园小路上。

candidates.english: He picked up a white stone near the wall.
candidates.chinese: 他在墙边捡起一块白色的石头。

candidates.english: The store sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店出售新鲜水果和蔬菜。

candidates.english: I bought a notebook at the store.
candidates.chinese: 我在商店买了一本笔记本。

candidates.english: The store closes at nine in the evening.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店晚上九点关门。

candidates.english: Grandma told us a story about her childhood.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于她童年的故事。

candidates.english: The story made the whole class laugh.
candidates.chinese: 这个故事让全班都笑了。

candidates.english: I wrote a short story for homework.
candidates.chinese: 我为作业写了一个短故事。

candidates.english: She put a strawberry on top of the cake.
candidates.chinese: 她在蛋糕顶上放了一颗草莓。

candidates.english: I washed a strawberry before eating it.
candidates.chinese: 我吃草莓前洗了一颗草莓。

candidates.english: The picture shows a red strawberry.
candidates.chinese: 这幅图展示了一颗红色的草莓。

candidates.english: Our school is across the street from the park.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校在公园的街对面。

candidates.english: Many trees grow along this street.
candidates.chinese: 这条街道两旁长着许多树。

candidates.english: The bus stop is at the end of the street.
candidates.chinese: 公交车站在这条街道的尽头。

candidates.english: Exercise can help reduce stress.
candidates.chinese: 锻炼可以帮助减轻压力。

candidates.english: Too much homework can cause stress.
candidates.chinese: 太多作业可能造成压力。

candidates.english: Music helps me deal with stress.
candidates.chinese: 音乐帮助我应对压力。

candidates.english: Every student received a new workbook.
candidates.chinese: 每位学生都领到了一本新练习册。

candidates.english: A student asked a question after class.
candidates.chinese: 一名学生课后问了一个问题。

candidates.english: The new student sits near the window.
candidates.chinese: 那名新学生坐在窗边。

candidates.english: This drink contains too much sugar.
candidates.chinese: 这种饮料含糖太多。

candidates.english: Please add less sugar to my tea.
candidates.chinese: 请在我的茶里少加点糖。

candidates.english: The bag of sugar is on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 那袋糖在厨房桌子上。

candidates.english: This time suits everyone in the group.
candidates.chinese: 这个时间适合小组里的每个人。

candidates.english: This blue coat suits you well.
candidates.chinese: 这件蓝色外套很适合你。

candidates.english: The small desk suits my little brother well.
candidates.chinese: 这张小书桌很适合我弟弟。

candidates.english: We visit our grandparents every summer.
candidates.chinese: 我们每年夏天都去看望祖父母。

candidates.english: Summer is the hottest season in my city.
candidates.chinese: 夏天是我所在城市最热的季节。

candidates.english: The school library opens later in summer.
candidates.chinese: 学校图书馆在夏天开门晚一些。

candidates.english: The sun rose above the mountains.
candidates.chinese: 太阳从群山上方升起。

candidates.english: Morning sun filled the reading room.
candidates.chinese: 早晨的阳光洒满了阅览室。

candidates.english: We wore hats under the bright sun.
candidates.chinese: 我们在明亮的太阳下戴着帽子。

candidates.english: It will be warm and sunny tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 明天天气温暖晴朗。

candidates.english: We had a sunny afternoon for the sports meeting.
candidates.chinese: 运动会那天下午天气晴朗。

candidates.english: The photo looks bright on a sunny day.
candidates.chinese: 晴朗的日子里，这张照片看起来很明亮。

candidates.english: We bought milk and eggs at the supermarket.
candidates.chinese: 我们在超市买了牛奶和鸡蛋。

candidates.english: The supermarket near our school closes at nine.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校附近的超市九点关门。

candidates.english: Dad chose some apples in the supermarket.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在超市里挑了一些苹果。

candidates.english: Leaves floated on the surface of the pond.
candidates.chinese: 树叶漂浮在池塘表面。

candidates.english: Dust covered the surface of the old desk.
candidates.chinese: 灰尘覆盖了旧书桌的表面。

candidates.english: Small bubbles appeared on the surface of the soup.
candidates.chinese: 汤的表面出现了小气泡。

candidates.english: Our class did a survey about reading habits.
candidates.chinese: 我们班做了一项关于阅读习惯的调查。

candidates.english: The survey asked students about their breakfast choices.
candidates.chinese: 这项调查询问学生们的早餐选择。

candidates.english: We will survey fifty families in the neighborhood.
candidates.chinese: 我们将调查社区里的五十个家庭。

candidates.english: Please sweep the floor after the activity.
candidates.chinese: 活动结束后请扫地。

candidates.english: I sweep the leaves from the front steps.
candidates.chinese: 我清扫前台阶上的树叶。

candidates.english: The students swept the classroom before the bell.
candidates.chinese: 学生们在铃响前清扫了教室。

candidates.english: These strawberries are fresh and sweet.
candidates.chinese: 这些草莓既新鲜又甜。

candidates.english: The soup tastes sweet with carrots in it.
candidates.chinese: 这汤里有胡萝卜，尝起来是甜的。

candidates.english: Grandma made a sweet cake for the family.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶为家人做了一个甜蛋糕。

candidates.english: The dove is a symbol of peace.
candidates.chinese: 鸽子是和平的象征。

candidates.english: The red cross is a medical symbol in many places.
candidates.chinese: 红十字在许多地方是医疗符号。

candidates.english: A star on the map is the symbol for our school.
candidates.chinese: 地图上的一颗星是我们学校的符号。

candidates.english: Dinner is ready on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭已经摆在厨房的桌子上了。

candidates.english: My notebook is under the round table.
candidates.chinese: 我的笔记本在圆桌子下面。

candidates.english: Please put the flowers on that small table.
candidates.chinese: 请把花放在那张小桌子上。

candidates.english: She has a talent for telling stories.
candidates.chinese: 她有讲故事的天赋。

candidates.english: He showed a talent for drawing maps.
candidates.chinese: 他表现出了画地图的天赋。

candidates.english: Mina has real talent in music class.
candidates.chinese: 米娜在音乐课上确实有天赋。

candidates.english: A tall tree grows beside the gate.
candidates.chinese: 大门旁边长着一棵高大的树。

candidates.english: The tall boy can reach the top shelf.
candidates.chinese: 那个高个子男孩能够到最上面的架子。

candidates.english: A tall building stands across from the park.
candidates.chinese: 公园对面矗立着一栋高楼。

candidates.english: We completed the task before lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我们在午饭前完成了任务。

candidates.english: My first task is to water the plants.
candidates.chinese: 我的第一项任务是给植物浇水。

candidates.english: The science task took only ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 这项科学任务只花了十分钟。

candidates.english: Our teacher showed us how to do the experiment.
candidates.chinese: 老师向我们演示了怎样做这个实验。

candidates.english: The teacher wrote three questions on the board.
candidates.chinese: 老师在黑板上写了三个问题。

candidates.english: A music teacher helped us learn the new song.
candidates.chinese: 一位音乐老师帮助我们学习这首新歌。

candidates.english: Our team practises together every afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 我们队每天下午一起训练。

candidates.english: The science team built a small robot.
candidates.chinese: 科学团队制作了一个小机器人。

candidates.english: A rescue team arrived after the storm.
candidates.chinese: 一支救援队在暴风雨后到达了。

candidates.english: Good teamwork helped us finish the project.
candidates.chinese: 良好的团队合作帮助我们完成了项目。

candidates.english: Teamwork made the classroom clean in ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 团队合作让教室在十分钟内变干净了。

candidates.english: We learned teamwork while preparing the school show.
candidates.chinese: 我们在准备学校演出时学会了团队合作。

candidates.english: New technology makes communication faster.
candidates.chinese: 新技术让沟通更快捷。

candidates.english: This hospital uses technology to check patients quickly.
candidates.chinese: 这家医院使用技术快速检查病人。

candidates.english: Technology helps farmers grow food with less water.
candidates.chinese: 科技帮助农民用更少的水种植粮食。

candidates.english: The temperature fell below zero last night.
candidates.chinese: 昨晚温度降到了零度以下。

candidates.english: The nurse checked my temperature before class.
candidates.chinese: 护士在上课前量了我的体温。

candidates.english: Keep the room temperature at about twenty degrees.
candidates.chinese: 把室内温度保持在大约二十度。

candidates.english: They play tennis after school on Tuesdays.
candidates.chinese: 他们星期二放学后打网球。

candidates.english: My sister learns tennis at the sports center.
candidates.chinese: 我姐姐在体育中心学习网球。

candidates.english: Tennis is popular in our summer club.
candidates.chinese: 网球运动在我们的夏令营俱乐部很受欢迎。

candidates.english: We will study twelve units this term.
candidates.chinese: 这学期我们将学习十二个单元。

candidates.english: The new term begins in September.
candidates.chinese: 新学期在九月开始。

candidates.english: Lucy joined the art club this term.
candidates.chinese: 露西这学期加入了美术社团。

candidates.english: We had terrible weather during the trip.
candidates.chinese: 旅行期间天气非常糟糕。

candidates.english: The soup tasted terrible without salt.
candidates.chinese: 这汤没有盐，味道很糟糕。

candidates.english: I made a terrible mistake in my homework.
candidates.chinese: 我在作业里犯了一个糟糕的错误。

candidates.english: We have an English test on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期五有一次英语测验。

candidates.english: The math test took only twenty minutes.
candidates.chinese: 这次数学测验只用了二十分钟。

candidates.english: Our teacher will test us on these words tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 老师明天会测验我们这些单词。

candidates.english: That red bicycle belongs to me.
candidates.chinese: 那辆红色自行车是我的。

candidates.english: That blue cup is for cold water.
candidates.chinese: 那个蓝色杯子是装冷水的。

candidates.english: Can you see that tall tree near the gate?
candidates.chinese: 你能看见大门附近那棵高树吗？

candidates.english: Please close the door quietly.
candidates.chinese: 请轻轻地把门关上。

candidates.english: The book on the desk is mine.
candidates.chinese: 桌子上的那本书是我的。

candidates.english: I found the key in my pencil case.
candidates.chinese: 我在铅笔盒里找到了那把钥匙。

candidates.english: We watched a play at the local theatre.
candidates.chinese: 我们在当地剧院看了一场戏。

candidates.english: The theatre was full before the show began.
candidates.chinese: 演出开始前，剧院已经坐满了。

candidates.english: Dad bought tickets for the new theatre downtown.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸买了市中心新剧院的票。

candidates.english: The students put their bags under the desks.
candidates.chinese: 学生们把他们的书包放在桌子下面。

candidates.english: The twins shared their lunch with us.
candidates.chinese: 这对双胞胎和我们分享了他们的午餐。

candidates.english: Many visitors left their coats near the entrance.
candidates.chinese: 许多参观者把他们的外套放在入口附近。

candidates.english: Our classroom is smaller than theirs.
candidates.chinese: 我们的教室比他们的小。

candidates.english: These notebooks are ours, and those are theirs.
candidates.chinese: 这些笔记本是我们的，那些是他们的。

candidates.english: My seats are in row five; theirs are in row six.
candidates.chinese: 我的座位在第五排；他们的在第六排。

candidates.english: I met them outside the cinema.
candidates.chinese: 我在电影院外面遇见了他们。

candidates.english: Please give them these clean towels.
candidates.chinese: 请把这些干净的毛巾给他们。

candidates.english: The guide showed them the old city wall.
candidates.chinese: 导游带他们参观了古老的城墙。

candidates.english: The children made the model themselves.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们自己制作了这个模型。

candidates.english: The players washed their shoes themselves.
candidates.chinese: 队员们自己洗了他们的鞋。

candidates.english: My cousins cooked dinner by themselves.
candidates.chinese: 我的表兄妹们自己做了晚饭。

candidates.english: Finish your homework, and then you can play.
candidates.chinese: 先完成作业，然后你就可以玩了。

candidates.english: Wash your hands, and then eat lunch.
candidates.chinese: 先洗手，然后吃午饭。

candidates.english: Read the question, and then choose the answer.
candidates.chinese: 先读题，然后选择答案。

candidates.english: Your umbrella is over there by the door.
candidates.chinese: 你的伞在门边那儿。

candidates.english: My bag is there under the chair.
candidates.chinese: 我的书包在那里，在椅子下面。

candidates.english: Please put the cup there on the table.
candidates.chinese: 请把杯子放在那里，放在桌子上。

candidates.english: These apples came from our school garden.
candidates.chinese: 这些苹果来自我们学校的花园。

candidates.english: These pencils are for the art class.
candidates.chinese: 这些铅笔是给美术课用的。

candidates.english: I washed these vegetables before dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭前我洗了这些蔬菜。

candidates.english: They practise basketball every afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 他们每天下午练习篮球。

candidates.english: They are reading in the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 他们正在教室里读书。

candidates.english: They helped carry the boxes upstairs.
candidates.chinese: 他们帮忙把箱子搬上楼。

candidates.english: Wear a thick coat on cold days.
candidates.chinese: 寒冷的日子要穿厚外套。

candidates.english: The thick dictionary is heavy.
candidates.chinese: 这本厚词典很重。

candidates.english: A thick blanket kept me warm.
candidates.chinese: 一条厚毯子让我保持温暖。

candidates.english: Cut the bread into thin pieces.
candidates.chinese: 把面包切成薄片。

candidates.english: She wrote on a thin sheet of paper.
candidates.chinese: 她在一张薄纸上写字。

candidates.english: The ice was too thin to stand on.
candidates.chinese: 冰太薄了，不能站在上面。

candidates.english: The first thing we need is clean water.
candidates.chinese: 我们首先需要的东西是干净的水。

candidates.english: Please put each thing back in its box.
candidates.chinese: 请把每样东西放回它的盒子里。

candidates.english: This small thing can open the door.
candidates.chinese: 这个小东西能打开门。

candidates.english: I felt thirsty after the long walk.
candidates.chinese: 走了很远的路后，我感到口渴。

candidates.english: The boy was thirsty after football practice.
candidates.chinese: 足球训练后，那个男孩口渴了。

candidates.english: Drink some water if you are thirsty.
candidates.chinese: 如果你口渴，就喝点水。

candidates.english: This book belongs to the school library.
candidates.chinese: 这本书属于学校图书馆。

candidates.english: This cup is full of warm milk.
candidates.chinese: 这个杯子里装满了热牛奶。

candidates.english: I found this key near the gate.
candidates.chinese: 我在大门附近找到了这把钥匙。

candidates.english: Those mountains are covered with snow.
candidates.chinese: 那些山覆盖着白雪。

candidates.english: Those chairs are for our guests.
candidates.chinese: 那些椅子是给我们的客人用的。

candidates.english: Please move those boxes to the corner.
candidates.chinese: 请把那些箱子搬到角落。

candidates.english: I had a sudden thought during the lesson.
candidates.chinese: 上课时我突然有了一个想法。

candidates.english: Her thought helped us solve the problem.
candidates.chinese: 她的想法帮助我们解决了这个问题。

candidates.english: Write down your thought before you forget it.
candidates.chinese: 在你忘记之前，把你的想法写下来。

candidates.english: Keep your train ticket until the journey ends.
candidates.chinese: 旅程结束前请保管好火车票。

candidates.english: I bought a bus ticket this morning.
candidates.chinese: 我今天早上买了一张公交车票。

candidates.english: Show your ticket at the museum gate.
candidates.chinese: 在博物馆门口出示你的票。

candidates.english: Her desk is always clean and tidy.
candidates.chinese: 她的书桌总是干净整洁。

candidates.english: The classroom looks tidy after the meeting.
candidates.chinese: 会议结束后，教室看起来很整洁。

candidates.english: Keep your schoolbag tidy every day.
candidates.chinese: 每天保持你的书包整洁。

candidates.english: Tie your shoes before you run.
candidates.chinese: 跑步前系好鞋带。

candidates.english: Can you tie the ribbon around the box?
candidates.chinese: 你能把丝带系在盒子上吗？

candidates.english: I need to tie this rope to the tree.
candidates.chinese: 我需要把这根绳子系到树上。

candidates.english: We worked together to clean the beach.
candidates.chinese: 我们一起清理了海滩。

candidates.english: The twins walked to school together.
candidates.chinese: 这对双胞胎一起走路去学校。

candidates.english: Let's put the puzzle together after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们一起拼拼图吧。

candidates.english: She added a tomato to the salad.
candidates.chinese: 她在沙拉里加了一个西红柿。

candidates.english: I sliced a tomato for my sandwich.
candidates.chinese: 我切了一个西红柿放进三明治里。

candidates.english: There is a red tomato in the basket.
candidates.chinese: 篮子里有一个红色的西红柿。

candidates.english: We will visit the farm tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们明天将参观农场。

candidates.english: The music lesson starts tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 音乐课明天开始。

candidates.english: Our class will plant trees tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们班明天要植树。

candidates.english: The truck can carry one ton of sand.
candidates.chinese: 这辆卡车能运一吨沙子。

candidates.english: This small bridge can hold two tons.
candidates.chinese: 这座小桥能承重两吨。

candidates.english: The factory bought a ton of rice.
candidates.chinese: 这家工厂买了一吨大米。

candidates.english: This bag is too heavy for me.
candidates.chinese: 这个包对我来说太重了。

candidates.english: The soup is too hot to drink.

candidates.english: We planted a bean in a small pot.
candidates.chinese: 我们在小花盆里种了一颗豆子。

candidates.chinese: 妈妈往汤里加了一颗青豆。

candidates.english: Each bean needs water and sunlight to grow.
candidates.chinese: 每颗豆子都需要水和阳光才能生长。

candidates.english: A brown bear crossed the forest path.
candidates.chinese: 一只棕熊穿过森林小路。

candidates.chinese: 那只熊睡在一个安静的洞里。

candidates.chinese: 那只蜜蜂绕着苹果树飞。

candidates.chinese: 请把你的名字写在图片下面。

candidates.chinese: 汽车开动前系好安全带。

candidates.chinese: 爸爸给他的新裤子买了一条黑色腰带。

candidates.chinese: 这条腰带对我的腰来说太长了。

candidates.chinese: 请把账单给我们好吗？

candidates.english: The waiter brought the bill after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后，服务员拿来了账单。

candidates.english: Mom checked the hotel bill carefully.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈仔细查看了酒店账单。

candidates.english: Put the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
candidates.chinese: 把空瓶放进回收箱。

candidates.english: Please throw the paper into the bin.
candidates.chinese: 请把这张纸扔进垃圾箱。

candidates.english: The classroom bin is beside the door.
candidates.chinese: 教室的垃圾箱在门旁边。

candidates.english: Biology teaches us how living things grow.
candidates.chinese: 生物学教我们了解生物如何生长。

candidates.english: We study plants and animals in biology class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在生物课上学习植物和动物。

candidates.english: Biology is my favorite science subject.
candidates.chinese: 生物学是我最喜欢的理科科目。

candidates.english: She ate a biscuit with her tea.
candidates.chinese: 她喝茶时吃了一块饼干。

candidates.chinese: 汤姆带了一块饼干作为点心。

candidates.chinese: 那块饼干碎成了两片。

candidates.english: I need a bit more time to finish.
candidates.chinese: 我还需要一点时间来完成。

candidates.english: Add a bit of salt to the soup.
candidates.chinese: 往汤里加一点盐。

candidates.english: The room feels a bit cold today.

candidates.english: A black cat slept by the door.
candidates.chinese: 一只黑猫睡在门边。

candidates.chinese: 她为考试买了一支黑色的钢笔。

candidates.chinese: 小伤口开始流血。

candidates.chinese: 在干燥的空气中，他的鼻子开始流血。

candidates.chinese: 如果皮肤裂开，我的手指可能会流血。

candidates.chinese: 图书馆离这里隔一个街区。

candidates.chinese: 下一个街区有一家面包店。

candidates.chinese: 晚饭后我们绕着这个街区走了一圈。

candidates.english: She chose a white blouse for the concert.
candidates.chinese: 她为音乐会选了一件白色女式衬衫。

candidates.english: Her blue blouse matches her skirt.
candidates.chinese: 她的蓝色女式衬衫和裙子很相配。

candidates.english: The new blouse has small buttons.
candidates.chinese: 这件新女式衬衫有小纽扣。

candidates.english: The old photos are in that box.
candidates.chinese: 旧照片在那个箱子里。

candidates.chinese: 爸爸把书放进一个箱子里。

candidates.chinese: 一个大箱子放在窗户附近。

candidates.chinese: 男孩在校门口挥手。

candidates.chinese: 一个小男孩在公交车上安静地读书。

candidates.chinese: 那个男孩背着书包上楼。

candidates.english: Take a deep breath before you speak.
candidates.chinese: 说话前深吸一口气。

candidates.english: I could see my breath in the cold morning.
candidates.chinese: 在寒冷的早晨，我能看见自己的呼吸。

candidates.english: Her breath became slow after the run.
candidates.chinese: 跑步后，她的呼吸慢了下来。

candidates.english: He wore a brown jacket in the photo.
candidates.chinese: 照片里他穿着棕色夹克。

candidates.english: The brown dog sat near the tree.
candidates.chinese: 那只棕色的狗坐在树旁。

candidates.english: She placed the brown notebook on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 她把那本棕色的笔记本放在架子上。

candidates.english: Our class has a small budget for the party.
candidates.chinese: 我们班为聚会准备的预算不多。

candidates.chinese: 我们在预算范围内计划了这次旅行。

candidates.english: The school set a budget for new books.
candidates.chinese: 学校为新书制定了预算。

candidates.english: Spread a little butter on the bread.
candidates.chinese: 在面包上抹一点黄油。

candidates.chinese: 这个蛋糕需要黄油和鸡蛋。

candidates.english: Keep the butter in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 把黄油放在冰箱里。

candidates.english: A butterfly rested on the leaf.
candidates.chinese: 一只蝴蝶停在叶子上。

candidates.chinese: 一只黄色的蝴蝶飞过花丛。

candidates.chinese: 我在学校门口附近看见了一只蝴蝶。

candidates.chinese: 我们往汤里加了一些卷心菜。

candidates.chinese: 我妈妈为晚餐切了卷心菜。

candidates.chinese: 篮子里有新鲜的卷心菜。

candidates.english: Mark the sports day on the calendar.
candidates.chinese: 在日历上标出运动会日期。

candidates.chinese: 日历挂在我的书桌上方。

candidates.chinese: 我在制订计划前查看了日历。

candidates.english: Doctors are studying better ways to treat cancer.
candidates.chinese: 医生们正在研究治疗癌症的更好方法。

candidates.chinese: 这家医院有一个新的癌症护理中心。

candidates.chinese: 良好的习惯可能会降低患癌症的风险。

candidates.chinese: 那个孩子选了一块糖果。

candidates.chinese: 她把糖果放进了书包里。

candidates.english: This candy tastes like orange.
candidates.chinese: 这块糖果尝起来像橙子。

candidates.chinese: 他在阳光下戴着一顶蓝色便帽。

candidates.chinese: 汤姆把他的便帽落在了公交车上。

candidates.english: The red cap matches her jacket.
candidates.chinese: 这顶红色便帽和她的夹克很相配。

candidates.english: The small shop only accepts cash.
candidates.chinese: 这家小店只收现金。

candidates.english: I paid for the ticket in cash.
candidates.chinese: 我用现金付了票钱。

candidates.english: Dad keeps some cash in his wallet.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在钱包里放了一些现金。

candidates.english: The cat waited beside its empty bowl.
candidates.chinese: 猫在空碗旁等着。

candidates.chinese: 一只黑猫睡在椅子下面。

candidates.chinese: 那只猫跳上了窗台。

candidates.chinese: 这支铅笔五十美分。

candidates.chinese: 我在地板上发现了十美分。

candidates.chinese: 这张邮票九十美分。

candidates.english: The library is in the central part of town.
candidates.chinese: 图书馆位于城镇中心地区。

candidates.chinese: 我们在中心车站见面。

candidates.english: The hotel is near the central square.
candidates.chinese: 这家旅馆在中心广场附近。

candidates.english: The teacher drew a circle with chalk.
candidates.chinese: 老师用粉笔画了一个圆。

candidates.chinese: 书桌上有白色粉笔。

candidates.english: Please bring a piece of chalk to class.
candidates.chinese: 请带一支粉笔来上课。

candidates.english: She became the city swimming champion.
candidates.chinese: 她成了全市游泳冠军。

candidates.english: Our team was the basketball champion last year.
candidates.chinese: 我们队去年是篮球冠军。

candidates.english: The chess champion answered questions after the game.
candidates.chinese: 这位国际象棋冠军在比赛后回答了问题。

candidates.english: Long ears are a characteristic of this rabbit.
candidates.chinese: 长耳朵是这种兔子的一个特征。

candidates.english: Kindness is an important characteristic of a good friend.
candidates.chinese: 善良是好朋友的一个重要特征。

candidates.english: A strong smell is a characteristic of this flower.
candidates.chinese: 浓烈的气味是这种花的一个特征。

candidates.chinese: 这家慈善机构为乡村学校提供图书。

candidates.chinese: 这家慈善机构帮助孩子们获得学校餐食。

candidates.chinese: 我姑姑在城里的一家慈善机构工作。

candidates.english: Students must not cheat in an exam.
candidates.chinese: 学生考试时不得作弊。

candidates.chinese: 他在拼写测试中没有作弊。

candidates.chinese: 做家庭作业时作弊是不对的。

candidates.chinese: 她在三明治里放了一些奶酪。

candidates.chinese: 汤姆在热面条里加了奶酪。

candidates.chinese: 披萨上的奶酪很快融化了。

candidates.chinese: 我们在化学课上做了一个安全的实验。

candidates.chinese: 莉莉通过彩色图表学习化学。

candidates.chinese: 我们的化学老师今天讲解了水。

candidates.chinese: 一只鸡跟着农场主穿过院子。

candidates.chinese: 这只鸡今天早上下了一个蛋。

candidates.chinese: 一只白色的鸡站在大门附近。

candidates.chinese: 一块微小的芯片控制着玩具机器人。

candidates.chinese: 我们分吃了一小块巧克力。

candidates.chinese: 妈妈为蛋糕买了巧克力。

candidates.chinese: 那根巧克力棒在我的书包里。

candidates.chinese: 他们在圣诞节看望祖父母。

candidates.english: Our town puts up lights before Christmas.
candidates.chinese: 我们镇在圣诞节前挂起彩灯。

candidates.chinese: 这家商店在圣诞节当天早早关门。

candidates.chinese: 这是一个关于友谊的经典故事。

candidates.chinese: 她穿了一件经典的黑色外套。

candidates.chinese: 这家博物馆展出经典的中国画。

candidates.chinese: 点击绿色按钮开始。

candidates.chinese: 请点击图片查看大图。

candidates.chinese: 我桌上的时钟停在了六点。

candidates.english: It will be cloudy but dry tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 明天多云但不下雨。

candidates.chinese: 教练给我们示范了一个新练习。

candidates.chinese: 我们的教练安排了一场简短的训练赛。

candidates.english: The swimming coach checked each student's form.
candidates.chinese: 游泳教练检查了每个学生的姿势。

candidates.chinese: 夏天我们沿着海岸骑行。

candidates.chinese: 小船在多岩石的海岸附近移动。

candidates.chinese: 这个小镇离海岸五公里。

candidates.english: My father drinks coffee without sugar.
candidates.chinese: 我爸爸喝不加糖的咖啡。

candidates.chinese: 这家咖啡馆冬天卖热咖啡。

candidates.chinese: 桌子上有一杯咖啡。

candidates.english: We use the computer to make a class poster.
candidates.chinese: 我们用电脑制作班级海报。

candidates.chinese: 我姐姐把作业保存在电脑上。

candidates.chinese: 她给每个孩子一块曲奇饼。

candidates.chinese: 午饭后我吃了一块巧克力曲奇饼。

candidates.chinese: 汤姆把一块曲奇饼放进了书包。

candidates.chinese: 两个小组在这个项目上进行了合作。

candidates.chinese: 角落里放着一张小桌子。

candidates.chinese: 那只猫睡在一个温暖的角落里。

candidates.chinese: 打扫后把扫帚放在角落里。

candidates.chinese: 工人们在田里采摘棉花。

candidates.chinese: 桌子上有一袋棉花。

candidates.chinese: 他的咳嗽让他夜里无法入睡。

candidates.chinese: 咳嗽时请捂住嘴。

candidates.chinese: 两天后她的咳嗽好转了。

candidates.chinese: 我们在乡村拍了许多照片。

candidates.english: The concert was held in the school hall.
candidates.chinese: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。

candidates.english: Students gathered in the hall for the speech.
candidates.chinese: 学生们聚集在礼堂听演讲。

candidates.english: The awards ceremony began in the hall.
candidates.chinese: 颁奖典礼在礼堂开始了。

candidates.english: The handsome actor greeted his fans.
candidates.chinese: 这位英俊的演员向粉丝问好。

candidates.english: My cousin looked handsome in his new jacket.
candidates.chinese: 我表哥穿着新夹克显得很英俊。

candidates.english: The handsome guide showed us around the museum.
candidates.chinese: 那位英俊的导游带我们参观了博物馆。

candidates.english: Wear a hat in the strong sun.
candidates.chinese: 烈日下要戴帽子。

candidates.english: Tom put his hat on the desk.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆把他的帽子放在书桌上。

candidates.english: This red hat keeps my head warm.
candidates.chinese: 这顶红帽子让我的头保持温暖。

candidates.english: She smiled and said hello to everyone.
candidates.chinese: 她微笑着向每个人问好。

candidates.english: Please say hello when you meet the teacher.
candidates.chinese: 见到老师时请说你好。

candidates.english: Jack waved and called hello from the door.
candidates.chinese: 杰克挥手从门口喊你好。

candidates.english: The hen laid an egg this morning.
candidates.chinese: 这只母鸡今天早晨下了一个蛋。

candidates.english: A brown hen walked around the yard.
candidates.chinese: 一只棕色的母鸡在院子里走来走去。

candidates.english: The farmer gave the hen some corn.
candidates.chinese: 农民给那只母鸡一些玉米。

candidates.english: I said hi to our new neighbour.
candidates.chinese: 我向新邻居问了好。

candidates.english: Hi, Lily, your notebook is here.
candidates.chinese: 你好，莉莉，你的笔记本在这里。

candidates.english: Ben said hi before the class began.
candidates.chinese: 本在上课前说了你好。

candidates.english: We climbed the hill before breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 早餐前我们爬上了小山。

candidates.english: There is a small hill behind our school.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校后面有一座小山。

candidates.english: Flowers grow on the sunny hill.
candidates.chinese: 花儿长在阳光充足的小山上。

candidates.english: A river runs through my hometown.
candidates.chinese: 一条河流穿过我的家乡。

candidates.english: I visit my hometown every summer.
candidates.chinese: 我每年夏天都回我的家乡。

candidates.english: My hometown is famous for fresh apples.
candidates.chinese: 我的家乡以新鲜苹果闻名。

candidates.english: Add a spoonful of honey to the tea.
candidates.chinese: 在茶里加一勺蜂蜜。

candidates.english: The bread tastes sweet with honey.
candidates.chinese: 面包加上蜂蜜尝起来很甜。

candidates.english: Bees make honey from flowers.
candidates.chinese: 蜜蜂用花酿造蜂蜜。

candidates.english: The horse ran across the open field.
candidates.chinese: 那匹马跑过开阔的田野。

candidates.english: A white horse stood by the fence.
candidates.chinese: 一匹白马站在栅栏旁边。

candidates.english: The child drew a horse in art class.
candidates.chinese: 那个孩子在美术课上画了一匹马。

candidates.english: The host welcomed every guest warmly.
candidates.chinese: 主人热情欢迎每位客人。

candidates.english: The hostess showed us where to sit.
candidates.chinese: 女主人告诉我们坐在哪里。

candidates.english: Mr Chen will host the school music show.
candidates.chinese: 陈老师将主持学校音乐节目。

candidates.english: Our hotel is near the railway station.
candidates.chinese: 我们的酒店在火车站附近。

candidates.english: They stayed at a small hotel by the sea.
candidates.chinese: 他们住在海边一家小酒店里。

candidates.english: The hotel room was clean and quiet.
candidates.chinese: 酒店房间干净又安静。

candidates.english: A huge tree stands beside the lake.
candidates.chinese: 湖边立着一棵大树。

candidates.english: A huge bus stopped outside the library.
candidates.chinese: 一辆巨大的公共汽车停在图书馆外。

candidates.english: We saw a huge pumpkin at the farm.
candidates.chinese: 我们在农场看到一个巨大的南瓜。

candidates.english: Clean water is a basic human need.
candidates.chinese: 清洁的水是人类的基本需求。

candidates.english: Human life depends on clean air.
candidates.chinese: 人类的生命依赖清洁的空气。

candidates.english: The book explains human history in simple words.
candidates.chinese: 这本书用简单的语言解释人类的历史。

candidates.english: The fox hunts for food at night.
candidates.chinese: 狐狸在夜间觅食。

candidates.english: We hunted for shells on the beach.
candidates.chinese: 我们在海滩上搜寻贝壳。

candidates.english: Mina is hunting for her lost pencil.
candidates.chinese: 米娜正在搜寻她丢失的铅笔。

candidates.english: The ice melted in the warm room.
candidates.chinese: 冰在温暖的房间里融化了。

candidates.english: Please put some ice in the juice.
candidates.chinese: 请在果汁里放一些冰。

candidates.english: Thin ice covered the small pond.
candidates.chinese: 薄冰覆盖了小池塘。

candidates.english: We shared some ice cream after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后我们一起吃了冰淇淋。

candidates.english: I chose mango ice cream at the shop.
candidates.chinese: 我在店里选了芒果冰淇淋。

candidates.english: The ice cream melted in the hot sun.
candidates.chinese: 冰淇淋在炎热的阳光下融化了。

candidates.english: Tourism is important to the local industry.
candidates.chinese: 旅游业对当地产业很重要。

candidates.english: New machines changed the town's industry.
candidates.chinese: 新机器改变了这个小镇的工业。

candidates.english: Steel is a key part of heavy industry.
candidates.chinese: 钢铁是重工业的重要组成部分。

candidates.english: This tiny insect has bright green wings.
candidates.chinese: 这只小昆虫有鲜绿色的翅膀。

candidates.english: An insect landed on the classroom window.
candidates.chinese: 一只昆虫落在教室的窗户上。

candidates.english: The book shows each insect in clear pictures.
candidates.chinese: 这本书用清晰的图片展示每种昆虫。

candidates.english: Students joined an international science event.
candidates.chinese: 学生们参加了一场国际科学活动。

candidates.english: Our school welcomed international visitors today.
candidates.chinese: 我们学校今天接待了国际访客。

candidates.english: The city has an international airport.
candidates.chinese: 这座城市有一个国际机场。

candidates.english: The Internet helps us find useful information.
candidates.chinese: 互联网帮助我们查找有用的信息。

candidates.english: My grandma learned to use the Internet.
candidates.chinese: 我的奶奶学会了使用互联网。

candidates.english: The Internet was slow during the online class.
candidates.chinese: 网课期间互联网很慢。

candidates.english: We interviewed a local farmer for the project.
candidates.chinese: 我们为项目采访了一位当地农民。

candidates.english: The reporter had an interview with the swimmer.
candidates.chinese: 记者采访了那位游泳运动员。

candidates.english: May I interview you about your school club?
candidates.chinese: 我可以采访你关于你的学校社团吗？

candidates.english: A small boat carried us to the island.
candidates.chinese: 一艘小船把我们送到岛上。

candidates.english: Many birds live on this quiet island.
candidates.chinese: 许多鸟生活在这座安静的岛上。

candidates.english: The map shows an island near the coast.
candidates.chinese: 地图显示海岸附近有一座岛。

candidates.english: He wore jeans and a white shirt.
candidates.chinese: 他穿着牛仔裤和白衬衫。

candidates.english: These blue jeans are too long for me.
candidates.chinese: 这条蓝色牛仔裤对我来说太长了。

candidates.english: She folded her jeans before packing them.
candidates.chinese: 她在打包前把牛仔裤叠好。

candidates.english: Do not judge a person too quickly.
candidates.chinese: 不要太快评判一个人。

candidates.english: We can judge the weather by the clouds.
candidates.chinese: 我们可以通过云来判断天气。

candidates.english: The teacher judged the answer from the facts.
candidates.chinese: 老师根据事实判断了答案。

candidates.english: She joined the junior basketball team.
candidates.chinese: 她加入了初级篮球队。

candidates.english: He reads books for junior learners.
candidates.chinese: 他阅读适合初级学习者的书。

candidates.english: This is a junior cooking class for beginners.
candidates.chinese: 这是一门面向初学者的初级烹饪课。

candidates.english: Water spilled onto the computer keyboard.
candidates.chinese: 水洒到了电脑键盘上。

candidates.english: Please clean the keyboard with a soft cloth.
candidates.chinese: 请用软布清洁键盘。

candidates.english: Her new keyboard makes typing easier.
candidates.chinese: 她的新键盘让打字更容易。

candidates.english: Kick the ball towards the goal.
candidates.chinese: 把球踢向球门。

candidates.english: He can kick very far with his left foot.
candidates.chinese: 他能用左脚踢得很远。

candidates.english: The player gave the ball a strong kick.
candidates.chinese: 那名球员用力踢了球一下。

candidates.english: The bag weighs one kilo.
candidates.chinese: 这个包重一千克。

candidates.english: I bought half a kilo of apples.
candidates.chinese: 我买了半千克苹果。

candidates.english: This box is about three kilos.
candidates.chinese: 这个箱子大约三千克。

candidates.english: The king listened to the people’s concerns.
candidates.chinese: 国王倾听了人民的忧虑。

candidates.english: The king lived in a stone palace.
candidates.chinese: 国王住在一座石头宫殿里。

candidates.english: People gave flowers to the old king.
candidates.chinese: 人们把花献给了老国王。

candidates.english: She hurt her knee during the match.
candidates.chinese: 她在比赛中伤了膝盖。

candidates.english: He put a bandage on his knee.
candidates.chinese: 他在膝盖上贴了绷带。

candidates.english: Bend your knee slowly during this exercise.
candidates.chinese: 做这个练习时慢慢弯曲你的膝盖。

candidates.english: My cousin practises kung fu every Saturday.
candidates.chinese: 我的表弟每周六练习功夫。

candidates.english: Tom learned kung fu at a sports club.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆在一家体育俱乐部学习功夫。

candidates.english: The movie star showed kung fu in the show.
candidates.chinese: 那位电影明星在节目中展示了功夫。

candidates.english: Wear safety glasses in the science lab.
candidates.chinese: 在科学实验室要戴护目镜。

candidates.english: The students cleaned the lab after class.
candidates.chinese: 学生们课后打扫了实验室。

candidates.english: Our chemistry lab has many glass bottles.
candidates.chinese: 我们的化学实验室有许多玻璃瓶。

candidates.english: An elderly lady asked for my help.
candidates.chinese: 一位年长的女士向我求助。

candidates.english: A young lady bought tickets at the station.
candidates.chinese: 一位年轻女士在车站买了票。

candidates.english: The lady in a blue coat smiled at us.
candidates.chinese: 那位穿蓝色外套的女士对我们微笑。

candidates.english: I turned on the lamp to read.
candidates.chinese: 我打开灯看书。

candidates.english: A small lamp stood beside my bed.
candidates.chinese: 我的床边有一盏小灯。

candidates.english: Dad fixed the broken desk lamp yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸昨天修好了坏掉的台灯。

candidates.english: The mountain landscape was beautiful at sunrise.
candidates.chinese: 日出时的山间风景很美。

candidates.english: The lake landscape looked peaceful in autumn.
candidates.chinese: 秋天的湖边风景看起来很宁静。

candidates.english: We painted the village landscape in art class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在美术课上画了乡村风景。

candidates.english: We hung a red lantern by the door.
candidates.chinese: 我们在门旁挂了一个红灯笼。

candidates.english: Each child carried a paper lantern at night.
candidates.chinese: 每个孩子晚上都提着一个纸灯笼。

candidates.english: Grandma made a lantern for the festival.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶为节日做了一个灯笼。

candidates.english: She uses her laptop to finish school projects.
candidates.chinese: 她用笔记本电脑完成学校项目。

candidates.english: My laptop is light enough for school.
candidates.chinese: 我的笔记本电脑很轻，适合带去学校。

candidates.english: He saved the photos on his laptop.
candidates.chinese: 他把照片保存在他的笔记本电脑上。

candidates.english: The lawyer explained the law in simple words.
candidates.chinese: 律师用简单的话解释了法律。

candidates.english: Her uncle works as a lawyer in Shanghai.
candidates.chinese: 她叔叔在上海当律师。

candidates.english: The lawyer helped the family with the document.
candidates.chinese: 律师帮助这家人处理了那份文件。

candidates.english: Add a slice of lemon to the water.
candidates.chinese: 在水里加一片柠檬。

candidates.english: The lemon juice made the soup fresh.
candidates.chinese: 柠檬汁让汤变得清新。

candidates.english: Mom put a lemon in the shopping bag.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈把一个柠檬放进购物袋里。

candidates.english: This book is suitable for your reading level.
candidates.chinese: 这本书适合你的阅读水平。

candidates.english: He reached the next level in the game.
candidates.chinese: 他在游戏中达到了下一个级别。

candidates.english: The test checks each student's English level.
candidates.chinese: 这项测试检查每个学生的英语水平。

candidates.english: A flash of lightning lit up the sky.
candidates.chinese: 一道闪电照亮了天空。

candidates.english: We saw lightning over the sea last night.
candidates.chinese: 昨晚我们看见海面上空有闪电。

candidates.english: The children stayed inside during the lightning.
candidates.chinese: 有闪电时，孩子们待在室内。

candidates.english: Rain is likely this afternoon.
candidates.chinese: 今天下午可能会下雨。

candidates.english: It is likely that the bus will be late.
candidates.chinese: 公交车可能会晚点。

candidates.chinese: 她可能会加入学校乐队。

candidates.english: The lion rested under a tree.
candidates.chinese: 狮子在树下休息。

candidates.chinese: 狮子能在短时间内跑得很快。

candidates.chinese: 动物园管理员中午喂了狮子。

candidates.english: She studies Chinese literature at university.
candidates.chinese: 她在大学学习中国文学。

candidates.english: Our teacher introduced world literature today.
candidates.chinese: 我们老师今天介绍了世界文学。

candidates.english: Poems are an important part of literature.
candidates.chinese: 诗歌是文学的重要组成部分。

candidates.english: The farm suffered a great loss in the fire.
candidates.chinese: 农场在火灾中遭受了巨大损失。

candidates.english: The shop reported a small loss this month.
candidates.chinese: 这家商店报告本月有小额损失。

candidates.english: Careful planning can reduce the loss of money.
candidates.chinese: 仔细计划可以减少金钱损失。

candidates.english: We ate lunch under a large tree.
candidates.chinese: 我们在一棵大树下吃午饭。

candidates.english: I packed noodles for lunch today.
candidates.chinese: 我今天带了面条当午餐。

candidates.english: Our lunch starts after the fourth class.
candidates.chinese: 我们的午餐在第四节课后开始。

candidates.english: Can I help you, madam?
candidates.chinese: 女士，我能帮您吗？

candidates.english: Please take this seat, madam.
candidates.chinese: 女士，请坐这个座位。

candidates.english: Your bag is at the desk, madam.
candidates.chinese: 女士，您的包在桌子旁。

candidates.english: I read a science magazine on the train.
candidates.chinese: 我在火车上读了一本科学杂志。

candidates.english: She bought a music magazine yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 她昨天买了一本音乐杂志。

candidates.english: This magazine has a story about pandas.
candidates.chinese: 这本杂志里有一篇关于熊猫的故事。

candidates.english: The main reason is a lack of time.
candidates.chinese: 主要原因是时间不足。

candidates.english: The main road is closed today.
candidates.chinese: 今天主路关闭了。

candidates.english: Her main job is to check the tickets.
candidates.chinese: 她的主要工作是检查票。

candidates.english: The new mall has a cinema and many shops.
candidates.chinese: 新购物中心里有一家电影院和许多商店。

candidates.english: My family had dinner at the mall.
candidates.chinese: 我家人在购物中心吃了晚饭。

candidates.english: The bus stops in front of the mall.
candidates.chinese: 公交车停在购物中心前面。

candidates.english: We bought fresh vegetables at the market.
candidates.chinese: 我们在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

candidates.english: The fish market opens early each day.
candidates.chinese: 鱼市场每天很早开门。

candidates.english: There is a flower market near the park.
candidates.chinese: 公园附近有一个花卉市场。

candidates.english: Maths is my favourite subject at school.
candidates.chinese: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

candidates.english: We have Maths on Monday morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期一早晨有数学课。

candidates.english: Tom solved the Maths problem quickly.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆很快解出了那道数学题。

candidates.english: Video is a useful medium for learning.
candidates.chinese: 视频是一种有用的学习媒介。

candidates.english: Radio was an important medium for news.
candidates.chinese: 广播曾是一种重要的新闻媒介。

candidates.english: Email is a common medium for school notices.
candidates.chinese: 电子邮件是一种常见的学校通知媒介。

candidates.english: The meeting begins at three o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 会议三点开始。

candidates.english: Dad has a meeting at the office.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在办公室有一个会议。

candidates.english: The teachers held a short meeting after school.
candidates.chinese: 老师们放学后开了一个短会。

candidates.english: The village is one mile from here.
candidates.chinese: 村庄离这里一英里。

candidates.english: The lake is two miles from our hotel.
candidates.chinese: 湖离我们的旅馆两英里。

candidates.english: She walked half a mile to the station.
candidates.chinese: 她步行半英里到车站。

candidates.english: Miss Wang teaches us English.
candidates.chinese: 王老师教我们英语。

candidates.english: Miss Chen wrote the answer on the board.
candidates.chinese: 陈老师把答案写在黑板上。

candidates.english: Good morning, Miss Zhao.
candidates.chinese: 早上好，赵老师。

candidates.english: We built a model of the solar system.
candidates.chinese: 我们制作了一个太阳系模型。

candidates.english: This model plane is made of paper.
candidates.chinese: 这个飞机模型是纸做的。

candidates.english: The museum shows a small model of the bridge.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆展示了一个小桥梁模型。

candidates.english: I go running every morning before breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我每天早饭前晨跑。

candidates.english: The sun was bright this morning.
candidates.chinese: 今天早晨阳光明媚。

candidates.english: We cleaned the classroom on Sunday morning.
candidates.chinese: 我们星期天早晨打扫了教室。

candidates.english: A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
candidates.chinese: 一只老鼠跑过厨房地板。

candidates.english: The cat watched a mouse near the door.
candidates.chinese: 猫看着门旁的一只老鼠。

candidates.chinese: 一只小老鼠躲在盒子后面。

candidates.chinese: 李老师是我们的新科学老师。

candidates.english: Mr Zhang drives the school bus.
candidates.chinese: 张先生开校车。

candidates.chinese: 我把表格交给了格林先生。

candidates.english: Mrs Green lives next door to us.
candidates.chinese: 格林太太住在我们隔壁。

candidates.english: Mrs Wang teaches music at our school.
candidates.chinese: 王太太在我们学校教音乐。

candidates.chinese: 请把这封信交给李太太。
