candidates.chinese: 陈女士将主持今天的会议。

candidates.english: Ms Lin works in the school library.
candidates.chinese: 林女士在学校图书馆工作。

candidates.english: I asked Ms Zhao for help after class.
candidates.chinese: 课后我向赵女士寻求帮助。

candidates.english: The restaurant serves noodles with mutton.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆供应羊肉面。

candidates.english: Dad bought fresh mutton for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸买了新鲜羊肉做晚餐。

candidates.english: This soup has carrots and mutton in it.
candidates.chinese: 这汤里有胡萝卜和羊肉。

candidates.english: We walked along a narrow mountain path.
candidates.chinese: 我们沿着一条狭窄的山路行走。

candidates.english: The bus moved slowly through a narrow street.
candidates.chinese: 公共汽车缓慢地穿过一条狭窄的街道。

candidates.english: There is a narrow bridge over the river.
candidates.chinese: 河上有一座狭窄的桥。

candidates.english: She wore a scarf around her neck.
candidates.chinese: 她在脖子上围了一条围巾。

candidates.english: My neck hurt after I slept badly.
candidates.chinese: 我没睡好后脖子疼。

candidates.english: The doctor looked at the boy's neck.
candidates.chinese: 医生查看了这个男孩的脖子。

candidates.english: Negative thoughts can stop us from trying.
candidates.chinese: 消极的想法会阻止我们尝试。

candidates.english: Try not to use negative words about yourself.
candidates.chinese: 尽量不要用消极的话说自己。

candidates.english: His negative answer made the team less confident.
candidates.chinese: 他消极的回答让团队不那么自信了。

candidates.english: Grandpa reads the newspaper after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 爷爷早餐后读报纸。

candidates.english: A newspaper was on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 厨房桌子上有一份报纸。

candidates.english: The teacher cut a picture from the newspaper.
candidates.chinese: 老师从报纸上剪下一张图片。

candidates.english: The sun was high in the sky at noon.
candidates.chinese: 中午太阳高挂在天空。

candidates.english: We have lunch at noon every day.
candidates.chinese: 我们每天中午吃午饭。

candidates.english: The train leaves the station at noon.
candidates.chinese: 火车中午离开车站。

candidates.english: The strange object was made of metal.
candidates.chinese: 这个奇怪的物体是金属制成的。

candidates.english: Put the heavy object on the floor.
candidates.chinese: 把这个重物体放在地板上。

candidates.english: A small round object rolled under the desk.
candidates.chinese: 一个小圆物体滚到了书桌下面。

candidates.english: The film starts at seven o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 电影七点钟开始。

candidates.english: Class begins at eight o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 八点钟开始上课。

candidates.english: I usually go to bed at ten o'clock.
candidates.chinese: 我通常十点钟睡觉。

candidates.english: Heat a little oil in the pan.
candidates.chinese: 在平底锅里加热少量油。

candidates.english: There is oil on the kitchen floor.
candidates.chinese: 厨房地板上有油。

candidates.english: This bottle is full of cooking oil.
candidates.chinese: 这个瓶子装满了食用油。

candidates.english: Is it OK if I open the window?
candidates.chinese: 我打开窗户可以吗？

candidates.english: OK, I will wait for you here.
candidates.chinese: 好的，我会在这里等你。

candidates.english: You can use my pen if that is OK.
candidates.chinese: 如果可以的话，你可以用我的钢笔。

candidates.english: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal.
candidates.chinese: 她梦想赢得一枚奥运会奖牌。

candidates.english: The Olympic Games bring athletes together.
candidates.chinese: 奥运会把运动员聚集在一起。

candidates.english: Our class learned about the Olympic flag.
candidates.chinese: 我们班学习了奥运会会旗。

candidates.english: Chop the onion into small pieces.
candidates.chinese: 把洋葱切成小块。

candidates.english: An onion gives the dish a strong smell.
candidates.chinese: 洋葱让这道菜有一股浓烈的气味。

candidates.english: Mom put one onion into the soup.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈往汤里放了一个洋葱。

candidates.english: We watched a traditional Chinese opera.
candidates.chinese: 我们观看了一场中国传统戏曲。

candidates.english: The opera tells an old story through songs.
candidates.chinese: 这部歌剧通过歌曲讲述一个古老的故事。

candidates.english: My aunt enjoys listening to Italian opera.
candidates.chinese: 我姑姑喜欢听意大利歌剧。

candidates.english: The bread is baking in the oven.
candidates.chinese: 面包正在烤箱里烘烤。

candidates.english: Mom put the chicken in the oven.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈把鸡肉放进了烤箱。

candidates.english: The cake came out of the oven at noon.
candidates.chinese: 蛋糕中午从烤箱里拿了出来。

candidates.english: She opened a packet of biscuits.
candidates.chinese: 她打开了一包饼干。

candidates.english: He bought a small packet of seeds.
candidates.chinese: 他买了一小包种子。

candidates.english: There is a packet of sugar on the table.
candidates.chinese: 桌上有一小袋糖。

candidates.english: Thousands of visitors tour the palace each year.
candidates.chinese: 每年有数千名游客参观这座宫殿。

candidates.english: The old palace stands beside the river.
candidates.chinese: 这座古老的宫殿坐落在河边。

candidates.english: We saw a golden gate at the palace.
candidates.chinese: 我们在宫殿看见了一扇金色的大门。

candidates.english: He looked pale after feeling ill all morning.
candidates.chinese: 他病了一上午后脸色苍白。

candidates.english: Her face was pale after the long bus ride.
candidates.chinese: 长途公交车程后，她的脸色很苍白。

candidates.english: Tom turned pale when he felt dizzy.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆感到头晕时脸色变得苍白。

candidates.english: I ate a pancake with fruit for breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我早餐吃了一个配水果的薄煎饼。

candidates.english: Dad made one pancake in the pan.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在平底锅里做了一个薄煎饼。

candidates.english: The warm pancake smelled sweet.
candidates.chinese: 热乎乎的薄煎饼闻起来很香甜。

candidates.english: The first paragraph introduces the main idea.
candidates.chinese: 第一段介绍了主要观点。

candidates.english: Please write one paragraph about your school day.
candidates.chinese: 请写一个段落，介绍你在学校的一天。

candidates.english: This paragraph has five short sentences.
candidates.chinese: 这个段落有五个短句。

candidates.english: Please pardon me for arriving late.
candidates.chinese: 请原谅我迟到了。

candidates.english: I hope you can pardon my small mistake.
candidates.chinese: 我希望你能原谅我的小错误。

candidates.english: Pardon me for taking your seat by mistake.
candidates.chinese: 请原谅我误坐了你的座位。

candidates.english: Discuss the question with your partner.
candidates.chinese: 和你的搭档讨论这个问题。

candidates.english: My partner and I finished the science poster.
candidates.chinese: 我和我的搭档完成了科学海报。

candidates.english: Choose a partner for the dialogue practice.
candidates.chinese: 为对话练习选择一个搭档。

candidates.english: Read the passage and answer the questions.
candidates.chinese: 阅读短文并回答问题。

candidates.english: This passage is about a school trip.
candidates.chinese: 这篇短文是关于一次学校旅行的。

candidates.english: Find three new words in the passage.
candidates.chinese: 在这篇文章中找出三个生词。

candidates.english: Every passenger must wear a seat belt.
candidates.chinese: 每位乘客都必须系安全带。

candidates.english: A passenger asked where the bus stopped.
candidates.chinese: 一位乘客问公交车在哪里停靠。

candidates.english: The train passenger sat near the window.
candidates.chinese: 那位火车乘客坐在窗边。

candidates.english: Keep your passport in a safe place.
candidates.chinese: 把你的护照放在安全的地方。

candidates.english: She showed her passport at the airport.
candidates.chinese: 她在机场出示了护照。

candidates.english: My passport is in the blue bag.
candidates.chinese: 我的护照在蓝色包里。

candidates.english: She cut the pear into four pieces.
candidates.chinese: 她把梨切成四块。

candidates.english: I put a green pear in my lunch box.
candidates.chinese: 我把一个绿色的梨放进了午餐盒。

candidates.english: The ripe pear tasted very sweet.
candidates.chinese: 这个熟透的梨尝起来很甜。

candidates.english: The penguin keeps its egg warm.
candidates.chinese: 企鹅让它的蛋保持温暖。

candidates.english: A penguin walked slowly on the ice.
candidates.chinese: 一只企鹅在冰上慢慢走。

candidates.english: The baby penguin followed its mother.
candidates.chinese: 小企鹅跟在它妈妈后面。

candidates.english: Add a little pepper to the soup.
candidates.chinese: 在汤里加一点胡椒粉。

candidates.english: Grandma put pepper on the noodles.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶在面条上撒了胡椒粉。

candidates.english: This dish needs more pepper.
candidates.chinese: 这道菜需要更多胡椒粉。

candidates.english: About sixty per cent of the students walk to school.
candidates.chinese: 大约百分之六十的学生步行上学。

candidates.english: Twenty per cent of the apples are green.
candidates.chinese: 百分之二十的苹果是绿色的。

candidates.english: The store gave us ten per cent off.
candidates.chinese: 商店给了我们百分之十的折扣。

candidates.english: We did an interesting experiment in physics class.
candidates.chinese: 我们在物理课上做了一个有趣的实验。

candidates.english: My brother likes physics because it explains light and sound.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥喜欢物理学，因为它解释光和声音。

candidates.english: The museum has a physics show about magnets.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆有一场关于磁铁的物理演示。

candidates.english: Mum baked an apple pie for dessert.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈烤了一个苹果派当甜点。

candidates.english: Dad cut the cherry pie into six pieces.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸把樱桃馅饼切成了六块。

candidates.english: I shared a small meat pie with my cousin.
candidates.chinese: 我和表弟分享了一个小肉馅饼。

candidates.english: The little pig slept in the warm sun.
candidates.chinese: 小猪在温暖的阳光下睡觉。

candidates.english: A pink pig stood near the farm gate.
candidates.chinese: 一头粉色的猪站在农场门口附近。

candidates.english: The farmer gave the pig some fresh water.
candidates.chinese: 农民给那头猪一些清水。

candidates.english: Take this pill after breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 早餐后服用这片药。

candidates.english: The nurse gave me one pill with water.
candidates.chinese: 护士给了我一片药和水。

candidates.english: This small pill is easy to swallow.
candidates.chinese: 这片小药片容易吞咽。

candidates.english: We play ping-pong during the lunch break.
candidates.chinese: 我们午休时打乒乓球。

candidates.english: There is a ping-pong table in our gym.
candidates.chinese: 我们体育馆里有一张乒乓球桌。

candidates.english: Tom brought two ping-pong bats to school.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆带了两只乒乓球拍到学校。

candidates.english: She was a pioneer in space science.
candidates.chinese: 她是太空科学领域的先驱。

candidates.english: The doctor was a pioneer in heart care.
candidates.chinese: 这位医生是心脏护理领域的先驱。

candidates.english: This engineer became a pioneer of green buildings.
candidates.chinese: 这位工程师成了绿色建筑领域的先驱。

candidates.english: Put the sandwiches on a large plate.
candidates.chinese: 把三明治放在一个大盘子里。

candidates.english: Please wash your plate after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 午饭后请洗你的盘子。

candidates.english: A blue plate fell off the table.
candidates.chinese: 一个蓝色盘子从桌上掉了下来。

candidates.english: The train leaves at 3 p.m.
candidates.chinese: 火车下午三点出发。

candidates.english: The meeting starts at 2 p.m.
candidates.chinese: 会议下午两点开始。

candidates.english: School ends at 5 p.m. today.
candidates.chinese: 今天学校下午五点放学。

candidates.english: He put the key in his pocket.
candidates.chinese: 他把钥匙放进口袋。

candidates.english: There is a coin in my jacket pocket.
candidates.chinese: 我的夹克口袋里有一枚硬币。

candidates.english: Her phone rang inside her pocket.
candidates.chinese: 她的手机在她的口袋里响了。

candidates.english: She wrote a short poem about spring.
candidates.chinese: 她写了一首关于春天的短诗。

candidates.english: Our teacher asked us to read a poem.
candidates.chinese: 老师让我们读一首诗。

candidates.english: The poem on the wall is about the sea.
candidates.chinese: 墙上的那首诗是关于大海的。

candidates.english: The young poet read her work aloud.
candidates.chinese: 年轻的诗人大声朗读了她的作品。

candidates.english: The poet used simple words in the book.
candidates.chinese: 这位诗人在书中使用了简单的词语。

candidates.english: A famous poet visited our school library.
candidates.chinese: 一位著名诗人参观了我们学校图书馆。

candidates.english: The town has a population of about ten thousand.
candidates.chinese: 这个镇大约有一万人口。

candidates.english: The population of this city is growing fast.
candidates.chinese: 这座城市的人口增长很快。

candidates.english: China has a large population.
candidates.chinese: 中国人口众多。

candidates.english: We had pork and vegetables for dinner.
candidates.chinese: 我们晚饭吃了猪肉和蔬菜。

candidates.english: Grandma cooked pork noodles for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶午饭做了猪肉面。

candidates.english: This soup has pork and carrots in it.
candidates.chinese: 这汤里有猪肉和胡萝卜。

candidates.english: A bowl of hot porridge warmed me up.
candidates.chinese: 一碗热粥让我暖和起来。

candidates.english: I eat rice porridge on cold mornings.
candidates.chinese: 在寒冷的早晨我吃米粥。

candidates.english: The baby finished a small bowl of porridge.
candidates.chinese: 这个婴儿喝完了一小碗粥。

candidates.english: A positive attitude helps us face difficulties.
candidates.chinese: 积极的态度帮助我们面对困难。

candidates.english: She gave me positive advice before the test.
candidates.chinese: 考试前她给了我积极的建议。

candidates.english: Our coach stayed positive after the rainy start.
candidates.chinese: 比赛开始时下着雨，但我们的教练仍然保持积极。

candidates.english: I sent my friend a postcard from London.
candidates.chinese: 我从伦敦给朋友寄了一张明信片。

candidates.english: We bought a postcard at the museum shop.
candidates.chinese: 我们在博物馆商店买了一张明信片。

candidates.english: There is a beach picture on this postcard.
candidates.chinese: 这张明信片上有一幅海滩图画。

candidates.english: The postman brought a letter this morning.
candidates.chinese: 邮递员今天早上送来了一封信。

candidates.english: The postman put the magazines in our mailbox.
candidates.chinese: 邮递员把杂志放进了我们的邮箱。

candidates.english: Our postman knows every house on this street.
candidates.chinese: 我们的邮递员认识这条街上的每一户人家。

candidates.english: The notebook costs one pound.
candidates.chinese: 这本笔记本售价一英镑。

candidates.english: I paid five pounds for the small map.
candidates.chinese: 我花了五英镑买这张小地图。

candidates.english: The ticket was only two pounds.
candidates.chinese: 这张票只要两英镑。

candidates.english: The club president welcomed the new members.
candidates.chinese: 俱乐部主席欢迎了新成员。

candidates.english: The sports club president checked the event schedule.
candidates.chinese: 体育俱乐部主席查看了活动日程。

candidates.english: The student union president gave a short talk on Friday.
candidates.chinese: 学生会主席星期五作了简短发言。

candidates.english: Too much pressure can make it hard to sleep.
candidates.chinese: 压力过大会让人难以入睡。

candidates.english: Tom felt pressure before the math test.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆在数学考试前感到压力。

candidates.english: Deep breathing helped her deal with pressure.
candidates.chinese: 深呼吸帮助她应对压力。

candidates.english: My little brother goes to primary school.
candidates.chinese: 我的弟弟上小学。

candidates.english: The town has three primary school teachers.
candidates.chinese: 这个镇有三名小学教师。

candidates.english: We visited a primary classroom yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 我们昨天参观了一间小学教室。

candidates.english: The prince and princess helped the villagers.
candidates.chinese: 王子和公主帮助了村民。

candidates.english: The princess wore a blue coat in the story.
candidates.chinese: 故事里的公主穿着一件蓝色外套。

candidates.english: A young prince learned music from a teacher.
candidates.chinese: 一位年轻的王子向老师学习音乐。

candidates.english: Please print one copy of the report.
candidates.chinese: 请打印一份报告。

candidates.english: Can you print the timetable for me?
candidates.chinese: 你能帮我打印这张时间表吗？

candidates.english: Dad printed our family photo at home.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在家打印了我们的全家福。

candidates.english: The experiment proved that the idea was correct.
candidates.chinese: 实验证明这个想法是正确的。

candidates.english: The photo proves that we were there.
candidates.chinese: 这张照片证明我们在那里。

candidates.english: These numbers prove his answer is right.
candidates.chinese: 这些数字证明他的答案是正确的。

candidates.english: She painted the flowers purple.
candidates.chinese: 她把花涂成了紫色。

candidates.english: My sister has a purple schoolbag.
candidates.chinese: 我妹妹有一个紫色的书包。

candidates.english: The curtains in the music room are purple.
candidates.chinese: 音乐教室里的窗帘是紫色的。

candidates.english: The queen spoke to the crowd from the palace.
candidates.chinese: 女王在宫殿里向人群讲话。

candidates.english: The queen lived in an old castle.
candidates.chinese: 女王住在一座古老的城堡里。

candidates.english: A picture of the queen hung in the hall.
candidates.chinese: 大厅里挂着一幅女王的画像。

candidates.english: The rabbit hid behind a rock.
candidates.chinese: 兔子躲在一块岩石后面。

candidates.english: A white rabbit sat near the garden gate.
candidates.chinese: 一只白兔子坐在花园门旁。

candidates.english: The rabbit ate a fresh carrot.
candidates.chinese: 兔子吃了一根新鲜胡萝卜。

candidates.english: Mia came first in the school race.
candidates.chinese: 米娅在学校赛跑中获得第一名。

candidates.english: The race began after the whistle.
candidates.chinese: 哨声响后，赛跑开始了。

candidates.english: We will have a short race in PE class.
candidates.chinese: 我们将在体育课上进行一次短距离赛跑。

candidates.english: A railway runs through the valley.
candidates.chinese: 一条铁路穿过山谷。

candidates.english: The railway is beside the river.
candidates.chinese: 这条铁路在河边。

candidates.english: Workers checked the railway before the train arrived.
candidates.chinese: 工人在火车到达前检查了铁路。

candidates.english: A rainbow appeared after the storm.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨后出现了一道彩虹。

candidates.english: The children drew a rainbow in art class.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在美术课上画了一道彩虹。

candidates.english: We saw a rainbow above the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们看见湖上方有一道彩虹。

candidates.english: The rocket carried a satellite into space.
candidates.chinese: 火箭把一颗卫星送入太空。

candidates.english: The rocket stood on the launch pad.
candidates.chinese: 火箭立在发射台上。

candidates.english: A small model rocket flew above the field.
candidates.chinese: 一枚小模型火箭飞过了田野上空。

candidates.english: He gave his mother a red rose.
candidates.chinese: 他送给妈妈一朵红玫瑰。

candidates.english: A pink rose grew beside the gate.
candidates.chinese: 一朵粉色玫瑰长在大门旁边。

candidates.english: She drew a rose on the card.
candidates.chinese: 她在卡片上画了一朵玫瑰。

candidates.english: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
candidates.chinese: 用尺子画一条直线。

candidates.english: My ruler is twenty centimeters long.
candidates.chinese: 我的尺子有二十厘米长。

candidates.english: He found a ruler under his desk.
candidates.chinese: 他在书桌下面找到了一把尺子。

candidates.english: We made a salad with tomatoes and carrots.
candidates.chinese: 我们用西红柿和胡萝卜做了沙拉。

candidates.english: She ordered a fruit salad after dinner.
candidates.chinese: 她晚饭后点了一份水果沙拉。

candidates.english: There is a bowl of salad on the table.
candidates.chinese: 桌子上有一碗沙拉。

candidates.english: The soup needs a little more salt.
candidates.chinese: 汤里需要再加一点盐。

candidates.english: There is a small jar of salt beside the stove.
candidates.chinese: 炉子旁边有一小罐盐。

candidates.english: Dad put salt on the potatoes.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸在土豆上撒了盐。

candidates.english: The children built a castle in the sand.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在沙子里堆了一座城堡。

candidates.english: Fine sand got into my shoes.
candidates.chinese: 细沙子进了我的鞋里。

candidates.english: The wind blew sand across the road.
candidates.chinese: 风把沙子吹过马路。

candidates.english: I packed a cheese sandwich for lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我午餐带了一个奶酪三明治。

candidates.english: She bought a chicken sandwich at the shop.
candidates.chinese: 她在商店买了一个鸡肉三明治。

candidates.english: My brother cut the sandwich in half.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥把三明治切成了两半。

candidates.english: This warm scarf was a gift from Grandma.
candidates.chinese: 这条暖和的围巾是奶奶送的礼物。

candidates.english: He wrapped a blue scarf around his neck.
candidates.chinese: 他把一条蓝色围巾围在脖子上。

candidates.english: I left my scarf on the bus.
candidates.chinese: 我把围巾落在公交车上了。

candidates.english: Do not look at the screen for too long.
candidates.chinese: 不要长时间盯着屏幕。

candidates.english: The computer screen is very bright.
candidates.chinese: 电脑屏幕很亮。

candidates.english: Words appeared on the screen.
candidates.chinese: 文字出现在屏幕上。

candidates.english: Several students stayed to clean the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 几个学生留下来打扫教室。

candidates.english: Several books fell from the desk.
candidates.chinese: 几本书从书桌上掉了下来。

candidates.english: I waited several minutes at the bus stop.
candidates.chinese: 我在公交车站等了几分钟。

candidates.english: A shark can smell food from far away.
candidates.chinese: 鲨鱼能从很远的地方闻到食物。

candidates.english: The shark swam slowly near the boat.
candidates.chinese: 鲨鱼在船附近慢慢游动。

candidates.english: We saw a shark at the aquarium.
candidates.chinese: 我们在水族馆看见了一条鲨鱼。

candidates.english: The dictionary is on the top shelf.
candidates.chinese: 词典在最上层的架子上。

candidates.english: Put the cups back on the shelf.
candidates.chinese: 把杯子放回架子上。

candidates.english: There are three shelves in the kitchen.
candidates.chinese: 厨房里有三个架子。

candidates.english: Do not shoot at the birds in the park.
candidates.chinese: 不要向公园里的鸟开枪。

candidates.english: In the game, players shoot at a paper target.
candidates.chinese: 在这项游戏中，选手们向纸靶射击。

candidates.english: She learned to shoot arrows at a sports camp.
candidates.chinese: 她在运动营学习射箭。

candidates.english: He wore shorts for the morning run.
candidates.chinese: 他穿着短裤晨跑。

candidates.english: These shorts are too small for me.
candidates.chinese: 这条短裤对我来说太小了。

candidates.english: She packed two pairs of shorts for the trip.
candidates.chinese: 她为这次旅行装了两条短裤。

candidates.english: She carried the bag on her shoulder.
candidates.chinese: 她把包背在肩上。

candidates.english: My left shoulder felt cold in the wind.
candidates.chinese: 风中我的左肩膀感到很冷。

candidates.english: He put a towel over his shoulder.
candidates.chinese: 他把一条毛巾搭在肩膀上。

candidates.english: A narrow path runs along the side of the lake.
candidates.chinese: 一条窄路沿着湖边延伸。

candidates.english: Please write your name on the left side of the paper.
candidates.chinese: 请把你的名字写在纸的左边。

candidates.english: There is a small door on the side of the bus.
candidates.chinese: 公交车的一边有一扇小门。

candidates.english: A silver key lay on the table.
candidates.chinese: 一把银色钥匙放在桌上。

candidates.english: She wore silver shoes for the school show.
candidates.chinese: 她为学校演出穿了银色的鞋子。

candidates.english: The moon made the river look silver at night.
candidates.chinese: 夜晚，月光使河面看起来是银色的。

candidates.english: Only a single ticket was left.
candidates.chinese: 只剩下一张票了。

candidates.english: He answered every question with a single word.
candidates.chinese: 他每个问题都用一个单词回答。

candidates.english: A single flower stood beside the window.
candidates.chinese: 窗边有一朵花。

candidates.english: Excuse me, sir, is this your wallet?
candidates.chinese: 打扰一下，先生，这是您的钱包吗？

candidates.english: Could you help me find the library, sir?
candidates.chinese: 先生，您能帮我找到图书馆吗？

candidates.english: Thank you, sir, for opening the door.
candidates.chinese: 谢谢您，先生，帮我开门。

candidates.english: She chose a blue skirt for the party.
candidates.chinese: 她为聚会选了一条蓝裙子。

candidates.english: Her red skirt moved softly in the wind.
candidates.chinese: 她的红裙子在风中轻轻摆动。

candidates.english: Mum washed my school skirt this morning.
candidates.chinese: 妈妈今天早上洗了我的校服裙子。

candidates.english: The slim athlete runs every morning.
candidates.chinese: 那位苗条的运动员每天早晨跑步。

candidates.english: A slim girl stood at the front of the class.
candidates.chinese: 一个苗条的女孩站在教室前面。

candidates.english: The slim model smiled in the photo.
candidates.chinese: 照片中那位苗条的模特微笑着。

candidates.english: I had fruit as an afternoon snack.
candidates.chinese: 我下午吃水果当点心。

candidates.english: Tom bought a small snack before the movie.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆在电影开始前买了一份小点心。

candidates.english: Grandma made rice cakes as a snack.
candidates.chinese: 奶奶做了米糕当点心。

candidates.english: A small snake moved through the grass.
candidates.chinese: 一条小蛇在草丛中爬行。

candidates.english: We saw a green snake near the river.
candidates.chinese: 我们在河边看到了一条绿色的蛇。

candidates.english: The picture book has a funny snake on the cover.
candidates.chinese: 这本图画书的封面上有一条有趣的蛇。

candidates.english: The word socialism appears in our history lesson.
candidates.chinese: “社会主义”一词出现在我们的历史课中。

candidates.english: Our teacher explained socialism with simple examples.
candidates.chinese: 我们的老师用简单的例子解释了社会主义。

candidates.english: The textbook gives a short definition of socialism.
candidates.chinese: 这本教材给出了社会主义的简短定义。

candidates.english: Education plays an important part in society.
candidates.chinese: 教育在社会中发挥着重要作用。

candidates.english: Rules help people live together in society.
candidates.chinese: 规则帮助人们在社会中共同生活。

candidates.english: Modern society uses computers in many ways.
candidates.chinese: 现代社会在许多方面使用电脑。

candidates.english: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
candidates.chinese: 猫正在沙发上睡觉。

candidates.english: Dad sat on the sofa and read a newspaper.
candidates.chinese: 爸爸坐在沙发上看报纸。

candidates.english: We moved the sofa closer to the window.
candidates.chinese: 我们把沙发移到了离窗户更近的地方。

candidates.english: Healthy soil helps plants grow well.
candidates.chinese: 健康的土壤帮助植物茁壮生长。

candidates.english: The farmer checked the soil before planting corn.
candidates.chinese: 农民在种玉米前检查了土壤。

candidates.english: Rain made the soil soft in the garden.
candidates.chinese: 雨水使花园里的土壤变软了。

candidates.english: The young soldier returned home safely.
candidates.chinese: 这名年轻士兵平安回家了。

candidates.english: A soldier helped carry food after the flood.
candidates.chinese: 一名士兵在洪水后帮忙搬运食物。

candidates.english: The soldier stood straight during the ceremony.
candidates.chinese: 仪式上，那名士兵站得笔直。

candidates.english: I left my glasses somewhere in the house.
candidates.chinese: 我把眼镜落在屋里的某个地方了。

candidates.english: My pen is somewhere under these books.
candidates.chinese: 我的钢笔在这些书下面的某处。

candidates.english: We heard music coming from somewhere nearby.
candidates.chinese: 我们听见音乐从附近某处传来。

candidates.english: My legs were sore after the long hike.
candidates.chinese: 长途徒步后我的腿很酸痛。

candidates.english: Her throat felt sore this morning.
candidates.chinese: 今天早上她的喉咙感到疼痛。

candidates.english: My hand is sore after writing for an hour.
candidates.chinese: 写了一个小时后，我的手很疼。

candidates.english: Draw a small square in the centre.
candidates.chinese: 在中央画一个小正方形。

candidates.english: Each tile on the floor is a blue square.
candidates.chinese: 地板上的每块瓷砖都是一个蓝色正方形。

candidates.english: Fold the paper into a neat square.
candidates.chinese: 把纸折成一个整齐的正方形。

candidates.english: The dancers walked onto the stage.
candidates.chinese: 舞者们走上了舞台。

candidates.english: The singer stood alone on the stage.
candidates.chinese: 歌手独自站在舞台上。

candidates.english: Workers put lights above the school stage.
candidates.chinese: 工人们把灯装在学校舞台上方。

candidates.english: The train arrived at the station on time.
candidates.chinese: 火车准时到达车站。

candidates.english: Meet me outside the bus station at six.
candidates.chinese: 六点在公共汽车站外面见我。

candidates.english: There is a small shop near the railway station.
candidates.chinese: 火车站附近有一家小商店。

candidates.english: My stomach hurt after the large meal.
candidates.chinese: 吃完这顿大餐后我的胃疼。

candidates.english: She drank some warm water because her stomach felt uncomfortable.
candidates.chinese: 她喝了些温水，因为她胃不舒服。

candidates.english: Too much cold food can upset your stomach.
candidates.chinese: 太多冷食可能会让你的胃不舒服。

candidates.english: The storm damaged several trees.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨损坏了几棵树。

candidates.english: We stayed indoors during the heavy storm.
candidates.chinese: 暴风雨很大时，我们待在室内。

candidates.english: The storm stopped before the football match.
candidates.chinese: 足球比赛前暴风雨停了。

candidates.english: Walk straight ahead for two hundred metres.
candidates.chinese: 笔直向前走两百米。

candidates.english: The road goes straight through the village.
candidates.chinese: 这条路笔直地穿过村庄。

candidates.english: Stand straight when the teacher takes the photo.
candidates.chinese: 老师拍照时站直。

candidates.english: The building has a simple modern style.
candidates.chinese: 这座建筑有一种简约的现代风格。

candidates.english: Her drawing has a bright cartoon style.
candidates.chinese: 她的画有一种明亮的卡通风格。

candidates.english: This restaurant uses a traditional Chinese style.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆采用传统的中国风格。

candidates.english: Many crops suffered damage in the flood.
candidates.chinese: 许多农作物在洪水中遭受损害。

candidates.english: The old bridge suffered damage after many years of rain.
candidates.chinese: 多年雨水之后，这座老桥遭受了损坏。

candidates.english: Some shops suffered losses during the power cut.
candidates.chinese: 一些商店在停电期间遭受了损失。

candidates.english: I suppose the bus will arrive soon.
candidates.chinese: 我想公交车很快就会到。

candidates.english: I suppose this key opens the front door.
candidates.chinese: 我认为这把钥匙能打开前门。

candidates.english: They suppose the meeting will end before noon.
candidates.chinese: 他们认为会议会在中午前结束。

candidates.english: Few plants can survive without water.
candidates.chinese: 很少有植物能在没有水的情况下存活。

candidates.english: The little fish can survive in cold water.
candidates.chinese: 这种小鱼能在冷水中存活。

candidates.english: These trees survived the dry summer.
candidates.chinese: 这些树在干燥的夏天里存活了下来。

candidates.english: Wear a warm sweater outside.
candidates.chinese: 到外面要穿一件暖和的毛衣。

candidates.english: He bought a green sweater for winter.
candidates.chinese: 他为冬天买了一件绿色毛衣。

candidates.english: My red sweater is still in the classroom.
candidates.chinese: 我的红色毛衣还在教室里。

candidates.english: The dog moved its tail happily.
candidates.chinese: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。

candidates.english: The cat has a long white tail.
candidates.chinese: 这只猫有一条长长的白尾巴。

candidates.english: A bird uses its tail to keep balance.
candidates.chinese: 鸟用尾巴保持平衡。

candidates.english: Turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
candidates.chinese: 刷牙时关掉水龙头。

candidates.english: The kitchen tap is leaking again.
candidates.chinese: 厨房的水龙头又漏水了。

candidates.english: Please clean the tap after washing the cups.
candidates.chinese: 洗完杯子后请清洁水龙头。

candidates.english: Use tape to fix the torn paper.
candidates.chinese: 用胶带粘好撕破的纸。

candidates.english: The box was closed with strong tape.
candidates.chinese: 这个盒子是用结实的胶带封好的。

candidates.english: Put a piece of tape on the label.
candidates.chinese: 在标签上贴一小块胶带。

candidates.english: We took a taxi to the airport.
candidates.chinese: 我们乘出租车去了机场。

candidates.english: A yellow taxi stopped near the hotel.
candidates.chinese: 一辆黄色出租车停在旅馆附近。

candidates.english: She called a taxi after the class ended.
candidates.chinese: 下课后她叫了一辆出租车。

candidates.english: Would you like some hot tea?
candidates.chinese: 你想喝点热茶吗？

candidates.english: My father drinks green tea after lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我爸爸午饭后喝绿茶。

candidates.english: Please pour the tea into this cup.
candidates.chinese: 请把茶倒进这个杯子里。

candidates.english: The centre offers activities for teenage students.
candidates.chinese: 这个中心为青少年学生提供活动。

candidates.english: This book talks about teenage life in a small town.
candidates.chinese: 这本书讲述了小镇上的青少年生活。

candidates.english: The magazine has a page for teenage readers.
candidates.chinese: 这本杂志有一页内容是给青少年读者的。

candidates.english: We put up our tent beside the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

candidates.english: The children slept in a blue tent.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们睡在一个蓝色帐篷里。

candidates.english: Rain fell softly on the tent roof.
candidates.chinese: 雨轻轻落在帐篷顶上。

candidates.english: Read the text and answer the questions.
candidates.chinese: 阅读课文并回答问题。

candidates.english: The teacher explained the new text carefully.
candidates.chinese: 老师仔细讲解了新课文。

candidates.english: There are three pictures beside the text.
candidates.chinese: 课文旁边有三幅图片。

candidates.english: The road was closed; therefore, we turned back.
candidates.chinese: 道路关闭了，因此我们返回了。

candidates.english: It was raining hard; therefore, the match started late.
candidates.chinese: 雨下得很大，因此比赛开始晚了。

candidates.english: She missed the bus; therefore, she walked to school.
candidates.chinese: 她错过了公交车，因此她步行去学校。

candidates.english: Warm water may help a sore throat.
candidates.chinese: 温水可能有助于缓解喉咙痛。

candidates.english: I drank water because my throat felt dry.
candidates.chinese: 我喝了水，因为我的喉咙感觉很干。

candidates.english: The singer rested her throat before the show.
candidates.chinese: 那位歌手在演出前让喉咙休息。

candidates.english: Loud thunder woke us during the night.
candidates.chinese: 巨大的雷声在夜里把我们惊醒了。

candidates.english: We heard thunder before the rain began.
candidates.chinese: 下雨前我们听到了雷声。

candidates.english: The children counted seconds after each sound of thunder.
candidates.chinese: 孩子们在每次雷声后数秒。

candidates.english: The tiger rested under a tree.
candidates.chinese: 老虎在一棵树下休息。

candidates.english: A tiger walked slowly across the grass.
candidates.chinese: 一只老虎慢慢走过草地。

candidates.english: The zoo guide told us about the young tiger.
candidates.chinese: 动物园导游给我们讲了那只幼年老虎。

candidates.english: A tiny insect landed on my hand.
candidates.chinese: 一只小昆虫落在我的手上。

candidates.english: She kept a tiny shell in her pocket.
candidates.chinese: 她把一个极小的贝壳放在口袋里。

candidates.english: A tiny light shone on the radio.
candidates.chinese: 收音机上有一盏极小的灯亮着。

candidates.english: The museum is closed today.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆今天闭馆。

candidates.english: I have two English classes today.
candidates.chinese: 我今天有两节英语课。

candidates.english: Today is my first day at this school.
candidates.chinese: 今天是我在这所学校的第一天。

candidates.english: We added tofu to the vegetable soup.
candidates.chinese: 我们在蔬菜汤里加了豆腐。

candidates.english: My grandma cooked tofu with tomatoes.
candidates.chinese: 我奶奶做了番茄豆腐。

candidates.english: This mapo tofu is not too spicy.
candidates.chinese: 这份麻婆豆腐不是很辣。

candidates.english: The toilet is at the end of the hall.
candidates.chinese: 卫生间在走廊尽头。

candidates.english: May I use the toilet now?
candidates.chinese: 我现在可以去卫生间吗？

candidates.english: The restaurant has a clean toilet near the door.
candidates.chinese: 这家餐馆门口附近有一个干净的卫生间。

candidates.english: We will finish the project tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我们今晚会完成这个项目。

candidates.english: My cousin will arrive tonight.
candidates.chinese: 我表哥今晚会到达。

candidates.english: There is a music show on TV tonight.
candidates.chinese: 今晚电视上有一场音乐节目。

candidates.english: These trousers are too long for me.
candidates.chinese: 这条裤子对我来说太长了。

candidates.english: He folded his trousers and put them on the chair.
candidates.chinese: 他把长裤叠好，放在椅子上。

candidates.english: My black trousers are in the wardrobe.
candidates.chinese: 我的黑色长裤在衣柜里。

candidates.english: Every student wears the school uniform.
candidates.chinese: 每个学生都穿校服。

candidates.english: Lily washed her uniform on Sunday.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉星期天洗了她的校服。

candidates.english: His uniform has the school name on it.
candidates.chinese: 他的校服上有学校的名字。

candidates.english: We will review Unit Five tomorrow.
candidates.chinese: 我们明天将复习第五单元。

candidates.english: Please read the first page of this unit.
candidates.chinese: 请阅读这个单元的第一页。

candidates.english: Our teacher began a new unit about weather.
candidates.chinese: 我们的老师开始了一个关于天气的新单元。

candidates.english: Scientists study the age of the universe.
candidates.chinese: 科学家研究宇宙的年龄。

candidates.english: The universe is full of stars and planets.
candidates.chinese: 宇宙中充满了恒星和行星。

candidates.english: This book explains how the universe began.
candidates.chinese: 这本书解释宇宙是如何开始的。

candidates.english: She hopes to study medicine at university.
candidates.chinese: 她希望在大学学习医学。

candidates.english: My brother lives near the university.
candidates.chinese: 我哥哥住在大学附近。

candidates.english: The university has a large library.
candidates.chinese: 这所大学有一个很大的图书馆。

candidates.english: The view from the hill was beautiful.
candidates.chinese: 从山上看到的景色很美。

candidates.english: Our hotel room had a clear view of the lake.
candidates.chinese: 我们的酒店房间能清楚地看到湖景。

candidates.english: The train window gave us a lovely view of the fields.
candidates.chinese: 火车车窗让我们看到了田野的美丽景色。

candidates.english: She practises the violin every evening.
candidates.chinese: 她每天晚上练习小提琴。

candidates.english: Tom carried his violin to the music room.
candidates.chinese: 汤姆把他的小提琴带到了音乐教室。

candidates.english: The soft sound of the violin filled the hall.
candidates.chinese: 小提琴柔和的声音充满了大厅。

candidates.english: The virus can spread through close contact.
candidates.chinese: 这种病毒会通过密切接触传播。

candidates.english: Doctors found a new virus in the sample.
candidates.chinese: 医生们在样本中发现了一种新病毒。

candidates.english: Washing hands often helps stop the virus.
candidates.chinese: 经常洗手有助于阻止这种病毒。

candidates.english: We play volleyball after school on Thursdays.
candidates.chinese: 我们每周四放学后打排球。

candidates.english: Volleyball is popular in our school.
candidates.chinese: 排球运动在我们学校很受欢迎。

candidates.english: Lily joined the volleyball team last term.
candidates.chinese: 莉莉上学期加入了排球队。

candidates.english: Joining the clean-up is completely voluntary.
candidates.chinese: 参加清洁活动完全是自愿的。

candidates.english: The after-school reading club is voluntary.
candidates.chinese: 课后阅读俱乐部是自愿参加的。

candidates.english: They made a voluntary choice to help at the library.
candidates.chinese: 他们自愿选择在图书馆帮忙。

candidates.english: Students voted for their favourite design.
candidates.chinese: 学生们投票选出了最喜欢的设计。

candidates.english: Each class will vote for one song.
candidates.chinese: 每个班将投票选一首歌。

candidates.english: We need to vote before lunch.
candidates.chinese: 我们需要在午饭前投票。

candidates.english: A colourful map hangs on the wall.
candidates.chinese: 一张彩色地图挂在墙上。

candidates.english: There is a clock on the back wall.
candidates.chinese: 后墙上有一个钟。

candidates.english: The white wall makes the room look bright.
candidates.chinese: 白色的墙让房间看起来很明亮。

candidates.english: The museum website lists its opening hours.
candidates.chinese: 博物馆网站列出了开放时间。

candidates.english: I found the homework list on the school website.
candidates.chinese: 我在学校网站上找到了作业清单。

candidates.english: This website has many photos of the park.
candidates.chinese: 这个网站有许多公园的照片。

candidates.english: The first bus leaves earlier on a weekday.
candidates.chinese: 工作日的首班公交车出发得更早。

candidates.english: I usually get up at six on a weekday.
candidates.chinese: 我通常在工作日六点起床。

candidates.english: The library is quiet on a weekday morning.
candidates.chinese: 工作日上午图书馆很安静。

candidates.english: A whale rose beside the boat.
candidates.chinese: 一头鲸浮出船边的水面。

candidates.english: The whale made a loud sound under the water.
candidates.chinese: 那头鲸在水下发出了很大的声音。

candidates.english: We saw a blue whale in the nature film.
candidates.chinese: 我们在自然电影中看到了一头蓝鲸。

candidates.english: One wheel of the bicycle was loose.
candidates.chinese: 自行车的一个轮子松了。

candidates.english: The cart has a small wheel at the front.
candidates.chinese: 这辆手推车前面有一个小轮子。

candidates.english: Please check the wheel before the bus leaves.
candidates.chinese: 请在公交车出发前检查轮子。

candidates.english: Whom did you invite to the meeting?
candidates.chinese: 你邀请了谁参加会议？

candidates.english: Whom should I ask for the answer?
candidates.chinese: 我应该问谁要答案？

candidates.english: Whom did the teacher call first?
candidates.chinese: 老师先叫了谁？

candidates.english: Please finish the task within an hour.
candidates.chinese: 请在一小时内完成任务。

candidates.english: The train will leave within ten minutes.
candidates.chinese: 火车将在十分钟内出发。

candidates.english: You can walk to the park within five minutes.
candidates.chinese: 你可以在五分钟内走到公园。

candidates.english: A wolf appeared at the edge of the forest.
candidates.chinese: 一匹狼出现在森林边缘。

candidates.english: The wolf walked quietly across the snow.
candidates.chinese: 那匹狼安静地走过雪地。

candidates.english: We saw a wolf in a nature documentary.
candidates.chinese: 我们在一部自然纪录片中看到了一匹狼。

candidates.english: The doctor looked carefully at the X-ray.
candidates.chinese: 医生仔细查看了X光片。

candidates.english: The nurse put the X-ray on the light board.
candidates.chinese: 护士把X光片放在观片灯上。

candidates.english: My father kept his old X-ray in a folder.
candidates.chinese: 我爸爸把他的旧X光片保存在一个文件夹里。

candidates.english: The leaves turn yellow in late autumn.
candidates.chinese: 深秋时树叶会变黄。

candidates.english: She wore a yellow raincoat to school.
candidates.chinese: 她穿着一件黄色的雨衣去上学。

candidates.english: There is a yellow cup on the kitchen table.
candidates.chinese: 厨房桌子上有一个黄色的杯子。

candidates.english: We visited the science museum yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 我们昨天参观了科学博物馆。

candidates.english: I borrowed this book from the library yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 我昨天从图书馆借了这本书。

candidates.english: It rained for two hours yesterday.
candidates.chinese: 昨天下了两个小时的雨。

candidates.english: I had fruit and yogurt for breakfast.
candidates.chinese: 我早餐吃了水果和酸奶。

candidates.english: She bought a cup of yogurt after class.
candidates.chinese: 她下课后买了一杯酸奶。

candidates.english: Please put the yogurt back in the fridge.
candidates.chinese: 请把酸奶放回冰箱。

candidates.english: He spent his youth in a small village.
candidates.chinese: 他的青年时期是在一个小村庄度过的。

candidates.english: My grandmother loved music in her youth.
candidates.chinese: 我奶奶在青年时期喜欢音乐。

candidates.english: During his youth, Mr. Li learned to paint.
candidates.chinese: 李先生在青年时期学会了画画。

candidates.english: Zero comes before one on the number line.
candidates.chinese: 在数轴上，零在一的前面。

candidates.english: The answer to this question is zero.
candidates.chinese: 这道题的答案是零。

candidates.english: The temperature fell to zero last night.
candidates.chinese: 昨晚气温降到了零度。
